eps.d: There is a boisterous bucks party for Des Clarke at No. 28. Shane Ramsay has hired a stripper, Daphne Lawrence, much to the delight of the other blokes. The noise is troubling some of the Ramsay street inhabitants, especially Max Ramsay. It is now 2a.m., and Max is going to put an end to Des' last day of "freedom"...
Lorraine ditches Des.
Daphne the stripper moves in with Des.
Kim and Scott meet in a lonely spot, but their conversation is taped.
Marcia Taylor gets hoist by her own petard.
The tape played back in class makes Scott and Kim sound promiscuous.
Scott catches up with Kim but she is adamant she won't return home.
Jim persuades Scott to return home.
Daphne's priest friend joins the search for Kim.
Julie Robinson is at work when a bank robber strikes.
Both the Ramsay boys are in hospital.
Jim Robinson falls for Maria Ramsay's sister.
A young man loitering outside the bank slips a note to Julie.
Jim and Anna spend a day at the markets.
Peter Kirk woos Julie.
There is tension between Max Ramsay, Jim and Anna.
Julie is given an ultimatum.
Anna tells Jim she is returning to Queensland.
Jim makes a decision about Julie.
Max thinks he has seen a miracle.
Shane gets the doctors' verdict on his diving prospects.
Des is in for a surprise.
Kim Taylor tells Scott she desperately needs money.
Des finds out who is running the campaign against Daphne.
Shane gets a job as an instructor at the pool.
Carol Brown is attacked.
Mrs. Brown reports Danny to the police.
Julie thinks she is going to have a romantic dinner with Des. Jim learns Scott has been lying.
Carol Brown seeks help.
Maria shocks Max with some news.
Max declares his marriage to be at an end.
Max and Maria split up.
Des punches one of Daphne's clients.
Shane is angry about his parent's decision to separate.
Scott and Danny are threatened by a gun.
Paul and Des fall out over Daphne's loan.
Max's new bedsitter is in a terrible state.
Jim has a visit from an old schoolfriend.
Shane is suspicious of Nick's friendship with Maria, Paul thinks about a career change and Max has a car accident.
Nick explains the accident to Maria.
Max and Shane don't find it easy working together, Nick makes a pass at Maria and Jim tries to calm Mrs Forbes.
Paul is bored with studying for exams and begins to skip lectures.
Danny takes the news of his parents divorce remarkably well, while Jim is furious at Paul's decision to leave university.
Julie does not approve of Paul's career plans, while Daphne is still causing problems for Des at work.
Shane quizzes Maria on her past. Des lands one on Greg.
Max prepares for his court case.
Max is fined.
Paul wants a second interview for the steward's job.
Greg shows his true colours.
Des turns down a promotion.
Max shows his softer side when he helps Steve with his marital problems.
Steve's daughter is rushed to hospital after taking some pills.
Shane discovers the truth about his parents' break-up and swears Jim to secrecy.
Nick announces that he is leaving and warns Max to act before it's too late.
Daphne gets a shock when she starts her new secretarial job.
Scott finds a place to stay for Kim and the baby.
Scott is horrified when he discovers Brad's plans for the baby.
Scott gets deeper into debt, and Daphne feels she must resign from her job.
Scott tells Paul of the problems with Kim, and Shane comes home, determined to apologise to Maria.
Scott tells Kim that she doesn't need him any more.
Danny deceives Maria about his party.
Scott's trauma is over. Danny tricks Maria about his party.
Danny falls prey to alcohol and marijuana at his party.
Pete spikes Danny's drink.
Danny recovers from his disastrous party.
Harry Henderson returns.
Shane starts job-hunting.
Paul brings home his new girlfriend.
Jim explains the reason why he resents Charlie Slater so much.
Max gives Terry the sack.
Terry reveals her past to Shane.
Terry tells Shane that her life is in danger, and there is an unpleasant surprise in store for Daphne.
Terry receives a threatening letter, and Linda Fielding has a secret.
Shane gets an insight into Linda Fielding's personal life.
Lucy sees more than she bargained for on an observation project.
Terry is threatened with a gun.
Max warms towards Terry.
Max and Maria's dinner to discuss their future turns unpleasant.
It's decision time for Maria.
Jim talks seriously to Philip Martin.
The Robinsons move in on the Ramsay boys' girlfriends.
Shane decides to move in with Max.
Julie is convinced that Philip has deceived her about his wife.
Des agrees to see Joan Langdon again.
Scott tries to pay off his debts.
Danny has his big night out with Wendy.
Des's romance with Joan appears to be getting serious.
Max finds it hard to accept that Maria is seeing other men.
Philip asks Julie to marry him. Wendy strings along both Scott and Danny.
Wendy leaves.
Julie makes a decision about her future.
A feud erupts between the Robinsons and the Suttons.
Shane decides to sort things out with his mother.
Daphne suspects Joan of freeloading of Des. Shane takes Maria out to dinner.
Lucy is upset about having to wear glasses. Des proposes.
Max is totally convinced that Maria has a boyfriend.
Maria goes on a date with the insurance assessor.
Des tells Eileen that he's getting married.
Eileen apologises to Des about her clash with Joan.
Paul proposes to Terry. Eileen talks about her son's forthcoming marriage.
Paul announces his engagement, and Julie reacts oddly.
Max has a row with his neighbour.
Terry learns of Shane and Daphne's plans to live together.
Scott gets a job offer from Jim.
Joan gets a visit from her former husband.
Joan’s former husband turns up.
Joan is confused about her feelings towards Geoff.
Joan decides to go back to Geoff.
Richard Morrison declares his love for Maria.
Max agrees to divorce Maria.
Des and Julie find comfort in each other's company.
Daphne discovers the identity of her mystery intruder.
Des is dismayed when Eileen wants to move in with him.
Helen is upset and explains why she can never forgive her sister.
Rachel is surprised when her father turns up.
Paul gets some bad news.
Terry's deal on the house falls through and Ian meets Rachel's family.
Rachel agrees to live with her father.
Maria confides in Helen, and Jim and Scott clash over the coffee shop.
Jim can't bring himself to tell Max about his dinner with Maria and Richard, and Eileen moves her things out of Des's house.
Max interrupts Maria's dinner party, and Shane spends the night with Liz.
Shane gives Daphne an ultimatum.
Terry convinces Max that he should go to the wedding.
Max begins to seriously think about saving his marriage.
Jim tells Max that Richard is going to Hong Kong without Maria, and Terry and Paul continue to look for a new home.
Danny refuses to go away with Maria and Richard. Max hopes to get Maria back. *Opening titles change: Maria Ramsay removed.
Max agrees to take care of Danny. Meanwhile Paul is stranded in Singapore.
Helen is upset and clashes with Jim and Julie. Maria says her goodbyes to Ramsay Street.
It's the day of Terry and Paul's wedding and Gwen spoils Helen's day.
Gwen makes a startling speech at Paul and Terry's wedding. Maria Ramsay walks out of Max's life.
Daphne and Shane make up. Max returns to Ramsay Street.
Des has news for Helen, and Danny almost causes a disaster. Helen meets Douglas Blake.
Paul and Terry return from their honeymoon.
Terry is left alone in the house. Jim is embarrassed to learn the truth about Douglas, and he then clashes with Helen over his interference in her life.
The arrival of Jim's mother causes large waves in the Robinson household. Daphne and Terry's night out backfires, and Scott gets a shock.
Jim finds out how Terry and Paul are coping. Scott is concerned about his grandmother after her blackout, and Lucy is upset with Bess. Terry is having problems adapting to married life.
Paul and Terry have the first disagreement of the marriage, and Scott wins a school writing competition.
Jim begins to appreciate Scott's talent, and George and Eileen have a quarrel.
Max loses his job. George has an accident and Des diets.
Danny is caught joyriding and Helen grows more and more fond of Douglas.
Helen's relationship with Douglas Blake blossoms.
Bess discusses life and Death with Scott, and Shane gives Danny a driving lesson.
Bess Robinson leaves, and Jim makes a shocking discovery about his mother.
Des and Daphne sort out their differences over Sarah, and Eileen wants to impress George. Max has a surprise night ourt.
Julie gets a big shock, and Eileen starts her new job doing housekeeping work for Max.
Julie breaks some upsetting news to Philip.
There's bad news from the hospital as Philip's condition deteriorates.
Helen hears some distressing news. Daphne makes peace with Sarah and asks her to stay on at Des's house.
Daphne upsets Helen when she voices her doubts about Douglas, Danny and Sarah don't get on.
Helen is annoyed with the family for interfering in her friendship with Douglas, and Shane and Max worry about Danny. Des gets a shock.
Daphne gets a strange visit from her grandfather. Max teaches Danny to drive.
Barbara searches the Sutton house for Terry's tape. Jim visits Philip Martin in hospital.
Lucy is upset by the tape and decides to destroy it. Terry receives a threatening phone call from Charles. Helen has a surprise for Jim.
Helen and Doug announce their engagement, and Danny gets the job at the bank after the successful candidate quits unexpectedly and creates a vacancy.
Harry's poker game lands him in hot water, while Terry finds the tape missing.
Helen prepares for her wedding, and Daphne reports Lucy's disappearance to the police.
Terry asks Shane for help when she becomes frightened. George proposes to Eileen.
Lucy is anxious about Helen leaving, while Des sees his mother in a new light.
Helen is persuaded to accept Jim's offer of money. Daphne gets a proper job.
Scott jumps to the wrong conclusion when he sees Shane leaving Terry's house.
Paul gives Shane a warning to stay away from his wife. Des announces a bank contest.
Excitement grips the Robinson household as Helen's marriage approaches. Paul becomes increasingly suspicious of Terry.
The Robinsons' celebrate the news of Terry and Paul's baby, and the finalisation of Helen and Douglas's cottage. The missing tape is found.
Daphne is mistaken for Terry by Charles' hitman. Max clashes with Jim over Terry's lie.
Daphne tells Max the full story of her 'accident'. Jim makes an announcement. Max takes the law into his own hands when he visits Charles.
Helen finds out the devastating truth about Douglas and Terry gains the upper hand over Charles.
Max has a rendezvous with his mystery client. Terry's behaviour is causing concern, particularly after she implicates Daphne in the Durham affair. Paul finds out the truth about Terry.
Terry attempts to shoot Paul, and the Robinsons are thrown into turmoil as the street drama reaches a climax.
Daphne is starting to feel pressured by Shane who asks her to live with him. Max and Kate's dinner date has disastrous consequences.
Des, Shane and Daphne try to sort out their differences. Danny and Max make amends.

Sparks fly when Max's sister - Madge Mitchell - arrives in Ramsay St. 17-year-old Mike Young gets a job in the coffee shop. Max worries about property values and Paul returns from a three week convalescence whilst Shane accuses Zoe Davis of theft…
Des has a new admirer. Danny learns the identity of his new neighbour.
An innocent kiss between Daphne and Paul causes a stir just days before her and Des's wedding.
Danny is determined to earn enough money to take Marcie on a surfing holiday.
Paul's career takes off, and Madge starts to see Jim in a different light when he comforts her after a bad day.
Paul's personal problems grow worse as he causes a major feud at the Robinson's. Meanwhile, Madge manages to wangle herself an evening out with Jim.
Madge voices her disapproval over Daphne's past as a stripper. Danny gets a shock at work involving Marcie.
A lottery win enables Zoe to repay her debt to Shane.
The day before his wedding, Des recalls his past let-downs at the altar.
Preparations are afoot to celebrate the wedding of Des and Daphne, but disaster looms for Des.
The Ramsay Street residents try to come to terms with the events of Des and Daphne's wedding day. The police call on Max.
Helen plans to get her revenge on Douglas Blake.
Jim and Helen discover that Scott has been accused of a very serious crime.
Des and Daphne have a distressing encounter. Madge reveals the truth to Helen about her broken marriage. Clive and Shane go into business together.
Des is forced to take Zoe in as a lodger to avoid Eileen moving in. Daphne lays down some new ground rules between her and a disappointed Des. Jim continues his search for Scott.
Daphne takes a break and Zoe makes a disastrous attempt to run the coffee shop. News from the police brings Jim's search for Scott to an abrupt halt. The Police ask Jim to identify Scott's body.
Jim identifies a body. Clive and Shane fall for a sexy customer - with dire consequences, and Douglas Blake and Madge have a meeting at the hotel.
Zoe discovers the truth when Mike reveals who is responsible for his injuries. Scott contacts Jim after recovering from a vicious attack.
Scott Robinson returns home after his ordeal, much to Jim's relief. Madge and Helen set a trap to catch Douglas using the diamond from Madge's ring.
There's an unexpected new development in the plot to snare Douglas Blake. Beth Travers visits Shane and knocks Max for six.
Helen and Madge put their plan into action. Daphne returns - still very hung up on Des.
Mike faces his father. Revenge is sweet for Helen.
Daphne rehires Zoe.
Helen's daughter Rosemary Daniels arrives in Ramsay Street.
Rosemary causes disruption.
The Robinson household is divided when Rosemary offers Helen a high-powered managerial job.
Rosemary offers Des the management job after Helen declines it. Danny's scheme for computer betting ends in frustration.
Danny and Des find themselves in trouble with Max. There's a mixed reaction to Jim's news about Scott's new tutor, and Helen is upset that Rosemary did not offer Paul the job.
The hostility between Beth and Shane continues. Helen finds it hard to cope with Rosemary's desire to find her real mother.
Shane is at the mercy of Beth Travers, and Danny's computer race tips send Max into convulsions.
Rosemary finally meets her real mother, and Max is warned about his health.
Zoe applies for a job as Paul's secretary.
Convinced that he is going to die, Max tries to make peace with Ramsay Street.
Zoe is attracted to Jim, and Helen offers Shane a partnership.
Shane is stunned by Daphne's announcement.
The past catches up with Des.
Bradley causes havoc in Ramsay Street.
Max learns the truth about his health.
Max becomes the centre of attention. Meanwhile, Shane and Helen get on the road at last.
Scott clashes with Jim over his school work, and Bradley causes more trouble.
Scott turns to drink to try and solve his problems.
Andrea makes Des a risky offer.
Daphne and Zoe plan a night out for Max, and Paul and Helen make a discovery.
The Max Ramsay Appreciation Society makes plans for revenge.
The Ramsay Street vendetta against Max backfires. Mike falls in love, and Helen's surprise for Nikki goes wrong.
It's Max's birthday, but will anybody remember? Laura has problems with Nikki.
Jim finds himself the object of two women's affections.
Will Max spoil Shane and Daphne's engagement party?
Shane blames Des for the loss of a job. Des confides in Daphne.
Shane becomes more jealous of Des.
Dr Clive performs an emergency operation on Lucy. NB: Scott and Madge added to opening titles.
Jim and Paul reach crisis-point over Zoe.
Nikki and Laura are invited to two very different dinners.
Nikki is forced to make an important choice that will have repercussions on the rest of her life. A rival of Andrea's turns up.
Eileen wants Des to settle things with Andrea and Bradley. She makes a trip to Perth and plans to find out why Andrea left.
The bonds between Jim and Zoe are reinforced. They get to know each other more intimately, spending an evening together and have their fist kiss.
Danny finds that being an adult can be lonely. Des tries to become an attentive and fun father to Bradley.
Paul still does not accept the romance between Jim and Zoe, and he is reminded about some bitter memories from his own life.
Des seeks Daphne's advice about marriage.
The tension between Paul and Jim finally reaches breaking point, with discussions on the relationship between Zoe and Jim dragging on endlessly.
Despite Lucy's pleas, Paul leaves the Robinson house and moves into Lassiters.
The affects of Paul's departure are felt in the whole of Ramsay Street.
The disappearance of Lucy and Bradley provokes a search of the neighbourhood with everyone pitching in..
Daphne receives some shocking news and asks Des for advice. Zoe tries to establish a friendly relationship with Paul, but without success.
Madge's daughter, Charlene, arrives in Ramsay Street. She announces that her father's girlfriend is pregnant.
Mike and Charlene go job hunting. The tension between Madge and Charlene are not improving, so Helen suggests that one of them move in with her.

Daphne and Clive discover a different side of Mike when he reveals his plans to leave school to strike out on his own. Nikki breaks up with Mike. Charlene is determined to move in on him. Unaware that Charlene has been partly responsible for the breaking between Nikki and Mike, Helen makes arrangements with Madge for Charlene to move into the Robinson house to share Nikki's room...
Zoe has to make a difficult decision. A threat weighs on the relationship between Des and Andrea.
Zoe confides in Jim that Paul is behind the relaunch of Daphne's coffee shop, Daphne is angry with Zoe and Des decides to reveal his parenthood.
Eileen's revelations threaten Bradley's future. Shane is furious to learn that Paul was associated with the relaunch of the coffee shop. Zoe is pleased to learn that she will keep her job with Paul.
A mysterious stranger lurks on Ramsay Street. Des refuses to believe that Bradley is not his son. Eileen has lost the birth certificate that holds the truth.
The draw for the pancake competition causes uproar. Zoe dines with the Robinson's although tensions remain high. A stranger stalking Ramsay Street frightens Bradley. Mrs Mangels first appearance.
Des protects Bradley from Gavin McKinley, but Gavin threatens Des with the police because he wants custody of his son.
Things in the Ramsay house do not improve when Madge learns that Helen has shown Max how to make pancakes.
Eileen is determined to save Des from Andrea's hold. She is convinced that Gavin is telling the truth and disapproves of Andrea who is keeping Bradley away from him. Last appearance of Max Ramsay.

Bradley has to choose between fathers and Lucy's sex education class creates problems. Eileen calls upon Clive and Shane to help her catch Gavin. Des and Andrea arrive at the moment Clive forces Gavin to halt on the side of the road. Diplomatically, Clive takes the matter in hand.
Eileen hopes to bring a little Sunday tradition to the street. Shane's depression has dire consequences for Daphne. He feels bad for her and decides to break off their engagement,

Eileen fancies herself as the new Pavarotti, and a surprise visitor turns up at the Ramsay's. Daphne tries hard to reassure Shane, but her lack of confidence in him deepens. Jim and Zoe's weekend is a disaster.
Madge has a great deal more than the pancake competition on her mind. Fred and Madge do not reach an agreement upon their financial settlement,
Des and Daphne share an intimate dinner. Mrs Mangel succeeds in preventing Helen from winning the prize in the pancake contest.

Daphne shows Shane the door when he attempts to justify his behavior. Tom is furious and Shane decides to call off the engagement. Eileen tries to reunite Des and Daphne. First appearance of Tom Ramsay.
Mrs Mangel is put through the wringer. Clive finds an office job for Madge, but her first morning is a disaster.
A new client helps Shane get over losing Daphne. Madge realises that she and Shane have had a bad education and that that this is the source of all their troubles.
Daphne is hurt that Shane has recovered so quickly after the break-up of their engagement.
Madge is delighted to discover that she has a secret admirer.
Des hires Clive's services when he decides to go courting. Helen catches Debra kissing Shane. Jim continues to protect his relationship with Zoe while he can.
Des helps Daphne move into the coffee shop. Clive tries to convince Des that if he wants to win over Daphne, he will have to be more assertive.
Andrea gets a job and Paul gets caught out. The conflict between Paul, Helen and the Flemings gets so bad that Paul refuses to do business with them.
Zoe gets a threatening letter and Scott gets closer to Charlene. The way Debra has treated him hurts Shane. He starts to drink a bit to much and seeks consolation with Paul.
Jim has some important news. Clive's attempts to reconcile Des and Daphne do not come to fruition.Daphne is shocked by Des's lack of romanticism.

Madge and Charlene are finding it hard to get on with each other. Danny, jealous of the friendship between Tom and Mike, suceeds in convincing Tom to give him golf lessons. Lucy is recovering in hospital after the telephone incident.
Jim is worried about Lucy and gets angry when he finds out what happened. Zoe considers ending her relationship with Jim after he blames her for Lucy's predicament.
Zoe finally realizes that her relationship with Jim is over. Everyone at the Robinson house is pleased to learn that Lucy will fully recover.
Jim tries to come to terms with losing Zoe. Tom continues to train Mike. Danny and Shane are fed up with hearing about his achievements.
Clive offers Charlene some advice. Scott arranges a hotel room for himself and Charlene.
Scott abandons Charlene after she confesses that he isn't the first man in her life.
Charlene moves back into the Ramsay household. Scott and Charlene are banned from seeing each other. Clive feels ill after eating too much.
Charlene is shattered when she hears that her father does not want her to come home. Charlene and Scott attempt to sort out their differences,

Shane makes a fateful decision after being influenced by Tom's enthusiasm for Mike's diving activities. Charlene is concerned by her father's confession that he does not want her back with him. Tom renews his efforts to find Madge a husband.
To the great relief of Tom, Shane succeeds in performing a flawless dive. Jack takes it upon himself to discipline Bradly.
Des almost knocks Daphne over in his car. Andrea has to choose between Bradley and Jack.
Tom falls in love with his teacher, Jean, Nikki prepares for her date. Zoe returns home.
Zoe returns with a secret. Nikki goes on her date with Grant Kenny,

Bradley doesn't like the relationship between his Mum and Jack nor between Des and Daphne, He thinks no one is devoting enough time to him. Bradley and Lucy announce their engagement. Is Zoe pregnant?
Des attempts to convince Zoe to reconsider marrying Jim. Lucy and Bradley break off their engagement. Mike is angry with Nikki after finding out about her date. .
Mrs Mangel moves into Ramsay Street and wastes no time in living up to her reputation.
Zoe is rushed into hospital after she faints.
Nikki is flattered by Mike's efforts to defend her, While collecting money for charity, Mike, Nikki, Scott and Charlene are shocked by Mrs York's strange attitude. Des takes a stand to win Daphne.
Des proposes to Daphne, Lucy and Bradley make up and renew their engagement. Clive launches a new scheme.
Des offers the use of Eileen's house to Andrea. Jack and Andrea get engaged.
Madge is shocked when she learns of Mrs York's disastrous financial situation, Bradley has mixed reactions to his mothers engagement.
With Jack's approval Clive decides to organise a sale of his items in front of the coffee shop. Mrs Mangel is outraged and calls the police. Jack considers selling Lassiters.
Jack decides to sell the complex to Paul. Helen and Madge grow increasingly concerned for Mrs York.
Clive and Helen break into Mrs York's house and find her unconscious on the floor. Jack delays selling the complex to Paul, Zoe is discharged from Hospital.
Mrs York is very touched by the kindness shown by her neighbours, but after being discharged; Madge and Clive find that she has passed away, Andrea, Bradley and Jack depart on their European trip.
Debra tries to cause trouble between Paul and Shane, Paul loses his temper with Shane after a disaster at Lassiters.
Mrs York's funeral takes place and darkens the atmosphere. Fred wants Madge back . The conflict between Nikki and Mike worsens. Paul hires a private detective to help catch his spy.
Helen returns home with bad news about Laura's health. Madge is persuaded to accept Fred's dinner invitation. Mike rescues a surfer from the sea.
Nikki leaves Ramsay Street to join her sick mother in Charleville. Mike can't resist Cassie's charms. Mrs York's dog sadly passes away, Helen consoles Lucy. Charlene runs away to join Scott.
Mike skips his training session and makes a surprise discovery about his girlfriend. Zoe returns to work. Paul gives Shane his job back.
Jean takes Tom to the hospital to meet her husband. Mike and Cassie argue over her career.
Jean chooses her husband over Tom. Mike and Scott get kicked off the dive team. Charlene agrees to get some photos taken, unaware of what she has agreed to.
Cassie throws Scott and Charlene out after they have an argument. Daphne agrees to let Des have a bucks party, during which Des drinks too much. Danny announces he has got a job transfer.
Mike breaks up with Cassie. Scott, Charlene and Mike decide to return home. Daphne wrongly believes that Des has broken his arm.
Daphne gets a surprise visitor. Des and Daphne's wedding day finally arrives.
Scott, Charlene and Mike return home, Madge and Charlene have a big showdown, as do Jim and Scott. Des and Daphne leave for their honeymoon..
Shane finds himself in big trouble after the accident, and Zoe and Tony's romance blossoms.
Jim receives a phone call from Rosemary. Clive's family arrive. Des and Daphne enjoy their honeymoon,
Des' injury forces him and Daphne to return from their honeymoon early. Mike moves out of Clive's house. Paul gets jealous of Zoe's date.
Shane continues his search for the witness. Zoe gets angry at Paul but later makes up with him. Des and Daphne return home, Des has injured his back.
Shane considers escaping from his problems. Clive clashes with with his brother. N.B Charlene added to credits, Max, Danny and Zoe removed.
Graham apologises to Clive after he finds out the reason he gave up being a doctor. Madge and Charlene clash again. Shane struggles when he returns to driving.
Shane worries over the threat of prison, and quits being a chauffeur. Graham and Clive establish a much better relationship.
Mike moves out for a few days so that Des and Daphne can enjoy their honeymoon. Shane finds his witness.
Alex clears Shane of drink driving.
Lucy witnesses a break-in. Charlene becomes a reluctant babysitter.
Des and Daphne are horrified when Eileen says that she wants to move in with them. Clive gets a surprise visitor.
Mrs Mangels granddaughter, Jane moves into Ramsay Street.
Helen intervenes in a brawl between Scott and Paul. Madge and Eileen are left in charge of the coffee shop.
Jane is unpopular with Scott after she tells Madge that Charlene has been missing school. Clive comes to the aid of Charlene.
Madge is horrified that Charlene has deceived her about the baby.
Louise and Clive's relationship intensifies. Mrs Mangel and Eileen find out about the baby.
Charlene tells Scott the truth about the baby. Tom reacts strangely to a letter from Max.
Vicki is worried about Alex's threats. Eileen causes problems for the coffee shop.
Daphne is furious with Clive when she realises he is to blame for the coffee shop fiasco. Vicki is scared to return to her house.
Madge finds out the truth about Max and Tom's double dealing. Vicki confides in Clive. The truth about the baby is revealed.
Madge is devastated to find out how Charlene has lied to her about the baby.
Shane finds that he has to share his caravan home with a squatter. Vicki recognises the burglar.
Graham confronts Alex. Daphne tries to encourage Mike to ask Jane to the school dance.
Jane decides on a drastic course of action to attract Mike.
Charlene hatches a plan to make Jane more attractive, Clive spots Alex and gives chase.
Eileen makes some salmon mousse, and tries to force coffee shop customers to buy it. Alex is taken to hospital. Charlene's plan to give Jane a makeover continues.
Eileen is using old food in the mousse, causing a bout of illness. Madge is trying to get Susan to stay. Scott and Charlene cannot wait for Jane's big dress reveal.
Daphne is still in bed ill and everyone is worried. Mike is speechless with Jane’s new look. They all head off to the dance but everything does not go as planned and Jane runs off.

Scott and Charlene are home from the dance early and tell Sue that Mike walked home alone. Daphne is not eating and Des is concerned that she also might be pregnant. Meanwhile Paul has plans for Patty to stay longer and invites her out to dinner.
Daphne's condition worsens and she is taken to hospital, in serious condition. Madge struggles to adapt to new technology.
As Daphne hovers between life and death, Clive face a crisis of confidence in his medical ability. Madge gets a surprise visitor.
Madge wants to know why her father has arrived on Ramsay Street without her mother.
Paul is determined to punish Scott and Lucy. Jim returns home from his trip. Zoe receives a tempting offer.
Madge discovers the secret surrounding her fathers arrival. Madge starts her new job.
Jim meets up with Ruth, a woman he met on the plane. Susan goes for a job interview. Madge and Clive come up with a scheme to get rid of her father.
Jim invites Ruth to stay with the Robinsons after she has money trouble. Clive becomes increasingly involved with baby Sam. Madge and Toms Mum arrives.
Helen goes on a date with Dan Ramsay. Susan begins working for Paul. Zoe has money troubles.
Tom leaves to visit his new Granddaughter. Daphne returns home from hospital. Clive has another plan to get the Ramsay's back together. Mrs Mangel is horrified by a letter.
Mrs Mangel forbids Jane from seeing Mike, resulting in them meeting up in secret.
Mrs Mangel reads a shocking letter about Mike and is determined to keep him away from Jane, she also visits the school to share her concerns.
Jane stands up to her mother and defends Mike. The mystery letter writer is uncovered.
Edna asks Dan for a divorce but has a shock when she visits the registry office. Jane threatens to leave home. Mike's innocence is proven.
Scott, Charlene, Mike and Jane confront Sue about the letters, resulting in Sue getting punched. Madge is shocked after finding out about her parents marriage.
Bill Parker threatens to sue Mike, Scott, Charlene and Jane because of what happened to his daughter, Sue. Clive's latest plan ends in a proposal.
Edna and Dan decide to tie the knot after 50 years. Rosemary lands Paul a new business deal.
Paul's new new business deal means a major upheaval for Ramsay Street, Scott comes up with a plan to make money.
Dan and Edna get married. Jim and Ruth find they have a lot in common. Mike and Scott start writing a pop song.
Madge suspects that her son, Henry, may be responsible for the burglary. Scott and Mike complete their song and start dreaming of stardom. Warwick Capper guest stars.
Paul tells Helen about the plans for Ramsay Street. Charlene is determined to land a job as a cheerleader.
The Ramsay Street residents are told of the redevelopment plans. Clive manages to get Charlene and Jane a cheerleader audition.
Des and Daphne disagree over whether to accept Paul's offer. Clive plans to take action.
Charlene is left bitterly disappointed after her audition.
After Jim and Des refuse to sell their property, Peter comes up with a drastic plan. Jane and Charlene fall out.
Sue Parker plays a nasty trick on Scott. Paul pulls out of the deal to demolish Ramsay Street.
Scott and Mike turn up for the bogus appointment. Lucy encourages her Dad to have a relationship with Ruth.
Charlene gets revenge on Sue Parker. Des and Daphne fret about not being pregnant yet. Scott's dreams of becoming a rock star are shattered.
Scott is jealous when Charlene gets the opportunity of a lifetime. Paul discovers that Ruth has been lying to Jim. Des accidentally takes a sleeping potion.
Jane finds Mike and Nikki in each others arms, after Nikki returns to Erinsborough. Ruth threatens to return to England, before declaring her love for Jim.
Jane's jealousy of Nikki causes a rift between her and Mike. Madge cant get on with the house keeper resulting in a public outburst.

Madge keeps her job, and is later offered a new role. Jane is upset by the way Mike is treating her, leading to a confrontation. Hilda's secret is discovered, costing her her job and a trip to the Police.
Mike sets Nikki straight about their relationship. Mrs Mangel offers her services as a house keeper. Madge accepts Paul's job offer.
An old friend of Helen comes for a visit. Madge leaves for her training course.
Laura argues with Nikki after experiencing a little pain during a jog. Helen is concerned about a note found at her husbands grave.
Helen discovers a well kept secret which causes her to break off links with Laura. Scott and Charlene organise a cricket match for charity.
Helen makes amends with Laura, then invites her to visit Rosemary in the States with her. The charity cricket match takes place.
Charlene wants to have fun whilst her Mum is away. Des is not happy with Philip staying.
Nikki and Laura finally sort out their relationship. Clive returns from his Grandfathers funeral
Paul disapproves of Clive's plan to trick his Uncle Ted by pretending to be the perfect example of a successful married man.
Shane and Scott are concerned by Charlene's drinking. Uncle Ted stays longer than expected, which means that Clive and Sue must continue pretending to be the perfect couple.
Paul's relationship with Sue is turned upside down when he receives an unexpected letter from his ex-wife, Terri, but he tears it up before reading it.

Ted confronts Clive about his 'unfaithful Wife' after he sees Paul kissing Susan, causing Clive to confess the truth to him. Ted decides to leave and visit his brother. Paul gets a phone call from prison.
Charlene is led astray by Warren. Paul decides to visit Terri in hospital, and hears some shocking news.
Ray blames Charlene when Warren ends up in hospital. By spreading a false rumour about Warren and Charlene, Sue succeeds in making Scott jealous.
Ray and Charlene go to the hospital where Warren tells them what has happened. Charlene feels the whole world is against her.
Charlene anxiously awaits the return of her mother and decides to run away to avoid facing the consequences of her actions.
Lucy is ill so Jim allows her to take the day off, though Scott believes she is faking her illness. Lucy tries to rescue a Cat whilst walking to the coffee shop.
Madge and Ray come to an understanding, Lucy is trapped.
Lucy is found, but has lost her sight, Scott is stressed about the exams.
Paul and Jim attend Terri's funeral. Lucy remains in hospital.
Paul makes Madge an offer. Ruth decides to fly back to England, until Lucy intervenes.
Lucy finds it increasingly difficult to keep her secret. Ruth leaves for England.
Scott changes his mind about cheating in his exam.
Shane and Jane's disappearance causes concern. Ray offers to lend Madge money to buy the house.
The wanderers return to a 'warm' reception after a long night in the bush. Susan contemplates her relationship with Clive.
Mike becomes jealous about Jane and Shane.
Shane asks Jane for a date. Susan tells Clive that she doesn't love him.
Helen's unexpected return from America is shrouded in mystery. Paul is jealous of Clive and Susan. Eileen's handbag gets stolen.
Eileen loses her voice as a result of the theft. Shane applies for a bank loan.
Shane chases and manages to catch the purse-snatcher.
Helen reveals the reason she returned home early. Daphne's decision to take Kelly under her wing meets with general disapproval.
Scott's driving lessons from Paul are not going well. Kelly returns with Paul's car. Kelly and Eileen continue to argue, resulting in a spicy outcome.
Jane has to choose between Mike and Shane. Des is having the birthday blues. Madge gets some good news about Henry.
Des suffers from a mysterious illness. Susan makes a confession to Clive. Paul wants Susan to go on a business trip with him.
Helen gets a phone call from the USA. Des' surprise birthday party takes place and Clive makes an astonishing diagnosis.

Susan and Clive get engaged and promptly decode on a wedding date. Scott is thrilled by Jim's surprise present, but an engagement ring and a pram herald a disaster that shocks the whole of Ramsay Street.
Scott is taken to hospital in a critical condition and has to undergo surgery.
Jane rekindles her old relationship with Mike. Charlene visits Scott in hospital to make a confession. Shane and Mike are about to come to blows.
An unexpected visitor causes a disturbance at the coffee shop. Mike and Shane agree to get the gloves on, while Des and Clive agree to train them and Jim agrees to referee. But Clive has a plan...
Daphne stands bail for Kelly. Shane gives Kelly a job, but not for long.
Threats are the order of the day on Ramsay Street, but which are real and which are imagined?
Charlene and Kelly form an unlikely alliance as they both look for work. What has Mrs Mangel done with Len and why has she taken to midnight gardening?
The secret in Mrs Mangels garden is unearthed. Dan returns, to become Shane's new trainer.
A training session in the gym develops into a tense confrontation. The big fight begins to divide the neighbourhood.
Shane and Mike square up for the big fight - will sanity prevail?

The long-awaited day of the exam results arrives - will it bring joy or sadness? While Charlene, Jane, Mike can celebrate, Scott is bitterly disappointed. Jim expects Scott to repeat the school year. Helen is visited by a strange man who introduces himself as Reverend Errol Price, but the visitor is destined to cause a lot of heartache.

Scott sees his brother in new light when Paul buys him a car. Sinister things are happening at the cemetery. Alleged prison chaplain Reverend Errol Price reveals his true colours. He doesn't care about the well-being of his fellow human beings, but wants to wipe out their lives. Paul and Susan have a row.

Helen hasn't come home all night. Paul spots her car in a parking lot. The Robinson family is in a frenzy and suspect that Reverend Price has something to do with Helen's disappearance, then Paul gets some interesting facts from the prison - the real Reverend Price is a much older man.

Reverend Eroll Price is revealed to be Ralph Drew and Helen's kidnapper. Shortly after, he shows up at the Robinsons. When he leaves their house, Charlene and Shane give chase. But it quickly becomes a dangerous mission.

Dan pays a furtive visit to the doctor. Kelly tells Daphne she killed her father. Madge is left money by her aunt Maud in a will. She is to be paid a large sum if she can prove to her father Dan that she has become a decent and honorable woman.
Paul fires Susan. Helen appears to have made a full recovery, but later becomes tired and emotional.
Clive gives a verdict on Dan's health. Charlene and Kelly put Mike and Scott in an embarrassing situation.
Daphne and Madge begin to scheme for Clive and Susan's wedding. Mike and Scott are caught with their trousers down. Shane is bitten by a snake.
Susan is forced to admit her true feelings for Paul.
Kelly tries hard to impress Shane. Susan makes a decision about her future.
Clive blames Paul for Susan's sudden disappearance.
Susan reaches out to Charlene. Scott gets his first pay cheque.
Clive accuses Paul of ruining his life.
Paul offers Mrs Mangel a full time job at Lassiters. Scott's first article is published.

Charlene begs Madge to call Mr Bishop, Charlene thinks Paul has ruined Clives life but Shane tells her to not be so hard. Charlene reads Scott’s article and says if it is published it will cause a stink that he will not hear the end of.
Madge is upset to learn that Charlene still has ambitions to be a mechanic. Helen gets a visitor.

Scott and Lucy get in an argument about Basil coming to the beach with them. Scott does not want Basil stinking out his car. Things get saucy at the beach with Scott and Charlene and Basil put himself in a life threatening situation when he jumps off the pier.

Lucy and Mike are on the pier calling and looking for Basil. They cannot find him, Mike dives into the sea. Mike comes up from under the water and Lucy shouts if he can see Basil. Mike shouts back that he cannot see him anywhere, he swims under the pier and dives down under the ocean in a vain search for Basil.
Scott's newspaper article has widespread repercussions in Ramsay Street.
Des and Daphne have a showdown that sees Des thrown out of his house. Helen gets some alarming news.
Scott is determined to continue with his newspaper article. Eileen is very supportive of Daphne.
Rosemary returns to Erinsborough and receives some bad news. Scott's latest article is published, angering Madge.
Mrs Mangel tells Helen the truth about her husband. Charlene gets an apprenticeship in a garage, Rosemary is determined to find out the truth.
Charlene starts her job, but it doesn't go well. Scott manages to stop the publication of his next article, with Jim's help. Madge has a plan to get Des and Daphne back together.
Madge hosts a dinner with some of the neighbours.
An argument between Des and Daphne ends in disaster.
Daphne and the baby are fine and Des apologises. Rosemary finds some letters that reveal some devastating information.
Rosemary is upset over the fact that Helen had an affair with her fiance so she moves into Lassiters, Charlene visits her brother in prison.
Madge tries hard to find the money to save her son. Mike gives bouncer to Lucy. Henry is released from prison but Madge wont have him in her home.
Henry gets to stay and Jim tries to make Helen and Rosemary friends again.
Sue Parker makes a pass on Scott, Paul and Jack agree on a business deal, Rosemary will go to France to organise it all and will take Lucy to see Bradley.
A Journalist takes an unusual interest in Paul's life.

Rosemary convinces Paul to stay on at Lassiters. Paul thinks that Clive told the journalist about his private life. Clive makes plans to move out of Ramsay Street. Des and Daphne are stuck in the claws of ruthless thieves.
Daphne is kidnapped and Des fears for her life as he is forced to open the safe.
Scott and Eileen rescue Daphne. Harold tells Madge that he intends to stay in Erinsborough. Shane has lost some money and accuses Henry of theft.
Henry assures Shane that he is innocent. Des receives some tragic news.
Des tells Mike that his father is dead. Shane finds some money and has to make an excuse. Mike makes plans to leave Ramsay Street.
Des and Daphne say goodbye to Mike. Madge offers Harold a place to stay, an offer he turns down. Instead he rents a room off Mrs Mangel.

Paul and Rosemary have to spend money to stop an article being printed. Jane realises that it was Mrs Mangel who spread the gossip, but is she going to tell Paul? Henry decides to try and sell Helen's early paintings.
Henry sells some paintings, but are they the correct ones?
Bouncer moves in with Des and Daphne. Jim tries to buy Helen's paintings back.
Jane threatens to tell Paul the truth unless Mrs Mangel gives the painting back to Helen. Des and Daphne welcome Mike back.
Paul needs help at the office, his old boss Gail Lewis applies for the job. Des and Daphne invite the Robinson's for dinner, but Jim and Des start fighting over who is the best.
Des and Jim's contest continues. Helen is eager to start work on Mrs Mangels portrait.
Daphne thinks that Des should ease up with his gym training, Paul employs Gail. Harold proposes to Madge.
The rivalry between Des and Jim escalates, with Scott and Mike getting involved. Madge makes a momentous decision.
Jane has to decide where her loyalties lie. Charlene, Jane, Madge and Mrs Mangel get involved in the sport competition.
Henry decides to run a book on the showdown between Des and Jim, whilst the other residents get in a competitive mood.
Paul suspects Mrs. Mangle about going to the Journalist and she begs for understanding, Jane tries to help as Mrs. Mangle tries to justify herself…Paul wants to know exactly what’s going on.
Henry owes people some money, after the relay race, resulting in a visitor at the Mitchell house.
Madge and Mrs Mangel continue their feud. Des and Jim encounter trouble during their race.

Des manages to find Jim, but with the phone and car vandalized, there is no way to get help. Jim tells Des to walk 10k through the bush, but he slips and lands in the river. Scott plays a prank on Charlene at the beach.
Jim gets rescued, but where is Des? Charlene gets revenge on Scott.
Daphne, Eileen and Mike anxiously await news of Des.
Des and Jim return home. Lassiters staff go on strike.
With the staff on strike, Paul's important convention looks set to be a disaster. Ramsay Street residents agree to help out.
Can Jane persuade Mrs Mangel to tell the truth? Will the convention be saved?
Mrs Mangel finally tells the truth, resulting in Lassiters staff going back to work. Scott plays an April fool on Jim.
Mrs Mangel and Jane come to an understanding. Harold and Madge get engaged. Charlene gets offered a job. Mrs Mangel gets her job back.
Charlene's new job is in Brisbane, will Scott let her leave? Daphne has a surprise visitor.
Madge isn't happy when she finds out Charlene didn't go to Brisbane, but they soon come to an understanding. Des has a drink with Daphne's father and ends up inviting him for dinner.
Harold buys Madge an engagement ring. Daphne refuses to see her Dad.
Daphne tells the truth about her father. Harold decides to behave like a parent towards Charlene and Henry.

Henry and Charlene are not happy about Harold interfering in their lives. Gail's father, Rob, is a mechanic and is looking for an investor. Jim is interested, but they need another one. Henry invites Jane to a party and tells her that he wants to date her again. But she reveals that she is in love with Mike.
Scott and Charlene come up with a plan to get Harold and Madge off their back. Mrs Mangel sees the portrait that Helen has painted of her.
Mrs Mangel does not like her portrait and is determined to stop Helen showing it in her exhibition. Henry gets the attention of an older woman.
Henry finds himself in trouble. Helen gets some disappointing news.
Helen decides that she doesn't want to paint anymore. Scott and Charlene's plan backfires. Daphne receives an unwelcome gift.
Rob gives Charlene a job in his garage, which Harold has agreed to invest in. Daphne visits her dad.
Charlene's situation with Warren gets more complicated, Daphne's dad comes for dinner, but it doesn't end well.
Scott tells Warren the truth about him and Charlene, making him very upset.
Scott tries to apologise to Charlene. Scott gets into an argument with Warren. Who is Henry's new girlfriend?
Henry's new girlfriend is revealed, Sue Parker. Has she got her act together? Paul has a a plan to make Helen paint again. Charlene decides to leave home.
Harold and Jim become partners with Rob at the garage. Paul enters Helen's picture into a competition.
Harold refuses to be a silent partner. Madge accepts Paul's offer, to allow Charlene to live in the caravan.
Sue Parker starts working at the bank. Helen finds out about Paul's secret plan.
Helen thinks that Paul should have asked her before sending her picture into a competition.. Charlene gets scared on her first night in the van.
Charlene searches for an intruder. Helen is being stubborn and refuses to forgive Paul.
Scott helps Helen to realise that Paul meant well. Gail's ex husband makes a surprise appearance.
Paul rents Clive's old house to Gail and Rob after they are evicted. Jeremy has a proposition for Rob.
After the caravan is trashed, Charlene thinks she knows who the prowler is. Gail is unhappy that her dad is helping to repair an old racing car, that usually brings bad luck.
Henry confesses to Charlene that he was the prowler. Harold makes a scene at the bucks party.
After Des refuses to give him money, Mike finds out about the fund his mum set up. Gail and Rob move onto Ramsay Street.
Madge takes Daphne to a doctor. Sue moves into the van with Charlene.
Daphne goes to hospital to get some rest. Paul wants to get into business with Mr Udagawa, but he needs a wife.
News of Paul and Gail's 'engagement' spreads. Mike comes to his senses.
Harold and Mrs Mangel accidentally get drunk. Gail agrees to go along with Paul's plan. Mike wants to buy a motorbike, causing concerns.
Harold and Mrs Mangel are found in a compromising position. The next day, they both have hangovers. Henry is accused of a crime.
Lucy returns from her trip to Europe, but she isn't happy. Where was Henry the night of the burglary?
Jim and Helen try to cheer up Lucy. Henry reveals where he was at the time of the break-in. Police arrive to search the Ramsay house.
Henry decides to leave home, but changes his mind after Madge apologises for not believing him. Lucy doesn't want to return to school.
Scott buys Charlene a ring. Lucy makes a decision about her future. A dangerous situation is developing at the caravan.
The spilled petrol causes the caravan to explode. Will Scott and Charlene get away in time?
Gail breaks off her 'engagement' to Paul. Scott and Charlene make plans to live together.
Henry and Sue break up. Mrs Mangel is suspicious of Gail and Jeremy.
Lucy hosts a party, but no-one shows up. Madge's attempt to get Harold, Jim and Rob to get along again, doesn't go well.
Erma apologises to Lucy. Madge loses the diamond from her ring. Jeremy tests the racing car.
Gail is devastated over Jeremy's death. Harold gets angry when he finds out about the diamond.

Gail discovers that Jeremy had a wife, when she comes looking for him. Charlene finds a sales job, and persuades Scott, Henry and Jane to invest in her idea. Paul comforts Gail and she tells him that the engagement is back on.
Jane makes a discovery about the polish they are selling. Jim decides to buy 'No. 13'.
Gail and Helen are not happy with Jim's decision to buy 'No 13'. Charlene, Scott, Henry and Jane discover that the company responsible for the polish, has gone.
Jim and Helen host a party to celebrate Gail and Paul's engagement. Scott reveals his plans to live with Charlene.
Madge and Jim are unhappy about Scott and Charlene's decision to move in together. Des and Daphne have a falling out.
Scott and Charlene go flat hunting. Scott puts his car on sale, then makes a stupid mistake.

Scott reports his stolen car to the police, but has no luck. Charlene finds Madge's diamond inside her trifle. Madge agrees to Scott moving in, despite Harold's objections. Madge and Harold have an argument by the lake.
Harold and Madge search Lassiter's lake for the ring. Mrs Mangel falls off a ladder whist helping out in Daphne's nursery.
Mrs Mangel is suffering from amnesia after her fall and seems to have forgotten the last 2 years. Scott gets himself a job.
Mrs Mangel has an embarrassing incident. Henry begins his search for Madge's ring. Harold moves into Lassiters. Scott pops the question to Charlene.
Scott and Charlene get engaged, but how will Jim react? Henry finds Madge's ring, with Lucy's help.
Scott and Jim are angry with each other. Madge tells Scott and Charlene they can live with her after the wedding.
Jim test drives 'No 13', then decides to sell it. Charlene finds her perfect wedding dress, but can she afford it? Scott and Jim resolve their differences at Anne's grave.
Lucy's keen to find out what bone she found at the lake. Paul gives Henry a Job. Jim gives Anne's necklace to Charlene.
Paul and Gail spring a surprise wedding on their families. Mrs Mangel mistakenly believes that her husband, Len, died.
Henry works hard through the night so he can surprise Charlene with a gift. Mrs Mangel starts talking to the Rose where she believes her husbands ashes are buried.
Daphne is upset that she wasn't invited to Paul and Gail's wedding. Mrs Mangel decides to sue Des and Daphne for her accident.
Mrs Mangel meets with a lawyer, leaving Des and Daphne worried that they could lose everything. Paul offers Madge a new job.
Mrs Mangel asks Harold to go to the church dance with her. The bone that Lucy found appears to be aboriginal.
Madge suggests to Mrs Mangel that she should cook a steak for Harold, knowing full well that he is a vegetarian. Jim's cousin Hilary arrives, 2 days early.

Paul, Des, Henry and Mike are planning Scotts stag night. Henry has an idea but Jim lets them know he does not like practical jokes. Later with the party in full swing Paul asks Scott to join him in the cellar for a toast.
Scott knows the plan and makes a run for it from the cellar and locks everyone in. There is lots of banging and shouting from Dan and Henry emerges in a chicken suit.
Dan does not see how a schoolboy can provide for his granddaughter. Hilary butts in and says at least Scott and Charlene are getting married instead of living out of wedlock like Dan and Edna.

Wedding plans are in full swing but will it be derailed with an outbreak of measles. Charlene reveals to Scott she has spots, Madge declares they may have to cancel the wedding. Scott kisses Charlene and says if you have measles then so do I, we are not calling off the wedding.

The big day has arrived…Scott is stressing out to Mike and Paul that Charlene might not turn up. As Scott looks round, he sees Charlene coming through the door on Henrys arm, dressed in a beautiful white dress and veil. Henry places the rings on the bible and Scott slips Charlene's ring on to her finger while Jane cries in the background.
Mrs Mangel is in love with Harold, and reacts badly when she discovers Harold doesn't feel the same. Harold discovers that Rob has a debt of $15,000 at the garage.
Hilary attempts to set Jim up with her friend, Beverley, before she leaves. Daphne tells Mrs Mangel the truth about Len.
Mrs Mangel gets her memory back and is furious at Jane for lying to her. Jim tries his best to avoid meeting Beverly. Mrs Mangel throws Jane out of the house.
Jane moves into the Robinson house. Rob makes a confession to Harold and Jim.
Rob finds himself in debt after gambling on horses. Paul agrees to lend him some money. Jim is rude to Beverly when she comes for dinner.

Harold decides to give up his share in the garage and dissolves the partnership. Henry wants to start his own lawn mowing business. Harold tells Madge he's leaving Erinsborough, but she begs him to stay.
Daphne searches for someone who can take over the Coffee Shop, until she has had the baby. Madge and Henry change their surname to Ramsay.
Harold offers to lend Henry some money for his lawnmower business. Harold agrees to take over the coffee shop for a while. Daphne suffers a fall after a mishap.
Daphne goes to hospital as a precaution. Mrs Mangel gets a fright, when Jane and Henry attempt to retrieve the liquid beauty bottles from her shed.
Harold takes over at the coffee shop, and immediately makes it vegetarian only. Lucy is devastated when she witnesses Paul kissing Crystal.

Lucy tries to avoid Gail after what she witnessed. Jim tells Rob that they have to sell the garage. Rob gets drunk and causes a scene in the Waterhole. Later, he goes to see Gail and ruins her and Paul's business dinner with Mr Udigawa.
Lucy forgives Paul after he gives her an explanation. Henry and Jane try to drum up business for his new lawnmower venture. Rob writes a letter for Gail, is he leaving town?
Gail arranges a meeting with Mr Udagawa. Helen contemplates taking a trip to the Bungle Bungles. Henry delivers Rob's letter to Gail, but is he too late?

Scott and Charlene return from their honeymoon to the news that Charlene has lost her apprenticeship. Mr Udigawa offers Paul a contract. Gail is worried about her fathers whereabouts. Paul offers to annul his marriage to Gail.
Henry reluctantly agrees to let Charlene help out in his business, in return for a 30% cut. Daphne hires Gino to help out in the coffee shop. Helen decides to go on her trip, but will she come back?
Mike returns from his trip and breaks up with Jane.
Daphne is angry with Harold when she finds out takings in the cafe have dropped significantly. Jane is struggling with her break up from Mike.
Henry helps Harold come up with a way to promote the cafe. Daphne decides to start selling meat again and has a themed week.
Lucy tricks Jim into going on a picnic with Beverley. The Italian food is a big hit in the cafe. Mrs Mangel makes a mistake in work.
Jim and Beverley bond during the picnic trip. Mike and Jane have a further falling out. Daphne goes into labour.
Daphne gives birth to a boy. Henry introduces his family to his new girlfriend, Melanie.
Des tries to find a name for the baby. Charlene tries to set Melanie up with Gino. Is there something wrong with the baby?

Des and Daphne are concerned about the health of their baby. They finally decide on a name for the newborn. Paul and Gail invite Scott and Charlene for dinner and they play a game for couples. Is Scott hiding something?
Scott and Charlene have a falling out over his secret. Daphne continues to be concerned about Jamie's welfare. Mike gets a surprise visitor.
Megan wants Mike to move in with her. Eileen is concerned about Mrs Mangel.
Jim and Beverly go on a date, much to Lucy's delight. Henry suffers another romantic setback. Mrs Mangel visits the doctor.
Jamie takes a turn for the worse. Beverly arrives with some news, is he going to be ok?
Des and Daphne get some good news. Mrs Mangel goes for a check up. Harold is excited to be getting a video player.
Harold and Henry help to apprehend an intruder in Mrs Mangels house. Daphne returns home, with Jamie. Mrs Mangel and Madge have a big fight on the street resulting in Mrs Mangel fainting.
Mrs Mangel is rushed to hospital after suffering a heart attack. Mike tells Des and Daphne about his plans to move out, but he doesn't go through with it. Helen returns from her trip.
Jane tries to contact her mother. Paul wants him and Gail to buy a house. Jane gets a visitor.
Jane's mother arrives in town. Harold pressure's Jane to move back into Mrs Mangels house. Paul surprises Gail by buying a house.
Jane moves back onto her Nan's house. Daphne is struggling to settle Jamie. Jane's mother is hiding a secret. Daphne and Eileen have a fight and Daphne tells her to leave.

Beverly offers Daphne some advice about Jamie. Beverly wants to buy Clive's surgery. Eileen has a fight with Charlene and Harold in the coffee shop, resulting in her leaving. Charlene buys a gift for Scott. Daphne feels like a failure.
Paul has plans to demolish the waterhole. Jane tries to make Mike jealous.
Helen inadvertently tells Rosemary about Paul's plans for the waterhole. Paul mistakenly blames Gail. Amanda and Charlene play a trick on the school caretaker in order to gain access to the school.

Helen sets Paul straight. Jim is interested in buying a workshop, which has been called 'a heap of junk'. Amanda invites Madge to lunch, but it ends in a big argument. Paul and Gail are still at odds.
Beverly gives some advice to Des and Daphne. Amanda gets an unwelcome visitor. Amanda enlists Scott and Henry for some help, before giving Jane some bad news.
Amanda agrees to stay, for now at least. Des and Daphne ask Mike to be Jamie's Godfather. Gail proposes some ideas to Rosemary. Gail asks Mike to help her make a promotional video.
Everyone is surprised by Jane's look. Gail and Mike begin to shoot the promotional video.. Amanda gets upset when her coat goes missing.
Amanda's coat is found. Eileen suffers from stage fright. Lucy is feeling out of sorts. Jane is desperate to make her mum happy. Beverly has an unexpected encounter.
Lucy is having trouble with her vision. Beverly tells Jim she would like them to take a break. Des and Daphne invite Beverly and Eileen for dinner. What is wrong with Lucy?
Lucy is rushed to hospital with a suspected brain tumor. Gail gets a surprise visitor,
Eileen's meddling in the coffee shop causes Harold to accidentally eat some meat.Lucy is very worried about her operation.
Mrs Mangel offers some words of wisdom to Lucy. Everyone waits for news of Lucy's operation. Jim spends the night at Beverley's house. Mike confronts Amanda.
Mrs Mangel returns home from hospital. Des gets caught having dinner with Amanda. Madge apologizes to Mrs Mangel.

Madge offers Daphne some advice about Des. Amanda has a falling out with her Mum and Daughter, resulting in her prompt departure from the street. Mrs Mangel plays a trick on Madge. Daphne agrees to spend some quality time with Des.

Madge invites Rob Lewis to dinner. When Harold pops in for a visit, the pair bicker. Lucy is upset about her potential partial paralysis, but a visit from her family gives her more hope. Scott and Charlene have money problems.
Charlene is offered her apprenticeship back, in Jim's new business. Scott considers leaving school to get a job. Lucy makes a new friend in hospital.
Mrs Mangel reveals that she used to read tea leaves, and swiftly takes it up again. She reads Harold's and Eileen's. Is love in the air?
Rosemary gives Gail a promotion. Mrs Mangel tries more fortune telling. Daphne returns to work, with Jamie in tow.
Someone calls the health inspector into the coffee shop. Gail and Paul are at odds. Lucy has a crush.
Des discovers who called the health department. Stephen and Jim fight for Beverly. .
Mike does the photo shoot of Lassiters, with Jane's help. Paul and Gail continue to be at odds. Beverley makes her choice.
Gail and Paul finally make up. Jim and Beverly go out for a meal. Scott and Charlene's insistence to pay their own way, causes frictions at home.
Jim,s new garage opens, and Charlene resumes her apprenticeship. Gail has an idea for a childcare centre. Harold and Eileen agree to go out, Eileen tries to make Madge jealous.
Lucy receives an upsetting letter. Harold is oblivious to Eileen's real intentions. Charlene is angry with Scott after he spends another evening in the pub. Rob contemplates moving away.

Paul is talking to Henry about the Waterhole renovations, he tells Henry the objective is to give the Waterhole a real outback feel. Des comes in and wants to talk about Jamie's christening. Paul jumps the gun, thinking Des was about to ask him to be Jamie's godfather. Madge is making baked beans for Henry's dinner so Scott and Charlene will not feel so left out.
Harold inadvertently puts on a porn movie for himself, Mrs Mangel and Eileen. Mrs Mangel plays a trick on Eileen. Following a chat with Jane, Henry decides to move out.
Harold is invited to join the church choir. An old flame of Gail's comes to town.
Jim and Beverly play a round of golf. Des and Daphne receive a mysterious gift. Paul borrows some of Rick's jokes.
Lucy gets her wires crossed, when she thinks she hears some bad news. Jamie's christening takes place, but who is the woman watching? Eileen is still worried that Harold may be a 'beast'.
Daphne's mother turns up, Daphne wants to know why? Jane becomes a poster girl. Mrs Mangel returns to work. Daphne invites her Mum to dinner.

Lucy returns home from hospital, excited to be spending some time with her Dad. Daphne is upset after finding out that her Dad blames her for the death of her brother. Des discovers some sad news, will he tell Daphne? Jim gets an urgent call from the office.

Paul offers his help and support, but Jim says there is nothing he can do, but Jim thanks Paul for offering. Rob heads off to see Gail at the office - apparently she and Paul are working late. Gail applauds Paul as she turns to face him, not saying anything. But Paul thinks he had every right to say that to Rob. Jim is steamed about Rob's behaviour - what does Rob think he's paying him for?

Madge tells Henry that the take was down by forty five dollars and Paul thinks Henry was in on Kenny with it. Kenny insists that Madge made a mistake, but Henry says that Madge is always very good with money. She tells Helen that on no account must she invite Harold for dinner - she might end up being the main course Helen says that Madge was only joking with her comments about Harold.
Harold discovers who started the rumours about him. Charlene buys a worn out, decrepit old car and vows to give it a makeover. Des tells Daphne about her father.
As a result of his humiliation, Harold decides to leave Erinsbourough. Mrs Mangel has a bad premonition from the tea leaves. Harold picks up his car from the garage before it has been fixed.

Harold is taken to hospital after the accident. Mrs Mangel vows to stop fortune telling. Mrs Mangel, Madge and Eileen agree to share looking after Harold whilst he recuperates, much to Harold's dismay. Paul speaks to Rob about his work etiquette.

Paul assures Charlene that she still has her job after Rob quits. Harold dislikes being treated like a child. Mike agrees to help Lucy with her school work. Charlene contemplates selling her wedding dress to raise some money.
Henry is concerned when he starts to lose customers. Daphne agrees to visit her Dad. Charlene finds Scott a tutor. Harold decides to move in with Des and Daphne. Rob decides to leave town.

Jane begins helping Scott with his maths. Henry discovers the reason his customers are leaving. Daphne contemplates an offer from her Dad. Harold is intent on leaving Erinsborough, even after a visit from the vicar.
Henry discovers who was writing the letters. Gail spends the day with Glen. Beverly manages to coerce Lucy out of the house. Henry gets into trouble with Paul after having a fight.
Helen witnesses a moment between Gail and Glen. Paul helps to convince the Neighbours that Henry is a reliable person. Paul overhears a conversation.
Charlene is concerned about how much time Scott is spending with Jane. Madge attempts to make peace with Harold. Daphne's dad is rushed to hospital, prompting a surprise decision by Daphne.
Harold apologises to Madge and they make up. Henry goes diving in an attempt to impress some one. Eileen declares shes moving in with Des, whilst Daphne is away. Mike moves into Mrs Mangles house.
Mrs Mangel is keeping a close eye on Mike. Daphne heads off to look after her Dad. Why is Sally so interested in Des?

Sally begins working in the coffee shop. Mike, Jane and Scott plan Charlene's 18th Birthday party. Gail hires a familiar looking mechanic for the garage. Paul takes Lucy to visit her horse. Paul is keen to take it out for a ride, despite not knowing how to ride one.

Rosemary offers Gail and Jane a work trip to the US. Charlene is increasingly concerned about Jane and Scott's friendship when they aren't where they said they would be. Paul recovers from his mishap on the horse.
It's Charlene's birthday, but she thinks no-one cares. Jane turns down the modelling opportunity in America. Everyone prepares for the surprise party.
Sally shows an uncommon interest in an old family album belonging to the Clarkes.
Gail heads off on her trip to the USA. Harold tells Mrs Mangel he'll consider moving back in when he's recovered. Des wants some answers from Sally.

Des discovers the truth about Sally, Scott draws a portrait of Jane. Henry catches Des and Sally alone. Mike reads Jane's diary and discovers a secret. Beverly brings Steven to her house after his accident.

Scott and Jane share a kiss, after her gives her the portrait he drew. Henry hints that he know someone is having an affair, making Charlene suspicious. Des wants Sally to move in. Charlene is furious when she finds out about the kiss, causing Scott to move out.
Jim arrives home to some unwelcome surprises.
Jane decides to take the trip to the USA. Harold asks for Henry's help, as he proposes to Madge again.
Mrs Mangel and Mike blame Scott for everything that's happened so far. Des and Sally confide their secret to Henry.
Henry and Helen have a plan to save Scott and Charlene's marriage. Henry persuades Eileen to let Sally stay with them.
Greg begins to act strangely. An unexpected house guest arrives on the Robinson doorstep.
Mrs Mangel makes a new friend. The Robinsons' new house guest begins to make 'waves' in Ramsay Street.
Lucy has a crush on Mike. Harold sets a new course for the future.
Harold decides it's time to 'think big and grow big' while Greg has an uncomfortable experience at the Clarkes. Sally has to answer an awkward question.
Gail's trip gets extended. Paul's temp turns out to be Melanie. Henry comes up with a scheme to help Sally. Gregg quits as Jim's mechanic after announcing some shocking news about himself.
Chrissie and Lucy jump to the wrong conclusion and cause a lot of trouble for Jim. Scott 's exams begin
A dreadful accident in Ramsay Street could ruin Scott's prospects. Scott and Charlene's talks aren't going well.
Harold asks Des for some advice after Madge tells him that she is not sure that she wants to get married. Eileen is on the wrong end of the phone at the wrong time - a recipe for disaster
Eileen feels betrayed and takes drastic action. Harold sweeps Madge off her feet.
Jane returns to Ramsay Street and issues an ultimatum to Charlene. Harold and Madge are forced to share a bed.
Harold and Madge spend the night together.. Scott and Charlene get back together. Charlene can't forgive Jane. Scott wants to start a family.
Scott and Charlene's momentous decision meets with mixed reactions. Sally has some devastating news for Henry.
Gail returns from America, but it isn't good news for Paul. Scott and Charlene agree to delay having a baby. Sally returns home to her mother.
Paul and Gail look set for a divorce. Harold and Madge set the date.

Mike moves back in with Des and Harold moves back in with Mrs Mangel. Mikes attempt to play a joke on Des and Pete backfires. Harold tries to persuade friends to invest in shares. Des gets a surprise at the the bank.
Des tries to prevent Eileen from seeing his Dad. Eileen and Nell join a lawn bowls team,
Jim hires a new mechanic. Des promises his Mum he will stay away from his Dad, but Sally returns in the hopes of finding him.
Henry and Tony have a fight, after Henry was pushed into the lake. Harold id concerned about how much interest Glen is showing in Jane. Scott and Charlene attempt to fix things between Gail and Paul.
Jane prepares to leave for New York, can her friends stop her?
Jane decides to stay, Paul offers Jane her job back. Harold dresses as Santa for a children's playgroup, which causes embarrassment for Madge later on. How has Beverley hurt herself?
Beverley tells Helen the truth. The garage hires a 'skilled amateur'. Sally continues the search for her father.
Sally finds her, and Des' dad. Scott has an idea to make a bit of money. Bouncer has a surprise for Mike.
Gail quits her job, but then Rosemary offers her an opportunity. Scott takes the photo of the Ramsay family for the calendar. Mikes puppies cause mayhem at home. Eileen has a meeting with Malcolm.
Mike tries his best to give away the puppies, but to no avail. Jim makes a move on Beverly and pops the question.
Jim and Beverly celebrate their engagement. Paul and Gail tell the truth about their marriage. Lassiters gets ready for reopening. Paul admits his true feelings about Gail
Mike continues his attempts to sell the puppies. Paul and Gail get back together.

Glen tries to worm his way into Jane's life, and he easily wins her. Gail and Paul go on their honeymoon, and Harold refuses to sell his stocks. The cosmetic company that Jane is supposed to model for, tells her they intend taking her to court if she doesn't show up for the American modelling assignment in a week's time.

Paul helps Jane get out of her modelling contract, and Sally decides to stay in Erinsborough. Eileen is doing a very good job looking after her ex-husband. While out on a shoot Scott, Mike and Jane get stuck in the middle of the sea. Malcolm tells Eileen why he left her.

Scott goes missing after trying to swim ashore, and his father blames Mike and Jane for not trying to stop him. Harold loses all his shares on the Stock Exchange, so he decides to call the wedding off which leaves Madge in tears.

Charlene fears that Scott has drowned, while Eileen begins to accept that Malcolm is living with them. Scott is found alive to everyone's relief, especially Charlene who faints when she hears the news. Eileen seems to be falling in love with her ex-husband again, but Malcolm is back on his feet again ready to go back to his house.

Scott returns home and learns that he has passed his exams. Glen is very disappointed when Mrs Mangel tells him what she thinks of his relationship with Jane. Madge Ramsay wins a car in a raffle and she is over the moon. Glen breaks up with Jane, and Lucy starts kissing - adultly!

Charlene gets a rash. Helen and Madge have a heated argument over household duties and their children's upbringing. The plant that Lucy brought as a gift for Charlene turns out to be poisonous. Madge doesn't have a drivers licence, but Henry promises to help her. Gail gets frightened when Paul tells her he wants children, as she believes she can't have babies.

Beverly tells Gail that she can't have children. Gail goes to see Ben for a second opinion and he refers her to a gynaecologist. She comes back highly disappointed about the diagnosis and she decides that the best thing to do is not to tell her husband. Henry becomes friends with Tony.

After receiving Tony's letter with Jane's photo, Mrs Romeo goes to Erinsborough to congratulate her son personally. Paul is disappointed when Gail tells him about her infertility. Eileen and Malcolm slowly fall in love again, while Mike and Jane also get back together.

Madge sets the record straight with Helen. Elinora meets Jane - Tony's 'fiancé' - at the coffee shop. Madge tries to talk Harold into selling the car so that he can afford to continue with the wedding, but Harold doesn't want to hear a word.

Jane and Sally confront Tony at the garage after explaining the situation to his mother, and feel quite relieved. Tony tells his mother the truth. Scott wants to write an article about immigrants, and Malcolm asks Eileen to marry him again.

Malcolm proposes to Eileen and when she accepts, Des is over the moon about the news. Henry tries to teach Madge how to drive, but her driving lesson ends up in disaster after an unfortunate encounter with a fire hydrant.

Madge asks Helen if she would tech her how to drive. Jim and Henry join the other boys in the card game, which leaves only Harold with the girls. After eating, they all play a game of scrabble, resulting in a big argument.

Everyone is getting on each other's nerves, and so Helen tries to calm the situation. Paul and Gail decide to go on with the invitro-fertilisation programme. Helen gives Madge driving lessons, and as usual they end up screaming at each other when Madge accuses Helen of being too fussy.
Helen reads the riot act to Madge, Harold, Henry and Lucy. Madge and Helen make up, but decide its best if Henry and Madge move back home. Scott and Charlene are in for a shock at breakfast time.
Harold agrees to marry Madge as soon as possible. Mrs Mangel tries to persuade Eileen not to get married. Scott's hopes are dashed.
Sally agrees to stay. Scott gets some exciting news. Sally bags herself a job. Where is Mike and Jamie?
Eileen over reacts when Mike and Jamie are not at home. Lucy starts high school. Eileen ponders if she is getting married too soon after a conversation with Helen. Helen drops a bombshell.
Helen remains determined to get her own flat. Scott agrees to work for Henry. Gail discovers a shocking truth.
Paul tries to track down Rob. Eileen is determined to have Mrs Mangel at her wedding. There's a disagreement over the honeymoon destination.
Gail and Rob make up. Malcolm has a last minute change of heart.
Malcolm calls the wedding off. Scott and Henry acquire another business.
Sally ropes in some friends to help decorate the flat. Helen finds a flat to rent, but is it haunted? Henry suffers an accident whilst using gym equipment.
Henry's injury means Scott has to do all the gardening work by himself. Scott and Paul play a trick on Jim. Jim is hopefuil that everything will go to plan with the wedding.
Jim and Beverley get married. Paul and Gail renew their vows. Todd and Katie run away.
Scott and Charlene find the kids safe and sound. Beverly offers to look after Todd and Katie for a while. Is Helen's new flat haunted?
Hilary gets spooked by Helen's flat and decides to leave. Eileen is still struggling with Malcolm's departure.
Madge has another mishap whilst learning to drive. Madge sells her car but thinks she was scammed.
Scott is struggling with the amount of work he has to do. Henry makes a move on Sally.
Beverley tells Scott to take a break. Beverly takes Katie on a shopping spree. Whats happened to Jim's lunch? There's a thief in the coffee shop.
Jim and Beverly have a chat with Todd and Katie about their home life. Bouncer causes trouble in Mrs Mangels garden. Todd's attempts to apologise to Harold, does not go well.
Helen asks Eileen for some help. Mrs Mangel gets a plan, but ends up getting a scare. Jim and Beverly agree to take a trip to Adelaide.
The mystery of the ghost is revealed. Harold's newspaper article does not go down well with Mike (or anyone else) Eileen is left in charge of Jamie, but can she be trusted?
Eileen struggles without her pills. Tony and Sally turn competitive and try to outdo each other.
Eileen heads to the medical centre to get some more pills. Paul has a bet with Gail. Jim and Beverly agree to look after Todd and Katie for longer.
Jane hosts a party for Mike at Mrs Mangels house. Henry and Charlene have an idea, to hopefully make Harold bring the wedding forward.
Beverley's attempt to cook a big family meal ends in disaster. Eileen returns to her former self. Mike leaves for his trip.
Scott, Henry and Charlene continue in their attempts to make Harold jealous. Eileen agrees to help Beverley with her cooking.
Charlene finds a valuable coin. Madge issues Harold with an ultimatum, before heading to Brisbane to visit her parents.
Harold pulls a sickie. Henry inadvertently gives Charlene's coin to Katie.
The hunt is on for the missing coin. Daphne's dad passes away. Helen scrambles to get invites out on time.

Mrs Mangel refuses to give the coin back to Charlene. Charlene arranges to return the coin to its original owner, and gets a surprise in return Katie is getting picked on in school, until Henry interjects.
Henry rescues Katie and prevents an accident. The funeral of Daphne's Dad takes place. Todd tries to prove that he can be trusted. Helen and Beverly come across a car crash, who's involved?
Daphne is badly injured in an accident. Will she pull through?
Mrs Mangel offers to look after bouncer. Jane teaches Tony a lesson. Beverley hears some upsetting news from the hospital .
Helen learns that Frank is on his way. Beverley suggests hypnotherapy to Gail, in a bid to help her remember the registration number.
Jim hosts a farewell dinner for Lucy, before she goes to boarding school. Beverly gets a little extra help with the food.
