Not happy with being confronted, she snaps and just as quickly apologises, thereby confirming Karl's suspicions before she beats a hasty retreat.

Vanessa and Lauren learn they have a new boss at Harold's, Steph Scully (who's just been released from jail), but Steph gets a bigger surprise when she learns that Lucas, her ex-boyfriend, has set up house with Vanessa and they have a baby together. Vanessa is worried when she learns that Lucas and Steph were still together and very much in love before Steph went to jail.

After Steph drops around with a present for Patrick, Vanessa's convinced she's genuinely trying to turn her life around, but Sonya's slightly protective of Lucas and Vanessa's relationship. Meanwhile, Steph visits Lucas at the Garage and he offers to take her for a ride on his motorbike. When they return Lucas realises he's late for his appointment. He races off, leaving Steph to close up.

Lucas steels himself to receive the results of his scan for testicular cancer. Keeping the truth from Vanessa, he turns to Steph for support. Both Lucas and Steph are relieved when Lucas receives the best possible prognosis – the cancer hasn't spread – Lucas will make a full recovery. Relieved, Lucas goes to tell Vanessa, not realising she has discovered the engagement ring he's kept hidden.

Hurting too much to tell Sonya about Steph's claim he's responsible for her prison sentence, Toadie feels the pressure of Sonya's hopes he will go into private practice with Ajay. But when he tells Ajay the truth, explaining he doesn't want to take personal responsibility for his friends' lives again, Ajay suggests the best way to overcome his guilt might be to keep helping people.

Paul finds out about Mason's criminal past and threatens to expose it if Mason doesn't stay away from Kate. But as Mason wrestles with his conscience over the cost of keeping family secrets, he discovers Paul in a compromising position and uses it to his advantage, making Paul assure him he won't reveal his secret. Mason, however, is still troubled by his past and chooses to tell Kate the truth.

Mason's pleasantly surprised when Kate accepts his criminal past and even more pleased when she finally asks him out on a date. But Kate's left furious when she learns Paul threatened Mason. She confronts her uncle, ordering him to stay out of her business, and stay quiet about Mason's past. But Mason feels the burden of his own dishonesty.

Vanessa admits that she knows Lucas told Steph about his cancer before he told her. Lucas apologises and assures her he didn't mean anything by it, but Vanessa confides in Sonya, admitting she still feels uneasy about it. She confesses that she's partly concerned because she discovered the engagement ring but there's been no proposal.

Having sworn off social media, Amber's got no idea what Cassie's been tweeting about her. She dreads going to school, knowing the entire school is identifying themselves as either Team Cassie or Team Amber by the colour of the ribbon in their hair. She gets the shock of her life when she arrives at school to find that every student is on Team Amber.

Amber's shocked to learn that Cassie has been reported missing by her parents after not coming home for the night. She's deeply concerned that Cassie may have done something foolish as a result of their Twitter war. Kate encourages the students to be responsible for their on-line activities and offers them strategies for dealing with cyber bullies.

Kyle is gutted when Georgia insists she's too embarrassed to attend the ball while she's being investigated over the missing drugs. Egged on by Rhiannon not to give up so easily, Kyle creates a mini-ball in his living room to cheer Georgia up. Kyle and Georgia share their first kiss. But their romance comes to screeching halt when Toadie arrives with bad news – Georgia's been fired.

Seeing Sonya struggle to remember their wedding day, Toadie comes up with a plan to beat her amnesia and enlists Georgia's help to pull it off. While Georgia takes care of the intriguing preparations, Toadie comes to a new understanding of how tough it is for Steph to be separated from her children. He offers to help get access to them. It looks like their friendship may be salvaged.

Romance is in the air as Toadie prepares for Sonya's surprise wedding. Sonya however has plans to shovel compost for the day and it's a challenge for Georgia to convince her to take a shower without giving away the surprise. When Sonya arrives she is delighted to see her closest friends and family waiting to celebrate the marriage. The ceremony is beautiful and goes off without a hitch.

After Sonya regains her memory, she struggles with the idea of reporting Mason to the police. Toadie convinces her it's the right thing to do and Mason is arrested as a result. Mason refuses to implicate Robbo, even when Matt pleads for him to protect himself. Bailey, wanting to protect Matt, reveals his involvement in the Mt. Isa break-in which in turn leads Matt to spill the beans.

All three Turner men are now in trouble with the law, especially Mason. After being bailed out, Mason is unable to contact Kate and fears he's lost her. His attempts to talk to her fail, and to make matters worse, Paul takes her off the street to live at Lassiters Hotel until the renovations at the Robinson House are complete.

In the wake of the police charges, Amber's birthday is ruined. With Amber refusing to go to school, Bailey heads there on his own, eager to distract himself from the tension at home. But he hadn't counted on the gossip of fellow students – and when Alister pushes him too far, Bailey lets loose with violence. Meanwhile, Matt learns that he has been officially suspended from his job.

Lucy has arrived back in Erinsborough, in the capacity of head honcho of the entire Lassiters chain. She doesn't like what Paul's doing, professionally or personally, and is in town to make some changes. She confronts Paul about the corruption allegations, but he insists it's all a misunderstanding and he's being set up. Desperate to get on the front foot, Paul approaches Hotel Manager Tony.

Hoping to distract herself from bigger problems, Steph keeps busy with housework, her café renovations, and by helping out at the garage. While Karl successfully gets her to open up about missing Charlie, Steph keeps her longing for Lucas a secret. When inspecting the new garage set-up, Steph inadvertently stumbles across Lucas's hidden stash of the men's magazine containing Vanessa topless.

Steph discovers Lucas doesn't know about Vanessa's ex-husband. Lauren inadvertently gives her the idea to create a fake Facebook account as Vanessa's ex. She sends a message to Lucas, who assumes it was sent to him accidentally. However when he tells Vanessa, she admits that she was married. Vanessa later explains that it happened when she was only twenty; the two of them eloped to Albania.

Vanessa pleads with Lucas to reconsider calling off the wedding but he can't shake the fear that he would only be second best. He can't understand why she would keep such a secret from him, while Vanessa starts to wonder whether he's just looking for an excuse to break up with her so he can be with Steph. When Sonya has a go at Steph about it, a tearful Steph rushes to Lucas.

Kate tells Paul that she's moving into Number Twenty-Six causing more tension between them. Lucy tells Paul that they have to make finding a replacement hotel manager a priority and that she has a candidate in mind. When Paul learns who it is, he wonders if it won't open a few old emotional wounds, but she assures him she's sussed out Lauren and is confident there won't be any problems.

As Amber's friendship with Chris develops, she misreads the signals and thinks she's got a chance to be with him. However when Chris accepts a date with hot new guy Seamus, Amber sets about stopping them from having a good time. Despite her best efforts, she's shattered to discover Chris really likes Seamus.

Amber's guilt is piqued when she sees Chris's disappointment over missing his chance with Seamus. Prompted by Georgia, she confesses to being the one who sabotaged his date. Chris is unforgiving and annoyed at Amber interfering in his personal life. Amber upset, returns home and runs into Lou, who has been talking with Sheila. Lou is concerned that Amber has feelings for Chris.

Enjoying a meal with Kate, Paul is in an uncharacteristically jovial mood, revealing he has won Council approval for the Lassiters development. Kate is pleased, despite knowing Lucy had a hand in it. Mason shows up, which sours Paul's mood but he makes the effort for Kate's sake - inviting Mason to join them. The next day, Mason discovers the legal fees for his hearing will be expensive.

Steph convinces Lucas to go away with her on a camping trip to watch the eclipse. As they pack for the trip Vanessa returns home from seeing her mother and is less than impressed to find Steph and Lucas packing to go away together. Steph moves off to collect supplies for the trip while Vanessa and Lucas have it out. After deciding they want to fight for their relationship.
Ramsay Street gathers in three separate locations to watch the solar eclipse – a rare astronomical event which foreshadows changes to the lives of everyone in the street.

Having found Patrick's pram empty, Vanessa and Lucas raise the alarm and Matt swings into action. Matt quickly ascertains that Steph is responsible for the kidnapping, after he meets new family, the Willis's. Things only become more dire when Toadie informs him that Steph is off her meds. Vanessa grows more and more worried as time ticks by with no sign of her baby boy.

Lucas is frantic after receiving a phone call from Steph – she's given no clue of where she is, and now she's switched her phone off. Vanessa's anxiety reaches breaking point as she angrily tells Lucas this is all his fault for bringing Steph into their lives. Vanessa later confides to Sonya that she's not sure she'll ever be able to forgive Lucas if they don't get Patrick back safely.

Lucas is forced to participate in Steph's delusion that Patrick is her son Adam, in order to get his baby away from her. Convincing Steph that he still loves her, Lucas finally convinces Steph to put the baby down, allowing him to rescue Patrick while Matt takes Steph into custody. Lucas, Vanessa and baby Patrick are reunited. Lucas apologises to Vanessa for not believing the warnings.

Kate tries to convince herself she imagined seeing Mark Brennan during the eclipse, but she can't shake the feeling it was real – even when it starts causing problems for her and Mason. Needing to put the idea to rest, Kate searches for an explanation, asking Toadie for help. Toadie finds out Wes Holland – the main threat to Brennan's life – has recently been killed.

Kate's floored when Brennan reveals the truth about his ‘death' two years ago. Although she maintains she's with Mason now, Kate can't help but be drawn to Brennan in her need for closure. When Mason discovers that Kate's ex is back from the dead, he stakes his claim over her and almost gets physical with Brennan.

Brennan reveals to Kate that he still loves her and despite her protests, he knows she still has feelings for him too. He needs an answer; will she get back together with him? Kate is rattled and, buying herself time, turns to others for advice. Georgia is very much pro Mason and thinks he and Kate are good together. Paul, however, insists that Brennan's the right man for Kate.

Shattered Kate unloads on Paul about her break-up with Mason, and lets it slip that Brennan kissed her. But she makes it clear that she's determined to win Mason back. Meanwhile, Mason starts to have second thoughts about his decision after Lauren makes him realise he's being immature. But when Paul tells him about the kiss, Mason's gutted.

Rani rewrites the play so that fictional Rani chooses Sanjay (Callum) instead of Raj (Bailey). Callum is delighted by the change, but Sonya is surprised. Having witnessed Rani and Bailey's kiss, she can't help but wonder what's going on. Worried for her boy, she approaches Ajay to try to ascertain Rani's state of mind. But Ajay misinterprets Sonya's concerns.

The Turners prepare for Mason's impending sentencing hearing. Appearing to be on their side, Paul assures them Tim Collins has all bases covered - his loyal receptionist, Caroline Perkins, has agreed to supply a written victim impact statement which will make any gaol time highly unlikely. But Matt sees the flaws in their plan and shares his concerns with Toadie.

Paul makes it clear that he thinks Mason is crazy to replace Tim Collins with Toadie and Ajay for the hearing. But secretly, he's not worried – he's convinced they can't put together a viable case in such a short time. Toadie however leverages Paul to give a statement of support for Mason which, along with one from Caroline, helps Mason get off with a good behaviour bond and community service.

Kyle and Georgia head off to the hospital fundraiser, Kyle having insisted he's perfectly capable of attending, blind or not. But after he learns Chris has been lying to him about how much work pressure he's been under, Kyle feels bad. His mood deteriorates even further when Georgia makes a speech about how much she loves taking care of others in need. Essentially, he feels useless.

Having slept at the Men's Shed, Kyle turns up safe and sound, much to everyone's relief. But Georgia's relief quickly turns to anger. She lashes out at Kyle for hiding out and causing them all so much stress. Kyle retreats to his room. Later, Georgia goes to Kyle in a conciliatory mood but Kyle's admits he's sick of being mothered.

Having slept together, Kate and Kyle reel. Kate is overwhelmed with guilt, and while Kyle too feels guilty, he feels like he needs to tell Georgia what happened. Meanwhile, Georgia feels bad about her fight with Kyle and wants him to take her back. Kate demands Kyle do so and never mention what happened, but Kyle doesn't relent.

Rani tries to apologise to Callum again but he doesn't want to listen – and he quits the play, which is due to be performed today. Rani's gutted, and tries to find a way to convince Callum that she genuinely wants him back in her life. She decides to rewrite the vital scene of the play, and with Ajay's help comes up with something from the heart.

Terese catches Caroline leaving her post at work and says if she makes another mistake she'll be fired. Caroline complains about this to Paul who assures her he'll take care of it, putting his hand on her leg – something Sheila witnesses. Caroline then turns up to work drunk and Terese sacks her on the spot. Paul is furious when he finds out what Terese has done but she is unapologetic.

Having been informed of Caroline's allegations of sexual harassment against him, Paul goes on the attack, blaming Terese for aggravating the situation by firing Caroline. When he finds out that Toadie has been asking Sheila questions about Caroline's claims he reads the riot act to her and other Lassiters staff. Toadie asks Sheila to be a witness is the case but Sheila is afraid.

Kyle is back from Frankston, having been dropped off by Honga. Chris is surprised to see him, and explains he's missed Georgia, who has gone to Frankston to find him. Chris has a go at Kyle, saying he shouldn't have disappeared for three days and ignored their calls. Chris tells Kyle to call Georgia, but he says he needs to see Kate first.

Toadie and Ajay tell Caroline that Paul won't settle and they'll have to take her case to court. She approaches Paul and tries to blackmail him – if he gives her a cash settlement she'll make it go away. But he thinks she doesn't want to be seen as a liar on the stand and is grasping at straws. Terese tells him to keep away from Caroline, and his cocky attitude annoys her.

With the first day as the new owner of Harold's Store under way, Lauren is thrown when she and Vanessa discover there's no power in the kitchen. Lauren is rocked when the full extent of the damage is revealed – the kitchen will need to be rewired. Too devastated to tell Matt, Vanessa steps in and loans her the money for the repairs. When Lucas lets slip to Matt about the problem.

Brad reels as the reality of Joshua's desire to change coaches hits home. He refuses to allow the change, sure Joshua's making the wrong decision. Terese takes a more considered approach, listening to Don's plans for Joshua, and to Joshua's reasons for wanting to change coaches, before urging Brad to reconsider.

Sonya is rattled to learn that Walter, a new man in town, is in fact her Uncle. Having believed for years that all her blood relatives are dead, it's a lot to get used to. But as Walter shares stories and photos of Sonya's childhood, strong, long-forgotten memories are evoked and Sonya is delighted. Toadie urges caution, reminding Sonya that Walter is still a stranger.

Bailey is rushed to the hospital having knocked his head and fallen into the pool after being shoved by Callum. As Callum waits for news of Bailey he tries to apologise to Rani for what happened but she's still too angry to speak to him. Ajay thinks the situation has gotten out of control and Toadie is concerned that Callum could be held accountable if Bailey's condition is serious.

Terese makes Paul attend the sexual harassment workshop she is running, despite the fact the Hotel Ratings Inspector is coming tomorrow. At the workshop, Sheila embarrasses Paul during a role playing exercise, though he blames Terese. Meanwhile, Imogen is surprised to learn about her dad and Lauren's history. She questions Brad, who is honest. Imogen recalls the time her parents split up.

Brad is kicking himself. Having accused Paul of making a move on Terese, he works hard to make amends. Not that he can fix the damage he's done to Lassiters – because of his outburst, the hotel has lost their chance to regain their five-star rating. Terese isn't happy, but she can deal with it – what she can't deal with is Brad's insecurity.

In the wake of her return to Erinsborough, Kate is bailed up by Georgia, who is armed with the story Kate gave Mason about her "one-night stand". Georgia jumps to the conclusion that the other man is Brennan and put on the spot, Kate doesn't correct her. The lie immediately begins to snowball as Georgia assumes a romantic triangle is now in play between Kate, Mason and Brennan.

Toadie's concerned by the amount of time and effort Sonya is investing in Walter. He holds back from saying anything, until his romantic lunch with Sonya is gate-crashed: Sonya has invited Walter, Susan and Karl, eager for them all to meet. Toadie's frustrated and Walter senses the tension, so excuses himself. Sonya's annoyed at Toadie, but Toadie may have good reason to be wary of Walter.

While Toadie's busy trying to make up for being rude to Sonya's Uncle Walter at lunch, the man in question is busy pawning the watch he stole from Susan and chatting up Sheila – with none of them any the wiser about this con man's true character. After Toadie apologises to Walter and begs him to stay in town longer to make Sonya happy, Walter helps himself to the key to the Men's Shed.

Kate and Mason are happy to be back together, and wanting to strengthen their relationship, Kate suggests a family dinner. Both Lauren and Mason know their family – especially Matt – spending time with Paul is a potential recipe for disaster. But they agree to try and make it work. Paul is more than reluctant to dine with the Turners as well, but accepts for Kate's sake.

Amber's keen to spend time with Josh, and offers to accompany him to training so she can watch. Josh – who doesn't want his coach Don to know that he and Amber are still together – quickly fobs Amber off, telling her that it would be too distracting to have her there. Imogen tries to warn Amber that Josh will hardly ever have time for her, but Amber remains convinced they'll be fine.

As Mason, Kate and their friends gather for a movie night, Mason catches Kate hiding one of the DVDs Georgia's suggested. Suspicious, he checks with Chris and realises it's about a couple struggling to overcome one of them having a one-night stand. Mason realises why Kate hid it – her own one-night-stand is playing on her mind. And now he can't stop thinking about it either.

Sonya is thrilled to have Walter living with her, and enjoys bonding with him over stories of the past. But when Walter's presence encourages Sonya to reach out to her Aunt Robyn, she learns Walter is a life-long alcoholic, and that he never tried for custody of her and Jade when their parents died, as he'd previously claimed. Hurt and confused, Sonya confronts Walter who apologises.

Sonya's fears that Walter has fallen off the wagon are proven right when Lucas catches him in the Men's Shed with beer and assumes he's drinking. Walter goes along with the back-story he's been forced to inherit and confesses to her, and Sonya is relieved he has reached out to her. She vows to help him and suggests they attend an AA meeting together.

Kate and Kyle find themselves thrust together yet again, this time as models in a wedding shoot to promote Lassiters as a honeymoon destination. When Paul unwittingly forces Kate and Kyle into an awkward kiss, they're forced to confront their guilt once again. Determined to move on, Kyle meets up with Georgia for a night of romance in the Lassiters honeymoon suite.

Brad watches Don train Joshua, on the lookout for anything dodgy. Joshua accuses Brad of checking up on him, and wishes he could just accept that Don is now his coach. But when Brad tentatively suggests that Don may be under-timing Joshua to make it look like he's improving, Joshua flares up, banning Brad from his training sessions.

Hudson is annoyed when he learns Chris has told Josh about Don's deception. He warns Chris to stay out of his business, but later has a change of heart. The pair spend some downtime together and it seems they're reconciling, until the night takes a dramatic turn. For the second time that day, Hudson experiences severe chest pain. Ignoring Hudson's insistence that it's nothing.

Walter continues to keep up the charade to Sonya and family, though he nearly comes unstuck when he finds himself standing up at an AA meeting and sharing his life story. Later, enjoying a secret beer at the men's shed, he's busted by Toadie, who's worried about the influence Walter will have on Sonya. Walter says all the right things and reluctantly Toadie agrees to allow the setback.

Kyle runs into Walter at the bus stop and tries to convince him to at least say goodbye. Feeling pressured, Walter scarpers, leaving Kyle to go home and pass on the bad news to his Gran and Sonya. Sheila brave faces it, claiming she doesn't care, but Sonya is hurt and bewildered that he'd go after all their bonding.

In the wake of Walter's con job, Sonya is feeling vulnerable and Toadie is concerned about the level of distress for the family. His fears are confirmed when Sonya flees an AA meeting, unable to be truthful about her conman "uncle". She admits to a worried Toadie the pressure is building inside her – she is close to busting, looking for ways to escape the emptiness and turmoil inside.

In the wake of the news about his grandmother, Ajay goes to Karl and Susan to ask them to take Rani in. For Susan and Karl, this raises a serious question about just how they're going to maintain their newly found freedom as empty-nesters. Meanwhile, Rani struggles to understand why Ajay won't take her to India. She confronts Ajay, correctly guessing that he is trying to protect her by leaving.

Karl reels after receiving word that his daughter Holly is coming from the UK to stay with them. He is nervous - he hasn't seen Holly for a while. But Susan is reassuring, promising Karl that Holly will settle in in no time. When Holly arrives, initially Karl's fears are allayed – Holly seems as cute as a button.

Following Holly's arrival, Karl's on cloud nine and so it is with some reluctance that Susan brings him down to earth when she reveals Holly's hostility towards her. Karl can only conclude she's suffering jetlag or she's feeling displaced being so far away from home. But Susan's attempts to break the ice are met with serious attitude from Holly.

Amber is thrown to discover that Robbo doesn't know about Mason's arrest or the warrant that's out for his own arrest. She keeps the news of Robbo's presence from her father but tells Mason, and after they anonymously call the police, Robbo is soon arrested. Robbo surprises everyone however when he pleads not guilty and gets bail the same day.

Kyle's rocked by Kate's news she thinks she's pregnant. But when two pregnancy tests both show negative, Kyle's hopeful the crisis is over. Kate though is not so sure – she's certain she can feel changes in her body. When she has a dizzy spell in front of Georgia, Kate's forced to come clean about her fears. Georgia convinces her to get tested by a doctor in order to be certain.

Toadie convinces Sonya to report Robbo's intimidation to the police but she is scared by the prospect he may return, even trying to stop Callum going next door to hang out with Bailey while he baby-sits Holly. Callum worries for his mum but thinks she's over-reacting, until Bailey tells him that Sonya is right to worry. Robbo is a persistent creep who never gives up until he gets what he wants.

Kate reels from the news that she has Premature Ovarian Failure, and when Karl explains that it is unlikely she will be able to have children, she's devastated – keeping the news to herself. When she cancels on Paul's house-warming, Mason is concerned and asks if she's okay. But Kate is not ready to talk to anybody. Although she does let her guard down with Kyle, and finds herself crying.

Embarrassed after she broke down in front of Kyle, Kate backtracks and tries to convince him she's fine. But concerned Kyle passes his worries on to Sheila, whose mothering influence moves Kate to open up. Determined to move on and have a normal day now that Sheila's in her corner, Kate faces the wrath of Paul for cancelling on his dinner last minute.

Kicking himself for over-reacting and jumping to the wrong conclusion, Chris apologises to Hudson for blowing up at him. Hudson is calm and upfront, admitting that he's having trouble getting balance in his life, and Chris lets down his guard enough to offer friendship. But when Chris finds himself defending Hudson to a righteous Josh, he starts to realise that perhaps his feelings run deeper.

Still coming to terms with her diagnosis, Kate chooses to keep Mason at arms length. Tired of feeling like he's in a one-sided relationship, frustrated Mason gives his girlfriend all the space she needs - without telling her he's just spent the night discussing their relationship with Imogen. Learning Kate's upset, concerned Georgia finally coaxes the truth from her best friend.

Sonya freaks out as she is sure someone has snatched Nell. Vanessa comes to her aid as Sheila wheels Nell in her pram from around the corner. Sonya insists on calling the police as she knows Robbo took her baby to rattle her. Matt and Toadie are called. Sonya feels like no-one believes her. Toadie assures her he does. However, since no-one saw Robbo there is no solid proof.

Mason's still hot under the collar following Robbo's uninvited arrival at last night's Bite Club and wants to sort the guy out. Lauren encourages Mason to leave it – he's playing right into Robbo's hands if he gets involved, and besides, Mason's got more to worry about – namely, his first day of work at Lassiters. Paul, meanwhile, alludes to the fact that he's got his own plan for Rob.

Vanessa and Lucas reel following the discovery that they are expecting another baby. Vanessa worries that with Lucas already under so much financial pressure, another mouth to feed will be too much – but Lucas is quick to assure her that he sees her pregnancy as a blessing. Vanessa initially hides her pregnancy from Lauren, knowing how desperate Lauren is to have another child.

Paul learns about Kate's premature ovarian failure and is surprisingly sensitive. Pained to see her distress, he immediately starts looking for ways to offer concrete assistance. Without consulting Kate, he buys the share house and has the broken hot water system promptly repaired. Paul expects Kate will be grateful to live rent free in a well maintained house but she's furious.

Susan has a hunch that Holly isn't as happy about staying in Erinsborough as she's making out. Lauren tries to get through to her but Holly refuses to open up. Susan tries every trick in the book but Holly remains upbeat until Susan forces the issue and Holly finally fesses up. She wants to go home to Izzy but is sure Karl will hate her for leaving.

Amber denies to Bailey that she's reconnecting with Robbo, despite the fact he saw her hanging out with him. Torn, Amber confides in Imogen, trying to explain that she sees good in Robbo still, but Imogen's take is clear – Robbo's bad, and Amber should stay away from him. When Amber receives a text from Robbo, Bailey becomes suspicious and grabs his sister's phone to confirm as much.

Instantly regretting what she's done, Amber wants to ensure that Robbo is going to the police station to change his plea. Robbo promises he will, but later betrays her. A worried Imogen urges Amber to call an end to their relationship once and for all – and Amber finally does. But there's a sting in the tail – Robbo has video footage of Amber that he plans to use to blackmail Mason.

Mason's desperate to find out whether Robbo's claims are true, so he confronts Amber and asks her whether she's still seeing Robbo. Amber's forced to lie, and Mason's relieved. But when Mason refuses to give Robbo his money, he gives Mason proof of the video's existence. Gutted, Mason turns to Paul for help, who in turn enlists Marty to find ammo and get Robbo out of town.

With news of Paul's sponsorship offer to Hudson, tensions run high in the Willis family. Terese is concerned it could come back to bite Lassiters; Brad's desperate to make it happen; Josh hates that Hudson keeps getting second chances; and Imogen is feeling on the outer. Susan notes this when she drops over in the middle of a heated debate.

Through Imogen, Amber discovers that Josh tried to text message her about his feelings. But she's confused – why didn't she receive it? She soon realises Robbo intervened and deleted the message. Eager to set the record straight, Amber convinces Josh that she has nothing to do with Robbo anymore, but guiltily stays silent about the fact she slept with him only days ago.

When Mason learns about Robbo's new job with the council, he takes the opportunity to check out his squat at the old radio station. He's hoping to find and destroy the footage of Amber. But when he's there, Robbo returns and Mason's forced to hide. Just as it seems he's about to be discovered, Amber arrives to confront Robbo, and Mason's able to make his escape undetected.

Lucas is still feeling the financial pressure, so he's relieved when someone from his past, Harry, repays an old debt. But he's uneasy upon learning Harry won the money at an illegal poker game. Lucas is adamant that life is behind him. At Harold's, Vanessa continues to suffer from morning sickness. With Lauren's help, Lucas persuades her to take time off.

Driven by the poor showing for his house, Lucas joins a high stakes poker game. But when the game turns out to be Robbo's, he baulks. Goaded into staying, Lucas wins a huge hand and despite Robbo's attempts to get him to stay, Lucas manages to tear himself away. Lucas is racked with guilt over his gambling, and struggles to hide his conflict from Vanessa, feeling terrible for lying to her.

When Georgia returns from her conference, Mason witnesses the affection between her and Kyle and can't help feeling wistful about the dwindling intimacy in his relationship with Kate. Mason tries to rectify this but Kate makes it clear she's just not ready. Mason is understanding and wants to support her however he can.

With Karl back from his London trip, Susan is quick to confide her fear that one of her students (Imogen) could have an eating disorder. Karl advises her to talk to someone close to the student for more facts before making any firm accusations, so Susan goes to Terese. But in her efforts to make subtle enquiries about Imogen's recent behaviour, she puts Terese off-side.

Lou returns from Cambodia, reinvigorated by the experience and bearing gifts. He tells Bailey and Lauren that Sheila is keen on him, based on comments she posted on his blog, but he's going to let her down gently. Bailey reveals to Sheila that he posted comments on Lou's blog under her name; they were meant to be innocent ones but Lou has taken them the wrong way.

Robbo steps up his threat to Mason by posting a video link on the internet – ready to go live if Mason doesn't pay him before his court appearance. Desperate, Mason appeals to Paul for a loan, but Paul wants to handle things his own way. He orders Marty to step up the investigation of Robbo – but Mason decides to take matters into his own hands.

The preparation is done, the works are hung and there is nothing to do but open the ‘Dads of Erinsborough' exhibition - prompting some heart-warming moments. With their concern for Imogen bubbling after Susan's intervention, Terese and Brad take the chance to reconnect with her. And they're reassured to see that she seems to be the Imogen they know and love.

It's the morning after Robbo's hit and run. A concerned Imogen has spent the night searching for Amber, unaware that Amber is at the radio station, waiting for Robbo. At the same time, Amber is waking up to find that Robbo never made their rendezvous. Feeling ashamed and guilty that she almost slept with him in exchange for his salacious memento of her, Amber arrives home, furious with Mason.

Still hazy, Toadie struggles to remember the events of the previous night. With Sonya's help, flashes of memory return, and they realise Robbo spiked her drink at the ‘Dads of Erinsborough' exhibition. However, Toadie was the one who drank it and later at home, while drug affected, recalls reading a threatening text on Sonya's phone and heading out to find Robbo.

Mason gets a text from Chris summoning him to the shed – wondering what happened to the money. Mason has no idea and he still hasn't cracked Robbo's password so they don't know if the video has been uploaded from the laptop. All their work and money might well have been spent in vain. Chris susses Georgia out, learning there was no money found amongst Robbo's personal effects.

Amber is touched by Joshua's apparently genuine attempt to begin their friendship again. But plagued with her conflicting feelings about Robbo and the accident, she visits him in hospital only to be confronted by his vulnerable state. Breaking down, she remembers confronting him the night of the accident. Feeling guilty for what happened, Amber begs him to wake up.

The mystery builds in the wake of Robbo's accident. Lucas's continuing unease has Kyle wondering if he knows more than he's letting on – and what he learns about Lucas and Vanessa's financial and emotional pressures only deepens his concern. In the meantime, Lucas is stunned to learn of Toadie's growing belief that he's responsible for the hit and run. Sonya truly believes that he's innocent.

Lives are on the line in the wake of Robbo's death. His dying declaration gives Toadie hope that he won't have to face a manslaughter charge. Matt realises that his family is well and truly under the spotlight as Detective Sergeant Ellen Crabb takes over the investigation. Mason and Imogen, meanwhile, do what they can to support Amber wondering if she is in fact responsible for Robbo's accident.

Kate can't understand why Mason won't tell her where he was the night Robbo was hit. He insists she just trust him, but she can't help being suspicious as to why he won't give a straight answer. She takes her concerns to Paul who, believing that Marty was responsible, tries to convince her Mason didn't do it. It's Imogen who points out to Mason how difficult he's making it for Kate to trust him.

Karl's examination of Imogen reveals that she has a ruptured oesophagus, which is generally caused by excessive vomiting. This leads Karl to surmise that Imogen may have bulimia, but Imogen refuses to admit she has a problem. Desperate to get her daughter to open up, Terese goes out on a limb and confesses to Imogen that when she was a teenager she also suffered from bulimia.

A nervous Hudson is taken in for questioning and cracks under pressure, revealing he didn't go straight home the night of the hit and run – he went to talk to his old coach, Don. When his alibi checks out, the police are back to square one with only a reconstructed note taken from Robbo's pocket to go on.

Lucas is taken to the police station where he is clearly under suspicion. He tells the truth about the night Robbo died but is aware his story sounds crazy. While the police investigate Lucas's mystery man, he goes home to face the music. Vanessa is gutted that Lucas was gambling again and didn't tell her, while Sonya and Toadie are devastated that he let Toadie think he may have been responsible.

Mason is convinced Marty must somehow be involved in the hit and run on Robbo, but first he needs to rule out Amber's involvement. He demands to hear her version of events and after some coaxing, Amber finally confides what happened that night. Later, when Paul and Mason confront Marty, he denies any involvement in the hit and run.

Kate and Mason are still maintaining their physical distance, having not slept with each other since her diagnosis of Premature Ovarian Failure. They're planning a weekend trip to Sydney, and Mason – who wants to do something nice for Kate – organises a hotel room. He assures her it doesn't have to mean anything; he simply wants to treat her. Touched by the gesture, things get amorous.

Kate is stunned to realise Mason's serious about trying for a baby together. Kate doesn't think Mason is ready for that kind of commitment but he assures her that it's what he wants. Kate is thrown and confides in Georgia, who understands a baby hasn't been in Kate's plans but she thinks it's a sign of how much Mason really loves her. Kate argues she feels the same way about him.

Amber is horrified when she discovers the bruises on Josh's body. She is even more horrified – though perhaps a little touched - to learn that he scored them whilst defending her honour. So when Mason reveals he too has gone to extraordinary lengths to protect her – stealing Robbo's laptop to ensure the footage of her never makes it onto the internet – she decides it's time to make a few changes.

Vanessa is still reeling from the appearance of Alek, who cryptically admits he wants to make up for past mistakes. Vanessa hurries back to work but bumps into Lucas. He explains about attending a GA meeting but a flustered Vanessa is dismissive, leaving Lucas deflated. Lucas apologises to Toadie for his recent actions. Toadie accepts his genuine regret.

Terese and Brad commit to spending more romantic time together, while also making sure Imogen feels included. The couple decide to try their luck at the treasure hunt, but Imogen's not interested in joining them. Brad and Terese try to solve the riddle, but are led astray by Sheila, and end up on a wild goose chase, finding nothing but a discarded mobile phone.

Matt is reeling after seeing the video on Robbo's phone. Ellen tells him she'll have to interview Amber and warns him not to interfere. Amber, trying to protect her brother, cracks under interrogation and admits who knew about the video – not just Mason but Imogen, Chris and Hudson. Ellen brings them all in for questioning, and they are all adamant they didn't do it.

Urged on by Callum, Sonya takes matters into her own hands and hunts down Marty Kranic – Lucas's alibi, and the one person that might be able to clear Toadie's name. However her search proves fruitless until she crosses with Terese. Realising there's something familiar about Marty, Terese soon remembers seeing him in Paul's penthouse weeks earlier. Paul dismisses her claim.

After learning Terese reported Marty Kranic's hotel stay to the police, Paul goes into damage control. Afraid he will be implicated in the hit and run by association, Paul pays Marty to leave town. Meanwhile, Jack Lassiter returns to the hotel after his health scare but when he is unable to settle his previous room account, Paul discovers he has blown his vast fortune.

Lucas, Vanessa, Toadie and Sonya are relieved and happy that Marty has finally been identified in relation to the hit and run that killed Robbo. They're hopeful that he will be able to clear Toadie's name. However, the opposite proves to be true, when Ellen takes Toadie in for questioning. He is later arrested and charged, sending shockwaves through Erinsborough, and causing Sonya to worry.
From the faces of all the prime suspects lined up at Lucas and Vanessa's wedding, we flashback through time and revisit the night of the hit and run, revealing events as they happened.

Hudson has confessed to the manslaughter of Robert Slade and Chris is rocked. He can't believe his boyfriend did it, and never told him. Hudson insists he didn't want to drag Chris into his mess but Chris is determined to stand by him. Despite being hurt that Hudson kept the secret about Robbo's death from him, Chris goes into care mode. But Hudson becomes cold and begins pulling away.

Matt is in turmoil after learning Mason went to Paul for help during the Robbo saga. Lou realises what's going on and attempts to get through to both Turner men. But Matt's sick of his kids being distant from him, and Mason's had enough of his dad making him feel like a screw-up. Each of them refuses to reach out to the other, leaving Lauren and Lou fearing their family is just as torn apart.

Lucas, Vanessa and Patrick return after their honeymoon in Daylesford to collect the keys to their new Eclipse apartment and start packing and moving. However, the first inspection of their new home reveals minor defects, as well as the discovery it isn't as big as they expected. But things look brighter when they receive two offers on the same day.

Lucas and Vanessa are tantalised that they now face the very real option of starting a new life in the country. Finally, they make a snap decision – to pack up their lives and buy their dream house in Daylesford. Not only that, deciding to seize the day, Lucas convinces Vanessa they should leave right away, and rent near their new house until they can move in.

Kept up most of the night, tormented by thoughts of Hudson, Chris oversleeps and is late for work, not impressing his new boss, Danni. Tired and unable to concentrate, he makes a further mistake and Danni has no choice but to give him his first official warning. Shaken that his job is on the line, Chris turns to Karl for help and convinces him to prescribe sleeping tablets. But is this the sol...

Kyle and Sheila are shocked to find Chris lying in the back garden with no memory of how he got there. Karl diagnoses sleepwalking and urges Chris to stop taking the sleeping pills he prescribed. Chris remains exhausted and upset, unable to relax, and is tempted to take another tablet. But he follows Karl's advice and throws them out.

Josh and Amber connive to get time together, both planning on opting out of family outings in order to win time with each other. All goes to plan after much manipulation on both sides, only for Josh to crash out on the couch and miss their hook up. The next day, Amber's miffed, but Josh comes up with a way to make it up to her when he realises the Kennedys have a spare key to the empty Kapoors.

When Joshua and Amber are sprung being together, Lauren and Brad set new ground rules. They are allowed to see each other provided Joshua does extra tutoring and gardening duties for a month; and Amber works extra hours unpaid at Harold's. Lauren manages to persuade Matt it's a good idea, but Brad can't get Terese on side. She insists the original punishment stands.

Terese battles to remain calm and clear as she challenges Josh on his decision to drop out of Year 11. But when her attempts to reason fail, her frustration and fear are quick to surface. Brad tries to mediate but Josh insists that his two priorities are Amber and training with the swim squad. It's a stand for independence, and a desperate Terese asks for Amber's help in changing his mind.

Matt finds Sheila walking along the road in the middle of the night. She's been out searching for Chris, who's sleepwalking again, and had a nasty encounter with a man who tried to pick her up. Unused to feeling so vulnerable, it's left Sheila rattled. The next day, Chris is shocked to learn about his sleepwalking misadventure and admits he's been taking the sleeping pills again.

Callum is hurting in the wake of Bailey's attack on him, but Sonya and Toadie urge him to reconcile. Josie thinks Bailey regards Callum as a sidekick and encourages Callum not to forgive him. At Lauren's urging, Bailey tries to apologise to Callum and, due in part to Josie's influence, Callum can't accept it. Callum wonders if Bailey regards him as a sidekick and whether he's a true friend.

The surprise party is missing the guest of honour, until Lou shows up after a near fatal miss with a ‘widow maker' gum tree. He is delighted to see Lolly but explains why tonight could be his last. Lauren becomes concerned as Lou grows sentimental, despite everyone's insistence he is being silly about the family ‘curse'. Bailey asks about an old photo of Lou during his army conscription.

Kyle's working outside Grease Monkeys and a young woman whose name he thinks is ‘Ursula' trips over his equipment and spills her coffee. Always a gentleman, Kyle offers to buy her another one. Thinking Kyle's got the hots for her, ‘Ursula' makes a move. Kyle quickly tells her he's got a girlfriend. This is a platonic coffee, nothing more!

Georgia is delighted her favourite cousin Gem has arrived in town although Kyle is thrown, having met her when she was pretending to be ‘Ursula'. But seeing Gem's embarrassment, he agrees to keep her earlier ruse a secret from Georgia. An unsuspecting Georgia moves Gem into Toadie's house and begs her to get a job and stay permanently. Gem agrees, and when Toadie reveals Gem's sad past to Sony.

After congratulating Georgia for following her dreams, Gem finds out that Susan hasn't decided whether she's got the teaching job. Gem confides in Sonya that she doesn't expect a great reference from her old school, as the principal didn't like her and she didn't give very much notice. Sonya goes in to bat for Gem, telling Susan that everyone deserves a chance.

Learning Sheila's facing criminal charges, Kate realises she's been more affected by last week's incident than she's been making out. But Sheila refuses to admit her issues and insists she just overreacted. However when Stavros drops the charges against her, a relieved Sheila finally lets her guard down and confesses she freaked out because it was the first time in her life she'd ever felt weak.

Excited for work experience at Lassiters, Amber is determined to impress Terese despite Josh's wandering hands and mouth. Lauren's jealous that Amber sees Terese as her new role model, but she's glad her daughter is enthusiastic about something so positive. So when Terese suggests Amber and Josh are planning on sleeping together after catching them in a heated moment.

After being busted with Joshua in the spa, Amber and Josh's misunderstanding escalates. She feels like he doesn't respect her and that her mum doesn't trust her. Joshua's left fearing he's wrecked things with her for good. When Matt hears of Amber's upset, he confronts Joshua, who insists that's not true – revealing he loves Amber. Touched, Amber reciprocates the sentiment and the two reconcile.

Toadie's approached by a potential client – but shocked when he discovers they want to sue the gym for injuries sustained when Brad was supervising. Imogen's on work experience at Toadie's office and is outraged by this, but after speaking to Susan, Toadie decides it's best if he takes the case on – he can't let his relationships get in the way of his professional obligation.

Bailey still can't understand how Callum got an ‘A' and he got an ‘A-minus' on their assignment. Confused, Bailey decides to find out what he did wrong. Meanwhile, Gem's first day hits a hurdle when Kate discovers her screening Georgia's music video to her Biology class. She finds herself before Susan who is less than impressed. Bailey witnesses this and decides not to add to her problems.

Rhiannon returns to Erinsborough to give evidence to the police about Paul's bribery of Alan Hewitt over the Eclipse Apartments development. Paul threatens to make public the fact that she was basically hired as an escort for Hewitt, which would reflect severely badly on her son. Rhiannon wrestles with what to do, confiding in Sheila the difficulty of turning her life around in Mount Isa.

As Chris struggles with his grief over his failed relationship with Hudson, and Rhiannon wrestles with the dilemma of the new life a job with Paul offers, Sheila is frustrated by her inability to get through to either of them. She does, however, provide a useful piece of insight to Lou, who comes to realise that just as Sheila says – sometimes meddling in your kids' lives lets them know you care.

Although Chris suspects Miguel may have caused the vandalism at the garage, he keeps his suspicions to himself. He privately fears if he tells the truth, Danni will be angry with him for allowing his personal life to mess with her business yet again. But when Danni discovers that Chris has been hiding this from her, she's doubly incensed and issues Chris with a second warning.

Kate is shattered after her run-in with Georgia over Gem, but when she tries to fix things with Georgia they wind up in a mutual slinging match. Kyle starts to feel on the outer as Georgia pours all her time and energy into Gem. After seeing how upset Kate is, Kyle tries to talk Georgia around, arousing Gem's suspicions about the nature of his friendship with Kate.

Well-intentioned Amber plays match-maker. She believes it's time Imogen hooked up with someone and suggests the new hottie chef at Lassiters. Imogen explains she's not interested, but Amber continues to push and Imogen eventually cracks, explaining that ‘hypothetically' there could be someone she likes. Knowing there has to be a guy, Amber advises Imogen to take a risk.

Imogen is reeling from having seen her unrequited love, Mason, pashing off with Rhiannon. Her heart is broken and she's a mess. Callum finds her and tries to get her to open up but Imogen is too upset and embarrassed to totally confide in Callum that she is in love with Mason. Meanwhile, Terese discovers that Imogen has missed her counselling appointment.

Susan breaks the news to Rhiannon that Jackson is missing. At first, Rhiannon assumes her son is simply wagging school. But when she learns Jackson ran away after overhearing Susan and Karl arguing about looking after him, Rhiannon is upset and blames the Kennedys for his disappearance. The whole neighbourhood turns out to help the police search and eventually Chris finds Jackson hiding.

Kate, Kyle and Sheila are horrified to discover that Chris has punched Joshua. Although he regrets his act of violence, Chris shows no signs of giving up his destructive behaviour, even after he's charged with assault. Fed up, Kyle warns that if Chris doesn't change his ways soon, everyone will give up on him. However, Kate isn't ready to give up and tries to convince Brad to drop the charge.

Kyle and Georgia are disappointed that the house is not available for rent. Kate suspects Gem had something to do with it but Kyle thinks Georgia might be having second thoughts about them living together. Kyle discovers Georgia cancelled the rental application; Georgia realises Gem was involved. Gem apologises saying she could not stand the idea of living with a happy couple.

Amber and Imogen struggle to come up with platforms for their campaigns for School Captain, with Imogen inadvertently putting Gem offside when she rejects Gem's advice. Worried that the rivalry with Amber will destroy their friendship, Imogen seeks guidance from Terese, who suggests she needs less stress in her life, not more.

Mason is sure he and Rhiannon are just having fun together and nothing more. However, Karl and Susan are working hard to encourage Rhiannon to make good on her promise to make Jackson her first priority. When Mason helps build a school project for Jackson and then shows him how to play cricket and be a better sport, Rhiannon starts to see him as part of the way to do that.

Still privately freaked out over what Rhiannon said about him making a great dad to Jackson, Mason distances himself from her. Rhiannon notices and, confronted, Mason admits he's worried things might be moving too fast. Reading this as rejection, Rhiannon backs off, covering her disappointment. Mason instantly regrets his decision and, after encouragement from Kate.

Kate takes Chris to the prison, urging him to see Hudson. But he refuses to get out of the car. She insists they're not leaving until Chris faces Hudson, despite his fears that Hudson will continue pushing him away. Chris eventually agrees to confront him, but he's shocked to learn Hudson didn't lose interest—he was pushing him away because he loved him too much.

Terese fumes as Paul plays man-of-the-people at the Erinsborough Hospital Fun Run, all the while maintaining she's to blame for the new paid parking plan. Terese hopes at least her friends will be understanding, but when Lauren learns Terese now can't afford to scrap the plan, she's upset. Paul's sincere act in front of the public continues, as he charmingly promotes Georgia's charity single.

People are reeling in the wake of Paul's announcement that he's running for Mayor. Terese is stung to realise she's being made a scapegoat over the paid parking scheme, as Paul intends to abolish it if elected. Determined to find someone to run against Paul, Matt tries to talk Karl and Toadie into running, to no avail. But when Susan points out just how real the risk is that Paul will be elected.

Rhiannon's called in to work a shift at Lassiters at the last minute, and without anyone to look after Jackson, she decides to take him with her. Mason's horrified and tries, unsuccessfully to get someone to babysit, which earns him a stern talking to from Matt about taking responsibility. Mason doesn't appreciate his father's lecture and accuses him of having a grudge against Rhiannon.

Distraught about the Department of Human Services showing up, Rhiannon takes her anger out on Matt, accusing him of causing this. He denies it. Jackson is worried it was his fault but Rhiannon reassures him. Mason confronts Matt but eventually believes he did not make the call. Rhiannon is less convinced, hurt by practically being accused of prostitution by Child Services.

Finally able to remove Sheila's engagement ring, Kate is shocked to hear that Kyle's contemplating proposing to Georgia. Burying her true feelings, she encourages Kyle to go for it. But when he hears a throw away comment from Georgia about where they're at in their relationship, he begins to question whether proposing is the right thing to do.

When the wedding photographer Terese has hired becomes ill, she is forced to try and find a replacement at very short notice. Joshua tries to convince his mum to get rid of the paid parking so Amber no longer has to work as a meter maid. Amber entertains herself on the job by taking photographs on her phone of Rhiannon and Mason.

Terese takes Paul to task for revealing to the bride and groom that their ‘professional' wedding photographer was actually a schoolgirl (Amber) and costing the hotel money. But Paul takes the high moral ground, claiming he only wanted to do the right thing. Knowing this and Paul's newly installed paid parking is threatening her ability to meet her contract's productivity clause.

Imogen's convinced that Gem's treating her and the other girls unfairly and lodges an official complaint with Susan. Susan investigates Imogen's allegations. After talking to students and comparing the marks with the previous semester, Susan concludes that Imogen could be right and presents Gem with the evidence. She's defensive, but Susan advises her to lift her game.

Imogen goes to Susan and reveals what she saw at the lake, but both Gem and Bailey deny her story. Imogen's upset, then shocked when an angry Gem confronts her and reveals that she knows about her eating disorder – and she's prepared to tell the entire school. Imogen breaks down in front of Sonya and reveals all, so Sonya encourages her to take her power back – and reveal her secret herself.

Imogen chickens out of going to the school dance after her public declaration that she has bulimia, but talking to Josie convinces her that she needs to face the music. After learning from Amber what Imogen has done, Mason offers to help his mother with the catering at the dance so he can be there if there's trouble. Sure enough, he catches Imogen just before she's about to bail.

Susan is unsure whether to accept Paul's offer to keep the radio station afloat as it would also assist his election campaign. With Karl accusing Susan of succumbing to Paul's vote-buying scheme and tensions running high in the house, Rhiannon decides it's time to move out. She sets her sights on renting Number 24 together with Mason.

As plans for the wedding – and the secret engagement party – roll on, the pressure on Kate is building. Forced to write a speech for the happy couple at the party, Kate struggles to find the words. Believing her stress is related to the guilt she feels over her shared secret past with Kyle, Chris wonders what to do.

Rhiannon accepts a job as a receptionist at Lassiters Darwin, starting immediately. Breaking the news to Jackson does not go well when he realises that Mason will not be joining them. Despite Mason's attempts to explain that his relationship with Rhiannon would not have worked out, the boy blames himself for Mason deserting him. Mason is well aware of his own role in building up Jackson's hopes.

Kyle suggests Georgia take some time off from wedding plans to go house hunting. She agrees and he reveals his surprise – he's arranged to rent Number 24. Georgia gleefully agrees and she and Kyle break the news to Gem that they don't want her to move in with them. Gem seems to take it well but is actually hurting. She decides to buy a bridesmaid's dress that overshadows Georgia.

In the wake of Kyle and Kate's secret being exposed, Kate is at a loss to understand how the email came to be in Georgia's hands. She admits to Sheila that Kyle and her had been together but denies giving the email to Georgia. Kyle's stunned that Kate wrote the email in the first place and is dubious about her explanation of why he never saw it.

Despite her feelings of humiliation and heartbreak, Georgia makes a conscious decision to get back to work and go on performing. Although she pretends to be supportive, Gem finds her cousin's resilience infuriating. It would be far more satisfying for Gem if Georgia were miserable and needy. Gem finally gets what she wants when Kyle makes an unexpected appearance at Georgia's gig.

As the mayoral campaign continues, Sheila leads a protest against Karl's plan to turn the Community Centre into a childcare facility. Karl tries to assure the protestors that his proposal will only compromise part of the centre, but Sheila is reluctant to trust any politician in the making. Meanwhile, Terese calls a meeting to negotiate with Sheila and the protestors.

Terese fills Karl in on Paul's plan to accept kickbacks when he becomes Mayor and he's appalled. But he's forced to face the reality that Paul stands a good chance at winning the election. In an attempt to win back votes, Karl comes up with a new platform, however he will not announce his plans until the election night… refusing to allow Paul the chance to steal his idea – again!

After running into Kate, Georgia decides to vent when she sees Mason. But she's disappointed not to find a kindred spirit in him. While understanding Georgia's pain and anger, Mason reveals he's moved on. Later when talking to Chris, Georgia thanks him for being a good friend but soon realises he knew all along about Kate and Kyle's night together. Feeling betrayed, Georgia cuts him off, reali...

Mason and Imogen encourage Bailey to tell Susan that Gem made him hack Kate's emails, but Bailey's scared of what Gem might do in retaliation. When his covert attempt to get proof from Gem backfires, Bailey decides to tell Susan the truth. Susan's shocked and calls in the Turners – Matt finds the proof they need on Gem's laptop and she's suspended from her job at the school.

Sheila realises she's badly misjudged Kate and apologises for being a terrible friend. When Sheila tries to warn Georgia of Gem's manipulations, Georgia refuses to believe her, insisting Kate set Georgia up. Hearing Sheila's warning, and aware the net may be tightening around her, Gem tries to talk Georgia into getting out of Erinsborough for a while.

Karl tackles Paul after embarrassing Susan when announcing his carers' policy. Smug Paul is unrepentant, and denies exploiting Susan's MS to undermine Karl's bid to become Mayor. Karl is concerned for Susan's welfare and disappointed in her for not telling him about her relapse. She explains she tried, but Karl was so focused on his campaign, she never got the chance.

Sonya offers to baby-sit Elliott while Jacob goes to a meeting with his lawyer to sort out his wife's estate. While taking a stroll around Lassiters Lake, Jacob forgets to put the brake on his pram and it almost careens into the water. Shaken from what might have happened, Jacob is even more down on himself. Sonya tries to reassure him and he's grateful for her continuing support.

Lucy is back in town to deal with Paul's problems with Terese. After giving him an ultimatum of either ripping up Terese's contract or leaving the Lassiters chain, Paul chooses the latter and Terese is distressed. If she loses her job she'll lose her house as well. Lucy is sure that Paul is bluffing; it's all part of his game. There's no way that Paul will leave the Lassiters chain.

Arriving first at the cottage where Gem and Georgia are staying, Kate ignores Chris's pleas to wait for Toadie and Kyle and races off to find her estranged friend. Kate bravely breaks through the door, finding Georgia abandoned and unconscious in a gas-filled room. Administering CPR, Kate finally manages to revive Georgia just as Kyle arrives.

Kate resolves to keep her distance from Kyle, but things go awry when Bossy runs away. Seeing Kyle's distress, she offers to help him search, initially pushing aside her feelings to encourage his hopes of reuniting with Georgia. When Bossy is found pining outside Georgia's bedroom, Kyle tells his dog it's time for them both to move on. Hearing this, Kate's hopes rise.

Bailey's still hung up on Gem, and wants to help hunt her down so he can get some answers. He convinces Callum to help him search her room, looking for clues to her whereabouts. They find her diary. Against Callum's advice, Bailey reads it, finding a passage about himself that makes him feel more sympathetic. Despite Callum's warnings not to, Bailey texts Gem.

Georgia's still rattled by the sudden appearance of her car, and when Kyle arrives at the hospital to keep her company, they experience the first thaw in their relationship. However things quickly become awkward when Kate turns up as well. They're interrupted when Gem suddenly runs in, with an injury to her hand that the others quickly suspect is self-inflicted.

Kyle, Georgia and Kate are all feeling weird in light of Kate's declaration that she's in love with Kyle. Kyle has no idea how to process the information, and Georgia feels similarly up in the air about what it means. But after getting closure with Gem, and feeling positive, Georgia decides she's open to whatever happens with Kyle – even the possibility of reconciliation.

Reeling from his talk with Georgia, Kyle confides in Chris, who feels Kyle needs to make a choice. Kyle mopes about the house, and Sheila doesn't see what good feeling sorry for himself will do. Chris persuades Kyle to go on a boys' night with him – no women allowed. After a couple of beers, Kyle begins to relax, although Sheila suggests he is burying his head in the sand.

Suffering from heartbreak over Kyle, Georgia's starting to feel physically ill at work. Karl, who is somewhat preoccupied with the election, encourages her to go home. She says she'll fight through the food poisoning, but he assumes the Kyle situation is getting her down. When she becomes nauseous during work later, she wonders if it's more than that.

Overwhelmed by the discovery that she's pregnant, Georgia is grateful to find an understanding confidante in Susan. She shares her feelings of shock and bewilderment, admitting she never could've imagined she'd find herself in this position, alone and pregnant. She wrestles with the decision to tell Kyle, fearing his reaction to the news.

As Josh's public profile builds, Ruby lands him a major new sponsorship deal. Josh is stoked with the gift they give him – a new car – but Amber begins to suspect fame is going to Josh's head. Her fears are confirmed when Josh skips another training session to attend a glitzy PR bash. Brad is livid when Josh gets home after midnight. Neither Brad nor Amber are able to get through to Josh.

Josh's path towards self-destruction continues, to Brad's increasing concern. Not even Amber can get through to him and it seems his swimming career and his relationship are headed for disaster. Sharing her son's drive and competitiveness, Terese finally understands what is scaring Josh – a fear of failure. Confronted, Josh admits his fears and the increased pressure that has got to him.

Jacob apologises for his impetuous kiss, but Sonya is left awkward and feeling that she should tell Toadie what happened. Jacob begs her not to, but when Callum senses something going on between them, Sonya decides to be upfront. She tells Jacob that they can't spend anymore time together, and goes home to tell Toadie the truth. But an unexpected twist in Jacob's legal case.

After a successful gig the night before, Karl comes into election day with all the momentum – and Paul struggles to hide his growing anxiety. Karl encounters a strong swell of support and it emboldens him to quietly confront Paul during a photo op. He relays Marty's offer and Paul is suddenly gripped by the feeling that everything is falling apart – a feeling that only gets worse.

Terese, still on an adrenaline high after quitting her job at Paul's victory party, shares her news with a pleased Imogen. Back home, however, the reality sinks in over the enormity of Terese's decision. Brad is supportive and even suggests Paul might come back on bended knee begging her to return to work.

It's the day of Josh's Commonwealth Games trials and tension builds as everyone, including a nervous Terese, gathers at the Turner's house to watch it. Not helping Amber's building anxiety over her boyfriend's sporting fate, is Bailey's inability to get the live broadcast feed working. Things get off to a shaky start for Josh when he fails to even qualify for the final of the 50-metre freestyle.

Amber is reeling after discovering Josh will be away at a training camp in Spain. For three months. Worried that it is too long to be apart, she's determined to buy herself a plane ticket. Unable to talk to Josh about the training camp because of the Victory/Australia Day Party and his phone ringing non-stop with people congratulating him and offers of endorsements, Amber decides to go ahead.

In the wake of Kyle and Kate's secret being exposed, Kate is at a loss to understand how the email came to be in Georgia's hands. She admits to Sheila that Kyle and her had been together but denies giving the email to Georgia. Kyle's stunned that Kate wrote the email in the first place and is dubious about her explanation of why he never saw it.

Despite her feelings of humiliation and heartbreak, Georgia makes a conscious decision to get back to work and go on performing. Although she pretends to be supportive, Gem finds her cousin's resilience infuriating. It would be far more satisfying for Gem if Georgia were miserable and needy. Gem finally gets what she wants when Kyle makes an unexpected appearance at Georgia's gig.

As the mayoral campaign continues, Sheila leads a protest against Karl's plan to turn the Community Centre into a childcare facility. Karl tries to assure the protestors that his proposal will only compromise part of the centre, but Sheila is reluctant to trust any politician in the making. Meanwhile, Terese calls a meeting to negotiate with Sheila and the protestors.

Terese fills Karl in on Paul's plan to accept kickbacks when he becomes Mayor and he's appalled. But he's forced to face the reality that Paul stands a good chance at winning the election. In an attempt to win back votes, Karl comes up with a new platform, however he will not announce his plans until the election night… refusing to allow Paul the chance to steal his idea – again!

After running into Kate, Georgia decides to vent when she sees Mason. But she's disappointed not to find a kindred spirit in him. While understanding Georgia's pain and anger, Mason reveals he's moved on. Later when talking to Chris, Georgia thanks him for being a good friend but soon realises he knew all along about Kate and Kyle's night together. Feeling betrayed, Georgia cuts him off.

After being rushed to hospital, Georgia is diagnosed with severe dehydration and is terrified that her actions may have harmed her unborn child. But when Karl does an ultrasound, Georgia's relieved to learn her baby is fine… Meanwhile, a frantic Kyle, desperate for news of what's going on – bursts into the room and realises that Georgia is pregnant with his baby.

Arriving at the camp site, Mason discovers his tent has a huge hole and Imogen reluctantly agrees to let him share with her. Settling down for the night, Josh and Amber have fun until they overhear Mason and Imogen bickering. Mason admits to Imogen he dobbed in Isaac – they argue but there is a flirtatious undercurrent. They converge in the night and are discovered the next morning.

Imogen, Mason and Amber are in a panic as they rush to check that Josh is alive – relieved to see he's conscious, they try and call for help but they can't get reception on their phones. Amber takes control and orders Mason to run back to the campsite to get help. Guilty, thinking this is his fault, Mason takes off and is shocked when he runs into – Mark Brennan – who calls for a chopper.

It's the night before the operation and Terese does her best to keep Josh comfortable, but when he admits it's the fear of losing everything that's keeping him awake, Terese puts her own doubts aside to soothe him. The family are relieved when Dr Crawford reveals the operation should be relatively straightforward. Now confident, guilty Josh apologises to Amber for kicking her out.

After putting his curiosity to rest about Kate and Kyle's relationship and subsequent break-up, Brennan is ready to move on to whatever lies ahead of him. But when he discovers a leak in his radiator, Chris allows him to repair it at the garage and the two are caught out by Danni. Under the pump, Chris quickly enlists Brennan's help in clearing their backlog in exchange for fixing his car.

Kate's bleak mood gets Susan's attention – and her concern results in a blasting from Kate. Chris tries to lend support but Kate's determined to shut herself away from her friends and deal with her issues on her own. But as the day wears on, and Brennan's presence continues to rattle her, Kate's troubles worsen. Finally, in the heat of the moment, she lashes out at school, hurting Bailey.

Mason returns home and the Turners are relieved. But Matt fears that even if the police don't lay charges, Brad will file a lawsuit, so he asks Toadie to represent Mason should anything happen. When Brad finds out that Toadie has agreed, he hits the roof and accuses Toadie of taking sides. The Turners' fears come true when Mason is served papers. He's being sued.

Matt tries to reason with Brad about the lawsuit against Mason, but Brad refuses to listen and heads off to collect his son. Josh is discharged from the hospital by Karl, who tries to warn him not to have unrealistic expectations about his recovery. At home, Josh learns from Imogen that Amber has been nominated for a photographic award by the Erinsborough Council.

Joshua's guilt for leaving Amber's award ceremony spikes when he's confronted by Chris. Covering his jealousy of Amber's newfound success, Joshua pretends to his concerned parents that he only left because his shoulder was hurting. He maintains the ruse when he goes to apologise to Amber, although when he turns down an invitation to her celebration dinner, Amber's upset and confronts him.

It's Valentine's Day and both Kyle and Georgia are feeling glum, given this is the day they were meant to be getting married. Georgia knows she has to tell Kyle about her decision to move home to Birregurra, but given the significance of the day, there's no way she can do it, so she's hoping to avoid Kyle altogether. They run into each other however, and agree to have a meal in order to discuss.

Mason is determined to prove he's not responsible for Josh's accident. Imogen insists he did nothing wrong – she saw the accident with her own eyes – but Mason won't be placated. Mason and Imogen approach Brennan, hoping that his background as a cop, coupled with his abseiling expertise, may be able to help prove Mason's innocence.

Sonya is trying hard to reconnect with her family and lets Callum talk her into approaching Toadie about getting his Learner's Permit. Toadie is very much against the idea – when will they find time to teach him? They both work! Sonya pushes and Toadie finally agrees as long as Sonya is the one to take him out for lessons. But Sonya insists he would be a better teacher.

When Toadie learns that he's missed Nell's first steps because he deliberately ignored Sonya's phone call, he's overwhelmed with guilt. He finally confesses, telling Sonya he didn't answer her call because he was annoyed with her for taking the support group convenor job instead of putting their family first. Sonya is upset. First of all, she hasn't taken the job.

It's Mason's birthday and he couldn't be happier. He's got the girl of his dreams and finally they're able to be open about their relationship. While shocked to discover the new arrangement, the Turners are happy for him. In contrast, things in the Willis household go from bad to worse. Josh is deeply betrayed by his sister, and Brad and Terese are concerned that Imogen went behind their backs.

Despite her concerns about seeing Georgia, Kate shelves her plans for ‘me-time' and agrees to go to Mason's party to support him after his break-up. She's thrown to find Brennan's also been invited, but insists to a match-making Lauren that whatever she and Mark once had is now over. After a run-in with Georgia, her attempt to rekindle their friendship is again rejected.

Karl has organised a charity car boot sale for the hospital. While gathering items to sell, Toadie accidentally takes the earrings Kyle bought for Georgia when they first got together. He's oblivious though and, along with Sheila, has success at the sale. But Karl hits a hurdle when Paul reveals that even though Terese gave permission for the car boot sale to take place at the car park.

After keeping his secret about Hudson from Patricia, Sonya encourages Chris to tell his mum the truth, while also wrestling with her own conflict of interest. Her concern only grows when Patricia doesn't turn up for the next GA meeting as promised. Worried she may be in a vulnerable place, Sonya tries to get in touch with her. But her quest to find Patricia's contact details proves fruitless.

Paul's on an anticipatory high, awaiting Rebecca's arrival… until Karl reveals that their Twin Cities meeting will be with Mary Barnett and the not the higher-ups. Bitterly disappointed, Paul pulls out of the meeting. Meanwhile, Rebecca arrives, taking a pass through Charlie's to visit her old stomping ground. She's a little wistful as she chats with Sheila, avoiding a near miss with Paul.

Rebecca reels from Paul's bombshell and tells him she will never get back with him. Debriefing with Susan, she realises Paul must have planned this for months. Rebecca decides to stay and complete her job like a professional. Paul gives her an access key to his apartment and they have a constructive business meeting where he impresses Rebecca with his skill.

It's Mason's last day in Erinsborough and the Turners are down about him leaving, while Lauren continues to struggle with the fact that it's actually happening. Meanwhile, Amber's spirits sink further when Josh refuses to support her during this difficult time, while Callum manages to buoy Bailey. Seeing his mum's reaction, Mason's feeling guilty about leaving.

Brennan's immediately suspicious when he sees a strange car loitering in the vicinity of the garage. When he tries to approach it, the car takes off – and now Brennan's really worried that Danni's ex, Stephen Montague, might've tracked down where she works. Brennan reports the car to Matt, who checks it out – apparently the vehicle is not registered to Stephen.

Bailey's missing his big brother, and Callum suggests that what he needs is some female distraction. He encourages Bailey to ask Hot Josie out, but Bailey thinks there's no hope – Hot Josie's into Kyle. However, after a study session with Josie, Bailey realises just how much he likes her, and Callum convinces him he's in with a chance.

Kyle rushes Georgia to the hospital where Karl confirms their worst fears – Georgia has miscarried. Georgia's mind is a fog. She doesn't know what to do or where to go. Kyle, determined to be strong, takes control. His strength and compassion are a huge comfort to her. Arriving home however, Georgia is confronted by the sight of baby Nell and painfully reminded of all that she's lost.

Sonya is disappointed when she is blanked by Chris but remains hopeful Patricia will come clean to him about her problems. Toadie remains sceptical. Sonya spots an edgy Patricia hurrying out of the Antique Shop and senses something is wrong. Patricia claims she almost sold some possessions to gamble but stopped herself. Sonya wants her to come to the GA meeting today.

Amber's sick of Joshua's moody behaviour and calls him on it. Joshua, in a better mood now and having success with his recovery, promises to be a better boyfriend. But Amber senses that something's not quite right with him. He's acting weird around his parents, not wanting to celebrate his quick recovery, and his eyes are weird – his pupils tiny.

Lou's first wife and Lauren's mother, Kathy, arrives for a surprise visit to Erinsborough, off the back of Lauren's phone call.
