Sheila confronts Kyle about his motives for returning to Erinsborough. He admits to still having feelings for his ex-girlfriend, Amy, but insists he has no intention of breaking up her and Gary. Meanwhile, Finn is struggling to find a place to stay and Ned and Bea have agreed to move on from their past disagreements

Finn moves into Ramsay Street, stirring up fear and anger among the neighbors. Gary and Ned confront Elly and Susan about their decision to let him stay, while Toadie returns home from America and struggles to cope with his wifes death.

Ned and Finns tension escalates, leading to an argument. Karl and Susan intervene, and David visits Karl to discuss his interest in neuropsychiatry. Meanwhile, Shane, Dipi, and Yashvi consider moving out of their home due to Toadies grief-driven actions.

The residents of Ramsay Street are thrown into chaos when a razor blade is found in an apricot. Aaron points the finger of blame at Finn, but Karl implores him to wait for the police investigation. Paul assumes Finn is the culprit, but Terese defends him.

Chloe realizes Pauls motive behind asking her to stop seeing Kyle, but Paul brushes it off. The engagement party begins, and tensions rise. Roxy causes a scene at The Waterhole, and Gemma wants Terese to help turn her daughters life around. Chloe and Kyle get caught in the laundry room, but Amy doesnt seem bothered. Kyle confronts Chloe about her manipulation and leaves.

Paul and Roxy move to Melbourne and meet Terese, Ned, Chloe, and Kyle. Terese wants to help Roxy get back on track, while Mark and Elly worry about the pregnancy. Roxy takes off her top and bra and jumps into the pool, while Elly is anxious about what she needs to tell Mark.

Elly and Mark discover that their baby is healthy after a sonogram with Dr. Dietrich. Mark becomes suspicious when Elly goes for a follow-up appointment, so she arranges a meeting with the doctor to ease his concerns. Meanwhile, Toadie plans to campaign for donations to the community center, Imogen is leaving for LA, and Roxy is in town for trial shifts at The Waterhole.

Finn anonymously donates 50,000 to Toadies Foundation, but must hide when Toadie and Dipi show up unexpectedly. Bea catches him in the act and he explains his intentions, but she remains skeptical. Elly returns a gift to Dipis house and learns Marks reaction was due to missing an ultrasound.

Elly is blackmailed by Dean for better grades, while Karl is excited to receive a vintage tram from his half-sister Jemima. Meanwhile, Paul and Kyle discuss the Robinson Pines house lots, and Kyle attempts to kiss Chloe. Karl eventually receives confirmation that Jemima bought him an actual tram, causing Susan to worry about where they will put it.

Elly is caught with alcohol in her bag, despite being pregnant. She lies at first, but eventually confides in Mark, apologizes to Dipi and Mark, and promises to stop drinking. Toadie discusses his donation with Sheila, Shane, and Kirsha, and Finn and Susan discuss Finns future plans. Karl is excited about the tram being installed, but Toadie cancels the fundraiser due to low attendance.

Elly is rushed to the hospital in pain and insists on seeing Dr Dietrich. Meanwhile, Finn is on the run and avoiding Beas calls. The residents of Ramsay Street are discussing a break-in at Toadies office and suspect Finn is involved. Bea receives a note from Finn that leaves her unsettled.

Aaron and David are worried when Finn doesnt show up for his hospital appointment. Bea, who is still in The City with Finn, calls David and agrees to bring him back. Meanwhile, Roxy finds a present in her shoe, Paul gets angry, and Gary talks to Amy about his passion for cooking.

Terese had a serious conversation with Roxy about her recent behavior and its impact on their relationship. Paul initially decided Roxy should move out, but changed his mind. Roxy revealed she had won money through race-fixing in Darwin and wanted to get out of the mess. Chloe promised Roxy she was a vault for secrets, but Roxy saw her receive sneaky cash from Paul.

Amy and Gary were caught in an intimate moment by Kyle, who had come to check on them after the Paul-bribing-Chloe scandal. Kyle mentioned that he and Chloe were still together, and Gary made a joke about Kyles timing. Mark then walked in on Elly while she was doing her schoolwork, and she quickly turned over her phone.

Finn discovers a secret that could ruin Elly and Marks relationship Shaun is the father of Ellys unborn child. Finn promises to keep the secret safe, but Elly decides its time to tell Mark. Meanwhile, Ned meets an unknown sender to discuss Finn, and Toadie prepares for the foundation launch to honor Sonyas memory.

Susan and Mark respond to a gas leak at the Lassiters Complex, where they find Toadie, Aaron, and Nell unharmed. Karl helps Bea, who is taken to the hospital, and Clive updates Gary and Amy that Sheila is conscious. Elly receives a call from Susan and Finn assures her that Dean wont bother her again.

Ned is confronted by Elly and Susan for his involvement in the gas leak at Lassiters Complex. Bea reveals she overheard Neds warnings about Finn and can no longer trust him. Kyle is still reeling from the shock and avoiding Amy, while Karl confirms Beas vitals are normal but tells Ned to go home.

Chloe feels guilty for telling Gary about Kyles true feelings, potentially ruining their friendship. Leo and Roxy discuss plans for the Back Lane Bar, while David and Aaron move their relationship forward. Paul and Terese argue about his meddling in Amy and Garys relationship, and Vance visits the Back Lane Bar. Roxy wants Vance to come for dinner to meet everyone, but he is reluctant.

Roxy has big plans for the grand launch of the Back Lane Bar, but runs into a problem when the hire company cant pick up the mechanical bull until Monday. She moves it to Paul and Tereses garden without permission, and they demand it be removed by the end of the day.

Vance arrives at Number 22 and meets Terese, who is shocked to see him. They have a private conversation, and Ned interrupts them. Finn visits Harry in prison with Karl, and everyone has dinner. Ned is charged at the police station, and Terese tells Paul about Vances criminal past. Paul is worried about Leo, and Vance tries to stir things up by talking about love and family.

Elly, Mark, Aaron, and Susan investigate Finns past and discover that he was involved in a gas attack. They work together to protect Finn from the consequences of his actions and help him regain his memory.

Finns memory is returning, causing tension between David and Aaron who disagree on how to handle it. Karl, Susan, and Bea learn that Finn recognizes Harry Sinclair, while Gary is planning a surprise party for Amy. Kyle buys her an expensive present and Yashvi jokes about eating all the food, leaving Gary sweating.

Elly has a difficult conversation with Mark where she reveals her pregnancy and that she slept with Shaun, Finns brother. Mark is devastated and leaves, and Elly follows him, but he tells her to stay away. Meanwhile, Paul and Terese sense something suspicious is going on with Gary and Jimmy, and Kyle has a surprise for Amy.

Gary surprises Amy with a public proposal at her birthdaywedding party, but shes uncomfortable and takes him aside to explain that she cant marry him like this. Meanwhile, tensions rise between Terese and Leo over Vance, and Paul criticizes Sheilas son. Gary announces that the wedding wont happen and turns the celebration into an Amy birthday party.

Paul, Terese, and Ned have breakfast with Roxy and Vance. Paul notices Vances scar and learns its from a fight with a psycho ex. Meanwhile, Chloe apologizes to Kyle for the wedding incident, but he reveals his love for Amy. Terese and Vances history creates tension, while Leo becomes suspicious of their activities with a horse.

Terese confesses to Ned that she still cares for Vance, her former teenage lover, but wants to keep him away from her niece, Roxy, due to his manipulative influence. Ned listens to her concerns, but is unsure how to help her. Meanwhile, Finn reveals to Karl a conversation they had before his amnesia, and Mark discovers the baby Elly is carrying is not his, but Shauns.

Elly and Finns tension is high as Finn reveals he invited Shaun to his hearing. Despite Susan and Karls encouragement, Elly storms out. Bea offers her support, while David keeps Finn and Shaun updated. Shaun expresses his gratitude to Susan, and Bea tries to get Mark to talk to Elly. Aaron and Kyle finish their jog, and Kyle confides in Aaron about his tender bid.

Elly was devastated when Mark asked for an annulment, but Bea and Susan encouraged her to seek legal advice from Toadie. Sheila offered Mark breakfast and encouraged him to talk to Chloe, which eventually led to them reconciling.

Andrea is struggling with her past and trying to start a new life in Geelong. Shane finds her and urges her to come back to Erinsborough and tell Toadie the truth about Dee. Toadie is furious and demands that Shane bring Andrea back, while Dipi tries to calm him down.

Andrea, Toadie, and Shane discuss the possibility of Andrea having new information about Dee. Toadie is skeptical, but Andrea insists she received a call from a stranger claiming to know her. Toadie refuses to let Andrea see her son Hugo, reminding her that he was awarded custody after they dropped the charges against her.

Toadie vents to Karl about Shane and Dipi involving Andrea in his life without his knowledge. Karl tries to reason with him, but Toadie feels betrayed by Sonya not confiding in him. Meanwhile, tensions rise between Roxy and Leo over the feud between Paul and Gary. Shane and Dipi seek Karls advice on dealing with Andrea, and Karl considers checking in on her.

Toadie is angry when Karl brings Andrea to his house, and Andrea remembers traumatic childhood memories. Susan and Karl try to help her, but her emotions overwhelm her, leaving them unsure of what to do.

Elly is reminded of her upcoming scan and is initially excited, but Finn suggests she bring Shaun along. Mark is distracted by a case and Aaron urges him to take a break. Shaun is apprehensive about visiting Finn, but Bea reassures him. They attend an art therapy class and Elly and Shaun slowly start to connect. Yashvi and Ned catch up on their lives and bond over their love of football.

Elly and Shaun are discussing their baby scan when Mark interrupts with news of a fire at the forensics locker. Chloe is preoccupied and asks Sheila to investigate Pierce, while Ned suggests Yashvi and him take a break. Susan talks to Finn about the tension between him and Bea, and Finn admits he almost kissed her.

Mark and Toadie discuss Andreas unhelpful information regarding the Dee Bliss case and consider hypnotizing her again. Willow visits Toadie to discuss her complicated feelings towards her mother. Karl hypnotizes Andrea and she mentions the Red Cove Hotel, but the conversation triggers bad memories about Dee.

Amy and Gary discuss an offer from Karl, weighing the pros and cons. Despite Garys hesitance, they decide to accept it. Kyle and Sheila encourage them to work together. Meanwhile, Andrea suggests contacting a friend from Heathers Spanish dancing class to find her, and Willow expresses concern for Andreas mental health.

Roxy suggests a game to distract Terese and Paul, while Vance plans to sell Red and leave without telling anyone. Toadie is struggling to understand what happened to Dee and his feelings for Sonya and Andrea. Meanwhile, Roxy is creating cocktails inspired by her acquaintances.

Terese discovers that Pierce is buying a stolen horse from Vance and asks Ned to inform him to avoid any potential legal issues. Roxy enters and tells Terese about a fondue set she has purchased for Vance. Leo discovers the safe open with a note from Vance explaining he needed the cash for a quick getaway.

Tereses secret past with Vance is revealed, causing tension between her and Paul and Roxy. Ebony and Pierce have dinner at the Waterhole, and Sheila reassures Ebony about Chloe. Roxy leaves the hotel, but Paul stays. Leo reveals Vances apology for stealing from the safe, and Paul confronts Terese about her history with Vance.

Ebony and Chloes bickering continues to escalate, while Toadie and Shane decide not to look for Dee. Andrea is fired from her job and then learns that her ex-partner Heather is in Melbourne, causing her to become agitated. Pierce tells Chloe to stay out of his love life.

Andrea is struggling to keep her mother, Heather, hidden from her daughter Willow while Heather is desperate to see her granddaughter. Andrea manages to distract Willow and convince Heather to stay hidden until she moves to Erinsborough.

Elly and Marks kiss ended awkwardly, leaving Mark to ask for time to think. Bea, Finn, and Shaun listened to Beas song, and Elly discussed the kiss with Shaun, who offered to leave when the baby is born to give Elly and Mark a chance to work things out.

Andrea is struggling with Ians harassment, while Terese is trying to help her niece Roxy and mend her relationship with Paul. Dipi is hostile towards Andrea, while Heather is suspicious of her influence over Toadie.

Toadie confronts Ian and Andrea about their argument, and they explain Ian is selling crystals and wanted to check on Toadies search for Karen. Heather lurks in the background, and Andrea resists Ians advances, worried about her relationship with Toadie. Mark updates them about Heathers whereabouts, and its clear shes gone into hiding.

Terese proposed to Paul, but he was hesitant to trust her due to her past mistakes. Roxy caused tension among the housemates, while Kyle avoided work and Chloe was wary of Ebony. Ned found Tereses proposal comical, and Paul and Terese discussed how to handle the press. Roxy demanded Neds help in finding Vance, but he refused.

Chloe discovers Ebony has been taking money from Pierces expense account to help her sister, a single mother of three, who had been left with no money by her ex-partner. Ebony begs Chloe not to tell Pierce, as she loves him and fears it will hurt him. Chloe is torn between telling Pierce and keeping Ebonys secret.

Kyle falls from scaffolding and is rushed to the hospital, where it is revealed he only has a small cut, some bruising, and a mild concussion. Dipi is researching facial recognition and credit card tracking to locate Dee, while Shane and Dipi enlist Finns help at the Sonya Rebecchi Foundation.

Finn is nervous about teaching an adult literacy class, but Susans support gives him some confidence. Toadie is worried about Dipis intentions and doesnt trust her, while Yashvi teases Ned at community service. Andrea and Heather plot to fake childhood memories during hypnosis, and Heather is expecting a visitor in a catsuit.

Heather is confident that Ian can help them reconnect with Karen, a loose end from their past. Andrea, however, shares a memory of a redheaded woman who looked after her when she was a child. Heather dismisses the memory, but as soon as Andrea leaves, Heather retrieves Ians quartz and kisses it.

Terese takes a risk to move forward with her business plans by meeting with investors, but her thoughts are interrupted when Roxy arrives home drunk. Yashvi and Ned try to hide their feelings for each other, and Yashvi confides in her mother about her relationship with Ned. Meanwhile, Pierce offers Terese helpful tips and Chloe is surprised to see him.

Terese and Paul confront Roxy over her behavior, which caused them trouble with investors. David and Aaron return to find their house occupied by a frustrated Roxy, and tensions escalate as they try to coexist. Pierce and Chloes conversation is interrupted by Ebonys arrival, and Pierce considers investing in the hotel.

Pierce catches Chloe hiding Ebonys wedding dress and is suspicious of her motives. Terese notices Pierces distraction and Kyle decides to stay in Erinsborough. Amy suggests to Gary that they have another baby and he is open to the idea. Amy apologizes for putting him on the spot and they both agree to have another baby.

Amy and Gary discussed their wedding plans, but Gary had secretly been planning to try for a baby soon after. Gary lied to Sheila about his intentions, while Heather tried to hide her whereabouts from Andrea.

Aaron drops David off at the hospital and notices the close relationship between Bea and Finn. Meanwhile, Heather is in Byron Bay investigating Karen, who may be the real Dee, while Dipi and Shane discuss Yashvi and Neds relationship and how to handle it.

Andrea and Karen discover a scream coming from the edge of a cliff, interrupting their conversation. Meanwhile, Ian informs Toadie and Dipi that Karen is on her way to Erinsborough, leaving Toadie in shock and wondering why she is coming back after all these years.

Heather is worried that Andrea wont accept FakeDee, but Toadie and FakeDee are determined to make it work. After a lot of convincing, Andrea finally agrees to meet FakeDee and they all come together as a family.

Dees friend Toadie listens to her shocking confession that someone has been pretending to be her for months. Meanwhile, Mark interviews Heather, who reveals she tracked down Dee after receiving a tip-off from Ian. Dee and Toadie sift through wedding photos and Dee reveals something happened on their wedding day that changed everything, involving her sister Cecile and her boyfriend Riley.

Dee reflects on her past and confesses to Susan that she was wrong to leave Toadie and the Zantucks were after Andrea. Toadie asks Dee to leave town and Mark focuses on his children. Andrea admits to panicking and trying to kill Dee for Willow and Hugo, but Willow is not impressed and leaves.

Amy and Garys disagreement leads to a rift in their relationship, while David and Finn discuss Finns struggles with jealousy. David also receives no response from someone he wrote a letter to, and Roxy is invited to a lunch with Paul and Terese as an opportunity to rebuild her relationship with Terese.

Paul is curious about David and Aarons secret conversation, but they play along with Roxys fake story about fostering a child. Tensions rise as Paul overhears their hurried departure and suspects something is amiss. Meanwhile, Yashvi struggles with her street art tour, Bea and Finn join in to support her, and Luka recognizes Finn.

Paul, David, and Aaron meet Harlow, who claims to be Roberts daughter. Despite Pauls skepticism, David believes her and invites her to stay with them. Meanwhile, Heather is denied bail and is transferred to Goodwood Prison, and Leo and Mark give advice to their respective friends to help them move on with their lives.

Dee and Toadie discuss his decision to send her back to Byron Bay the week before. Dee reassures Toadie that she understands, and they talk about the events leading up to Andreas arrival and the revelation that she was not there to harm Dee but to find her sister. They agree to visit Andrea to try to figure out the connection between them.
Toadie and Dee struggle to move on from the past, but eventually find comfort in each others support. They reconcile and decide to move forward together, despite the pain of their pasts.

Finn suggests a charity bachelor auction to support the Sonya Foundation, but Terese initially thinks its a tacky idea. After Finn insists there will be nothing tacky, Terese agrees to let them hold the event at The Waterhole, but asks Finn not to turn it into a meat market. Alfie, an obsessive tour-goer, scares Bea, but Finn intervenes and throws him onto the sofa.

Sheila and Paul are discussing how to help Kyle, who is struggling with his fathers new relationship. Sheila tries to offer support, but Kyle misunderstands her intentions. Later, Kyle is auctioned off and Chloe steps in to save him, offering money to buy him back.

Roxy is struggling with an obsession for Vance, while Paul is trying to make amends with his son and make sure Amy is happy on their honeymoon. Meanwhile, Gary is up to something suspicious with an invoice for Jemima. Terese tries to help Roxy, but its unclear if she will be able to get through to her.

Susan is invited to Sydney for a second round of remyelination therapy for her MS. Dee is concerned when Andrea wants to see her in prison. Sheila is distracted when Clive arrives, and Kyle confronts her about her role in his breakup with Amy. Harlow reads Pauls letter to Robert and decides to stay in Erinsborough and enroll in school as Harlow Robinson.

Roxy and Dee both struggle to come to terms with difficult situations in their lives. Roxy is hurt by Pauls lack of respect for their relationship, while Dee is overwhelmed by the revelation of her twin sister, Andrea. Meanwhile, Sheila attempts to make amends with Gary, but he is still hurt by her actions.

Paul lies unconscious as Roxy discovers him and calls for an ambulance. Toadie and Karl discuss Heathers willingness to undergo hypnosis to uncover the truth about her missing child. Terese and Harlow have a conversation about Roxys attention-seeking behavior. The group waits anxiously at the hospital as Roxy shares her limited knowledge of the attack.

Roxy comes forward to give a statement about what she saw the night Paul was attacked. She saw Gary attacking Paul near the lake, but doesnt know what weapon was used. Paul forgives Roxy for not helping and Mark takes Gary to the station. Elly returns home from her trip with Karl and receives a letter from the family court.

Elly struggles to make sense of her dream, while Bea and Finn try to keep their relationship a secret. Mark and Chloe discuss Ellys decision to cut short the massage session, and Bea gets the idea of taking Finn on a date outside of Erinsborough.

Ned suspects Finn is manipulating Bea, but when they explain a break-in happened and Finn saved her, Ned is curious and wants to know more. Meanwhile, Yashvi is devastated when Ned cancels their meeting without explanation. Dee and Toadie take a tour of the complex, and Karl reveals Susan has voiced concerns about them.

Dipi notices a spark between Toadie and Dee, and suggests they keep an eye on the situation to prevent either of them from getting hurt. Elly and Karl chat about Gary and Paul, and their conversation is interrupted when Bea and Finn arrive home, revealing their relationship to everyone. Willow talks to Dee and Toadie, and tensions rise when Bea and Finn sit at the table.

Dee confronts Shane and Dipi about reading her journal, and they explain they were looking out for Toadie. Gary and Kyle prepare for the grand opening of The Tram, while Sheila is left feeling hurt. Paul discharges himself from the hospital to attend the opening, but is angry that Karl hasnt fired Gary yet.

Sheila hides evidence of Garys attack on Paul, while Elly is taunted by boys and Yashvi reveals a rumor about Dean. At the tram launch, Finn and Bea are caught kissing, and Gary shows up drunk and causes a scene that is filmed and circulated.

Sheila has confessed to moving the crowbar used in Pauls attack to protect Gary, leaving him worried about his fate. Roxy is staying with Vance, who attacked Paul, and is experiencing flashbacks of the events leading up to the attack. Mark is questioning Roxy, but she is lying to him. Meanwhile, Terese is trying to convince Paul to let Roxy stay with them.

Elly and Karl discuss the rumours about her buying alcohol for Dean, and Finn comes in looking for his blue shirt. Karl offers him other shirts for his date with Bea, and Elly admits shes still unhappy about them seeing each other. Karl tries to make up for his mistakes by buying pies from Gary, who is worried about his drunken antics being discussed on Twitter.

Toadie and Dee share a passionate kiss, but Toadies unresolved feelings for Sonya and Andrea cause him to leave. Pierce asks Bea to perform at a music festival, but Finn interrupts out of concern for her. Chloe reveals her obsession with the band Hanson, and Finn confides in David about Beas sensitivity.

Bea and Finn investigate a series of break-ins at Erinsborough High School. Elly is devastated when she learns that six families have unenrolled their children due to her actions. Meanwhile, Toadie visits their house and Finn offers to help him with the Sonya Foundation.

Chloe and Ellys date is interrupted when Susan calls Elly to discuss school issues. Bea attempts to get Ned to help her talk to Alfie, but he suggests going to the police. Finn prepares his pitch for the Rebecchi Foundation, and Susan updates Elly on her treatment. Susan confronts Finn and Bea about their relationship but offers her support.

Yashvi admits to Karl that she kept a secret from Bea, which leads to Karl demanding to know the entire story. Meanwhile, Shane criticizes Yashvi for trying to profit from other peoples trauma, but Ned defends her. Dipi steps in to calm everyone down and drags Shane out of the kitchen. Gary and Amy arrange a meeting for their wedding, and Karl returns with an update on Susan.

Bea is thrilled when Nigel Davis invites her to be a support act for King Calaway, but she quickly remembers her storyline and the need to rush back. Toadie and Karl try to convince Mark that Finn is not a threat and should be released, but the decision is up to the OPP. Amy and Kyle reconcile, and Sheila learns that Gary has ended their relationship.

The episode explores the themes of relationships, forgiveness, and making amends through the storylines of Clive and Sheila, Aaron and Leo, and Roxy and her mother. Amy and Kyles discussion and Sheilas attempt to apologize to Clive are key moments in the episode.

Aaron and Chloe discuss plans for Chloes date with Elly. Elly is excited and Leo advises her to be honest about what makes her happy. Harlow complains about Roxy, but Terese advises her to be patient. Roxy is thrilled with the car and plans a road trip. Chloe visits Mark for advice and he reminds her to just be herself.

Chloe finally opens up to Kyle about her kiss with Elly, while Elly goes to get ketchup. Yashvi is pleased that Ned stood up for her against Shanes glare. Dipi advises Shane to wait for things to settle down, and Yashvi invites him to the pub. Meanwhile, Leo talks to Pierce about Chloe and Ellys date, and Pierce takes an interest in Carmen.

Carmen and Leo meet and fall in love, while Chloe and Elly attend a prenatal yoga class and discuss parenthood. Bea meets King Calaway and holds hands with Finn, while Yashvi gives her statement to the police. Elly advises Finn to let Bea go if he truly cares about her.

Mark and Leo investigate the theft of Leos money, with Mark warning Leo that his insurance may not cover the loss. Leo panics about how he will pay his staff and suppliers, and Roxy insists that he get the money back. Leo and Mark search for Carmen, the supposed accountant who set up Leos bookkeeping software and accessed his passwords.

Gail arrives unexpectedly and is met with hostility from Roxy, who is married to Paul. Terese shuts her down and Sheila meddles in Garys life, angering him. Gary catches Amy and Kyle making out and leaves early. Gail and Paul talk about the past and Harlow and Gail discuss Robert. Gail regrets not noticing the warning signs.

Gail attempts to convince Harlow to move to Tasmania with her, but Paul and Terese refuse to interfere. Meanwhile, Gary and Kyle work together at The 82, and Yashvi argues with her parents about spending time with her boyfriend. Yashvi eventually decides to stay until after her exams in exchange for a car.

Sheila has gone missing and her car has been found in Seaton. Amy and Kyle search for her while Gary and others gather at Number 26 to figure out where she could be. Finn is cleared of suspicion and celebrates his newfound freedom with a double date. Kyle and Amy reminisce about their memories of Sheila, and Gary struggles with guilt.

Chloe realizes she can no longer prioritize her relationship with Elly, who is now pregnant. Bea asks Elly if she wants to be in a relationship with Chloe, but Elly insists their connection is strong without it. Meanwhile, Terese offers to lend an ear to Pierce, Aaron and David plan a birthday party for Mark, and the 28 crew offer Elly support and consolation after the break-up.

Paul and Terese are shocked when Lyn, Pauls ex-wife, unexpectedly shows up and jokes that they are still married. Gary seeks fashion advice from Sheila and Amy for his date with Gail, but they suggest getting outside help. Mark and Roxy wake up in his house after a night of drinking, apologize to each other, and agree to keep it a secret.

Paul and Lyns strained relationship is causing tension in the lives of Paul, Terese, Leo, Roxy, and Mark. Leo and Roxy are struggling to move forward after the closure of their bar, while Mark and Roxys relationship is deepening. Lyns interference in Pauls life is causing discomfort for everyone, and its unclear how the situation will resolve.

Harlow confronts Roxy about her affair with Mark, and a heated argument ensues. Later, Yashvi visits and overhears Dipi and Shane talking negatively about her, leading to her leaving in hurt. Roxy then tries to seduce Mark, and Chloe offers Yashvi advice on her situation.

Pierce rushes to call an ambulance when he sees Elly in pain. Karl and Susan inform Chloe that Elly will undergo scans, but the results will take some time. Despite their persuasion, Chloe insists on being with Elly. Meanwhile, Paul and Terese confront Rebecca about her intentions, and Toadie reveals their partnership is still in the early stages.

Terese confronts Paul about his past with Rebecca and demands the truth. Paul admits Rebecca pushed him off the mezzanine years ago, and he blackmailed her to keep it a secret. Tensions rise as the ex-wives interfere, but Terese remains steadfast in her love for Paul. Meanwhile, Yashvi faces conflict with Shane over her relationship with Ned.

Shane is struggling with his relationship with his daughter Yashvi, who is not speaking to him after a disagreement. Dipi suggests he apologize to Ned, who is sitting alone at a table. Yashvi and Mackenzie enter the cafe and join Ned, and they discuss Shane. Meanwhile, Gary is feeling down about his dating life, and Sheila tries to cheer him up.

Mackenzie moves in with her dad Shane and starts attending Erinsborough High. Roxy struggles to find a job in the area, but Mark helps her get a job at The Waterhole. Mackenzie faces bullying at her new school, but Susan apologizes and offers her support.

Roxy sets up a romantic evening for Mark, but Harlow interrupts. Meanwhile, Sheila reminisces about her past with Clive, making Gary and Amy uncomfortable. Paul and Terese enjoy a romantic getaway before their elopement, but Paul worries about his past relationships.

Ned comforts Terese after Paul calls off their wedding due to his past with his ex-wives. Paul throws their wedding rings into a fountain, and Terese orders him to leave. Despite his pleas, Paul walks out and Terese is left in tears. Its clear that Pauls past is causing issues in their relationship.

Terese attempts to confront Christina and Caroline about Elles plan to ruin things for them, but the two sisters start arguing instead. Paul talks to Elle via Skype, where she admits to sending assassins to test his relationship with Terese. Paul then proposes to Terese, who eventually agrees.

David and Aaron search for Leo, eventually finding him at the Back Lane Bar. Leo apologizes for leaving and explains that he needed time to think. David and Aaron forgive him and the three of them reconcile.

Mackenzie is overwhelmed and seeks comfort at Harolds Caf, where she shares a special memory with Shane and Dipi. Meanwhile, Chloe and Pierce spend time together and share a kiss, and Karl discusses hosting wine events at the tram. Mackenzie returns to school and talks to Susan, showing her willingness to seek support.

Chloe is unaware of Pierces secret, and Pierce is hesitant to tell her. Mark encourages Pierce to be honest, but before he can, he receives a text and leaves. David is discussing his delusions of Leos return, while Mark is at The Waterhole and Roxy is avoiding him. Karl is worried Bea hasnt told Finn the real reason Elly left, and Finn gets a call from Shaun about Elly.

Gail is preoccupied with her daughters ex-wifes plan to sabotage Paul and Tereses wedding. Meanwhile, Roxy has handcuffed Mark to a table leg and enlists Harlows help to get bolt cutters from Ned. Pierce apologizes to Chloe and they bond over lunch, while Hendrix helps by taking his shirt off. Roxy and Harlow struggle to free Mark until Ned arrives and offers to help.

Yashvi and Mackenzies friendship is tested when Angela Lane and other parents complain to the schools PTA about Mackenzie playing on the girls team. Susan handles the confrontation with anger and composure, reminding the parents that Erinsborough High does not tolerate discrimination. Shane tries to contact Grant, Mackenzies father, but has no luck.

Mackenzie is interviewed by Mark and Yashvi about transphobic incidents at school. Yashvi also reveals she received a note. Mackenzie suggests Susan should be contacted. Ned takes Scarlett on a tour of the town, and they end up at the 82 where Gary offers them a special deal. Ned invites Yashvi to join them, and Scarlett finds out they are dating.

In Harolds Caf, Dipi confronts Shane about his outburst, while Harlow and Yashvi worry about Mackenzie. At Number 28, Finn shows Bea an old crib he found online, and they discuss their vision of a happy co-parenting dynamic with Shaun and Elly. Tensions rise at Number 32 as Aaron and David compete over restoring a crib, and Finn discovers Bea and Finn are also working on one.

Amy discusses with Harlow about her reluctance to introduce her mom to Paul and Terese. Harlow avoids the topic, leaving Amy worried. David loses interest in making a crib for Ellys baby, causing tension with Aaron. Pierce and Hendrix have school troubles, and Chloe babysits Hendrix while Pierce attends interviews.

Hendrix tries to charm Chloe by inviting her to join him in the pool, but she refuses and confronts him about his behavior. Chloe seeks Aarons help to address the issue with Hendrix and decides to focus on mending the relationship between Hendrix and Pierce. Ned is surprised to see Scarlett working at Harolds and learns she knows about his relationship troubles.

Sheila and her friends concoct a lie to tell the police, Ned is spied on by Scarlett, Yashvi is jealous of Shane, and the girls plan a surprise party for Sheilas birthday. Sheila hopes Clive will attend the party.

Roxy wakes up hungover and is surprised to hear Harlow tell her she kissed Mark at the party. Pierce, Chloe, and Hendrix have breakfast at Harolds Cafe when Mark arrives and reveals Hendrix invited gatecrashers. Sheila criticizes Mark and Shaun surprises Susan, Karl, and Bea. Roxy apologizes to Mark, but he remains silent, leaving her embarrassed.

Mark realizes he mistreated Roxy and apologizes, promising to change. After some time, Roxy agrees to forgive him. Aaron consoles David, reminding him not to judge Shaun based on Finns actions. Gary tries to help Sheila cope with Clives absence, but she refuses to forgive him.

Shaun, Finn, Mackenzie, and Harlow all face difficult decisions about their futures. Shaun must decide whether to stay or go, Mackenzie and Harlow must decide how to organize the school dance, and Finn must decide how to help Shaun. Meanwhile, Mackenzie and Shane search for clues about her missing father.

Mackenzie is struggling to come to terms with Shanes role in her familys destruction. She accuses him of trying to make up for his mistake by finding her father, but Shane denies it. They argue, and Mackenzie storms off, leaving Shane alone. Yashvi correctly guesses that the conversation is about Mackenzie and her father, and Shane reveals that he has not found him yet.

Ned, Bea, and Scarlett are at The Waterhole when Bea collapses due to an electrical shock. Ned rushes her to the hospital, leaving Yashvi alone. Yashvi eventually finds Ned and confronts him about not putting her first. Mackenzie encourages Yashvi to be honest with Ned, and Yashvi and Scarlett go to look for him.

Bea experiences chest pains and is taken to the hospital, where it is revealed she has atrial fibrillation. The news leaves Bea anxious and concerned, while the other characters react with worry and jokes. David is especially concerned and is likely monitoring Beas progress closely.

Shaun and Elly struggle to come to an agreement on co-parenting, while Karl visits The 82 bar and Kyle deals with an upcoming event. Gary teases his mother and invites her to the bar, while Roxy and Mark share a moment. Aaron and David argue, and Kyle confides in Amy about Scarletts crush.

Roxy goes on a date with Mark, who insults her and makes her feel small. Harlow consoles her and encourages her to break up with him. Sheila and Gary argue over Sheila throwing wine back at Beverly, and Pierce gives Hendrix an ultimatum to either go to school or get a job.

Mark and Chloe search for their mother, Fay, and discover her Huntingtons disease has progressed. They take her home to Adelaide, where she can receive 24-hour care. Meanwhile, Yashvi worries about Ned and Dipi and Shane investigate a lead on Mackenzies dad, Grant, who works in a hardware store in NSW.

Scarlett and Ned arrive home to find Kyle and Amy on the sofa. They discuss Scarletts shopping plans and Neds relationship with Yashvi. Ned confesses he misses Yashvi, and the others offer support. Mackenzie is nervous about Grants visit, so Yashvi and Harlow offer to go with her. Dipi agrees to be in the background in case things go wrong.

Ned spends the night protecting Scarlett from her ex-boyfriends threats, then goes to Yashvis to try to patch things up between them. Yashvi accuses him of cheating and breaks up with him, leaving Ned devastated. Meanwhile, Harlow and Roxy get into an argument, but it is interrupted when Terese and Paul arrive home early.

Terese and Paul investigate a hidden camera in a Lassiters Hotel room, while Toadie, Nell, and Hugo return home from the US to a warm welcome. Meanwhile, Shaun pitches his idea for a mentorship program to Finn, who is hesitant but agrees to discuss it further.

Paul and Terese discuss the secret camera situation with Donovan Ridley and are relieved to learn that the Wi-Fi transmitter is no longer functional, meaning no one could have received footage. Amy tries to convince Kyle to wait for more info before going to the police, but Kyle disagrees.

Pierce struggles with his sons misbehavior and lack of respect towards him, and seeks advice from Susan. He later takes Hendrix to the hotel room he trashed and makes him clean up the mess as a way to pay off his debt. Mackenzie and Harlow discuss their night at the dance, and Mackenzie feels responsible for what happened with Hendrix. However, Harlow reassures her that she is not to blame.

Shaun and Elly kiss, but Shaun insists on leaving for Switzerland. Mark decides to leave, and Aaron jokes about him leaving post-it notes. Scarlett is questioned by Paul, and she and Ned plan to schmooze Paul and Terese. Toadie sets up Neds community service job. Bea asks Toadie to talk to Ned about Yashvi.

Aaron, Ned, Scarlett, and Susan all face different challenges. Aaron and Ned search for Rex, Scarlett worries about Neds safety, Susan deals with a new principal, and Pierce worries about Hendrixs future.

Scarlett is struggling with her feelings for Ned, who is leaving town. Meanwhile, Pierce and Hendrix are at odds, and Finn and Toadie are setting up a support group for domestic violence survivors. Ned eventually tells Scarlett that he cant pursue a relationship with her, and she is left to deal with her emotions.

Paul and Terese rush to the crash site where Hendrix is still in the car. Harlow is trapped under debris, but Paul rescues her. The press captures the scene. Finn thanks David for his therapy session and offers him a speaking opportunity at a symposium. Pierce confronts Hendrix about the crash, taking the blame himself. Hendrix visits Harlow, but their interaction is strained.

Sheila apologizes to Gary for her behavior and admits that she and Clive are not back together. David is able to attend the symposium and Scarlett gets a reference from Toadie. Paul is still annoyed with Scarlett, but Terese sympathizes with her. Ned arrives to help Scarlett with her reference.

Scarlett and Paul continue their game of cat and mouse as they try to outwit each other. Scarlett reveals her knowledge of the camera in Room 402, and Paul asks her what she wants. Terese and Pierce arrive for a meeting, and Scarlett pretends she was just delivering guest feedback.

Paul and Terese are worried about Neds injury and suggest taking him to the hospital. Scarlett suggests they dont have all the facts yet, but Paul calls the police to investigate. Ned is found to have a dislocated shoulder, and Scarlett is relieved. Yashvi is struggling with her exams, so Finn suggests helping Toadie with a website.

Bea and Finns relationship is strained when Bea accidentally calls him by her exs name. Elly tries to mediate, but Finn leaves in frustration. Roxy discovers Sheilas relationship with Clive and encourages her to do something bold to get his attention. Kirsha confides in Toadie about her desire to apply for a scholarship, but her parents are hesitant due to her anxiety.

Finn anxiously awaits a call from his mom regarding the missing hikers in an avalanche. Hendrix reconnects with school, while Pierce and Terese prepare for the Melbourne Cup. Elly and Finn clash over their hopes for Shauns survival. The Cup goes missing, adding to the chaos. Hendrix observes with amusement. Harlow and Roxy stumble upon the Cup in their car.

Pierce is struggling to connect with his son Hendrix, while Sheila is suspicious of Clives relationship with Beverly. Finn learns of his brothers death and is struggling to cope with his grief. Roxy tries to console Hendrix and suggests he may have acted out to get Pierces attention, but Hendrix reacts negatively. Chloe stops Pierce from following Hendrix and advises him to keep trying.

Clive is caught kissing Beverly, leading to a confrontation with Sheila and Gary. Ned and Scarlett are interrupted by an alarm, and Yashvi worries about her exams and Neds relationship with Scarlett. Kyle, Aaron and Ned try to find out who set off the alarm, while Sheila is confident Clive will leave Beverly for her.

Six friends prepare for a getaway, but Ned and Scarlett take off together. Kyle is suspicious of Scarlett, and Paul discovers a text message warning of her dangerousness. Yashvi finds the message and makes a phone call.

Scarletts violent act leaves Ned injured and the others shaken, reflecting on their own actions and trying to understand how they could have prevented the tragedy. Meanwhile, Bea and Yashvi search for Ned, only to be confronted by Scarlett, who stabs Yashvi and flees. Harlow and Mackenzie go trick-or-treating, unaware of the horror unfolding elsewhere.

Paul discovers Tims agenda and realizes Scarlett had been manipulating them all. He and Terese confront Tim and demand he take down the website. Tim agrees, but Kyle is still angry at Paul for not taking Amys safety seriously. Paul apologizes and Kyle and Amy return to the hotel.

Paul tries to convince Pierce that Terese should not resign from her role as manager of the hotel, but Pierce disagrees. Elly interrupts and expresses her happiness for Chloe and Pierces impending move in together, and Chloe apologizes for not telling her about Shaun. They agree to put their differences aside and resume their friendship.

Chloe is conflicted about proposing to Pierce, but with the support of Aaron and Elly, she decides to go ahead with it. At the Melbourne Cup, Chloe proposes to Pierce, who happily accepts. Everyone celebrates the happy couples engagement.

Pierces engagement to Chloe has caused tension between him and his son Hendrix. Terese and Paul are trying to smooth things over with Prue, Harlows mother, while Kyle and Amy are discussing Pauls suggestion for Amy to do an interview with the press. Sheila reminds them not to let it come between them, but a group of drunken extras recognize Kyle from the sex tape and Amy is outraged.

Prues outburst has caused tension between her, Harlow, and Amy, and the family is struggling to come to terms with her behavior. Toadie is trying to reconnect with his family, while Yashvi is dealing with Neds advances. Gary and Kyle discuss Prues treatment of Amy, and Sheila comments on her viciousness.

Ned had a nightmare about Scarlett and accidentally hit Yashvi while thrashing in his sleep. Yashvi left Neds house and refused medical help, while Gary confided in Toadie and Karl about his relationship with Prue. Elly was experiencing back pain and Finn took her to the hospital, where Karl expressed concern about her prescribed medication.

Finn takes responsibility for his parole violation and turns himself in to the police, while Susan and Elly speak to Olivias mother. Harlow confides in Kyle about her mothers behavior, and Prue and Gary go on a date, where Gary reveals secrets about Roxy. Toadie is trying to get Finns ankle bracelet reinstated.

Prue and Harlow spend quality time together, but Roxy invites Prue to join her later. Terese offers to make breakfast, but they refuse. Elly learns that Finn had returned home alone and Angela blames her for any harm that came to Olivia. Prue and Harlow take a break to play pool at The Waterhole, where Roxy challenges Harlow to a dance match. Prue watches and laughs as they compete.

Three friends, Paul, Pierce, and Chloe, plan to hold a town hall-style meeting to address an issue involving cameras and leaked footage. Terese is worried about her involvement in the scandal, while Harlow and Prue plan to have dinner with Gary. Roxy offers to join them for dinner.

Kyle tries to convince Toadie to join a class action lawsuit against the corporation responsible for releasing a sex tape featuring Amy, but Toadie declines due to his debt of gratitude to Paul and Terese. Meanwhile, Pierce and Chloe plan their wedding, and Clive and Sheila continue their affair, but try to keep it transparent.

Pierce and Chloe reconcile after talking about their issues with Elly. Karl helps Pierce join the bike club, and Ned joins them at The Shed for a workout. Everyone is able to work out their issues and come together in the end.

Prue worries about Garys silence after their date. Harlow suggests he may not want to get attached. Prue trades places with Ned, whos happy and clear-headed. Susan tells Karl she gave a bad reference for Elly. Prue asks Sheila for a job but is rejected. Elly is upset about the reference, blaming Susan. Ned rejects life coaching.

Prue apologizes to Gary for attempting to steal money and admits to being under pressure. She wants to stay in Australia and asks Terese and Paul to sponsor her. Kyle is feeling guilty and confides in Sheila. Amy is feeling self-conscious and paranoid since the video of her and Kyle went viral. Prue discusses the Restoration Order with Gary and wants to go back to London, but Gary is unsure.

A story about a persons journey to find their true identity and purpose in life. Along the way, they must overcome obstacles and challenges, while learning valuable lessons about themselves and the world around them.

Roxy takes a Polaroid of Karl and Susan, but Sheila is against the idea. Sheila worries about Roxys job when Pierce informs her that theyll have to reduce staff. Meanwhile, Elly suggests creating a photo album for her baby, and Bea expresses her concern about Neds wellbeing to Finn.

Roxys job is in jeopardy due to possible staff cuts at the Waterhole. Pierce advises her to adjust her attitude, which she reluctantly agrees to. Hendrix asks Roxy for help in breaking up Pierce and his stepmother Chloe, but she gives him love advice instead. Yashvi is worried about her first day at work as Chloes assistant and is concerned about seeing Ned again.

Prue tries to remind Harlow of her life in the UK, while Dipi misses Kirsha and Yashvi tries to reassure her. Paul and Kyle discuss the class action, and Aaron helps Ned with his injuries. Paul talks to Harlow, but she has already left.

Terese admits to Prue that she has had a relapse with alcohol, but insists it is a one-time event. Prue is concerned that Terese is being controlled by addiction and suggests that Harlow should return to London for her own stability. Paul and Terese reconcile, and Kyle and Amy take time for themselves.

Harlow and her family and friends gather for a farewell drinks evening hosted by Paul and Terese. Harlow and her mother have reconciled and Harlow is leaving Erinsborough to go back to London. Prue thanks Terese for helping convince Harlow to go back, and Amy arrives late to apologize for not being able to say goodbye properly.

Terese finds Davids lifeless body and calls an ambulance. Aaron rushes to the hospital, where Karl informs them that David has a damaged kidney and internal bleeding. Kyle and Amy argue in the hospital corridor, and Terese arrives and confides in Paul that she had been drinking. Paul asks if she had hit David, but Terese denies it and Harlow believes her.

Paul and Aaron anxiously wait for news of David, who was hit by a car and is undergoing emergency treatment. Karl, a doctor, administers adrenaline and administers a shock to restart Davids heart, and the team is finally able to resuscitate him. Karl informs Paul and Aaron that David is now stable but warns them of further complications.

Karl informs Davids family of his registration for kidney donation, but warns them of the risks. Ned seeks counselling after being stabbed by his ex-girlfriend, Scarlett, and is hesitant to try mindfulness breathing techniques suggested by his counsellor. Chloe and Pierce postpone their wedding plans, but David insists it goes ahead.

Neds involvement in a fight club causes tension between him and Bea, while Chloe and Pierce return home to celebrate the end of a lawsuit and Chloe is surprised with the news of her new position. Hendrix is focused on his video game, while Finn buys a pram for Elly. Yashvi is annoyed with Ned for being late to work, and Sheila discovers she cannot donate her kidney to Clive.

Chloe confronts Hendrix about their kiss, expressing her frustration. Hendrix denies malicious intent, but Chloe accuses him of playing games. Pierce overhears the argument and demands an explanation. Hendrix downplays the situation, blaming it on a misunderstanding. In another part of the complex, Yashvi confides in Harlow about her secret relationship with Ned.

Elly is feeling uneasy and confides in Susan. Susan informs her about Tereses interest in joining the foundation. Toadie updates Finn on the foundations success and suggests Terese for the manager role. Dipi is grateful for a shift at the tram, while Kyle is struggling to cope with his guilt.

Finn discovers that Dean is blackmailing Elly and warns her to go to the police. Elly is hesitant, so Bea shares some lyrics to a song she wrote about Finn with her. Elly decides to confront Dean herself, while Pierce and Chloe discuss their upcoming wedding and Hendrixs reluctance to attend.

Pierce discovers Hendrix has run away and tries to convince him to return and be the best man at the wedding. Meanwhile, David and Aaron get dressed for the wedding, and Karl informs Aaron he is the new best man. Pierce cancels his phone to prove his sincerity, but the episode ends with the unresolved question of whether Hendrix will return.

Toadie meets Claudia at a cafe and they strike up a conversation. Elly is stirred up by memories at Chloes wedding reception, while Pierce takes Hendrix out on his yacht and assures him of their relationship. Karl, Susan, and Hendrix later discuss Kris Kringle at The Waterhole, and Claudia drops off a pamper pack for Elly. Karl helps Hendrix pick up his things from his dads place.

Claudia hires a PI to investigate Ellys background, uncovering something incriminating. Finn is upset that Claudia doesnt trust him and uses him to dig up dirt. Claudia then asks Finn to watch Elly and intervene if needed to save Shauns child. Finn disagrees and wants to support Elly instead.

Kyle and Amys conversation leads to Kyle suspecting Amy might be pregnant, while Paul and Terese welcome Leo back from New York and Paul expresses his desire to fix their relationship. Gary, Shane, and Dipi finish dinner with a disagreement, and Amy bumps into Sheila at The Waterhole and drops her pregnancy test.

Yashvi stands her ground and defends her decision to involve the police in the fight club, leading to a candid conversation about Pauls relationship with Terese and his struggles with his sons health. Meanwhile, Leo catches up with Roxy and learns about her romantic involvement with Mark, and Harlow waits for Roxy to come out of her kidney donor test.

Roxy and Harlow lie to their guardians to visit David in the hospital, and Finn is suspicious of Claudias intentions. Paul and Terese debate the ethics of moving David up the transplant list, and Aaron asks Dipi for help in finding a donor. Conflict looms as they all try to help David.

Finn is torn between his love for Bea and his complicated history with Elly. Toadie suggests a Christmas concert fundraiser in Sonyas name, while Hendrix is feeling down due to his broken heart over Chloe. Claudia talks to Paul about Elly and suggests using Finns loyalty to her advantage.

Claudia and Ellys conversation reveals tension between them, as Claudia is interested in Ellys ex-Finn. Pierce and Hendrix try to make amends, while Finn is worried about Claudia and Ellys relationship and decides to put a stop to it. Chloe shows Toadie her poster for the Christmas concert, but he is not happy with it.

Elly is trying to remain positive despite Claudias grandchild fantasies, while Bea is rattled by Claudias manipulations. Yashvi apologises to Chloe and Pierce and quits her job to focus on her police entrance exam. Amy worries about Davids infection and her relationship with Kyle, while Toadie and Ned work on a wall design with personal significance to Toadie.

Amy confronts Liam over his failure to inform her about Jimmys disappearance, and the group continues to search for him. Meanwhile, Roxy discovers she is a match for Davids kidney, and Kyle offers to take Amy to the airport. Just as the group is at their wits end, Jimmy suddenly appears safe and sound, much to everyones relief.

Sheila tries to make Jimmys birthday special, but he rejects her efforts and locks himself in his room. Worried, Amy and Gary investigate and discover that money is missing from her purse. Paul and Terese leave Erinsborough to make a fake drive, while Harlow plans to visit her father. At the hospital, Robert arrives heavily chained and is introduced to David.

Paul has a nightmare about Robert, which unsettles him. Terese comforts him, while Finn visits David in the hospital. Amy and her friends search for Jimmy, and find him with his girlfriend Maya at the Backpackers Retreat. Meanwhile, Paul and Terese talk to Harlow about visiting David.

The Brennan family faces a difficult situation when David needs a kidney transplant. Despite their initial hesitations, Terese and Paul forgive each other for past wrongdoings and come together to support David. With the help of the doctors, David is given a second chance at life, and Paul is given a second chance to make amends.

The family is relieved when Elly gives birth to a healthy baby girl, and as a tribute to Ellys late husband, Shaun, they name the baby Aster. However, the celebration is short-lived as Ned informs Leo about the police being called to Ramsay Street because Robert has taken someone hostage. Leos immediate concern is for his brother, David, who needs a kidney transplant urgently.

Elly and Finn struggle with their feelings for each other after a one-night stand, while Chloe and Pierce visit David in the hospital. Chloes visit to Ellys place to give Aster a gift highlights the deep emotional connections between the characters and the impact of one event on their lives.

Kirsha is welcomed home by her family and friends, while Toadie and his children spend time together. Kyle reveals that he and Amy have broken up, and Toadie tries to console him. Meanwhile, Hendrix and Yashvi go on a date, and Pierce and Chloe arrive for the party at The Waterhole.

Toadie sat on the couch, watching a video of Sonya that Piper had sent him. Kyle was asleep beside him, unaware of the emotional moment. In the video, Sonya talked about her New Years resolution of cherishing every moment with her family. Toadie was moved to tears by her words.

Paul is struggling with Amys departure, but Terese reminds him that there will be plenty of people around to keep him in line. Meanwhile, Roxy is taking care of David at Erinsborough Hospital and is feeling guilty for her past behavior towards him. Harlow confesses to Paul and Terese that she emailed Prue about everything thats been happening, but Paul warns her not to expect a response.

Kyle attempts to kiss Roxy, but she pushes him away and leaves. She is frustrated by the fact that guys assume she is interested in them just because they hang out for a few minutes. Finn wakes up to Aster crying and offers to help Elly settle the baby. After trying everything, Aster finally stops crying in Finns arms, and Elly falls asleep next to him.

Susan confronts Elly and Finn about their secret relationship. Elly pleads with Susan to keep quiet about it, while Finn tries to take the blame. However, Susan warns Finn that he cannot hurt Bea, whom he still loves. Paul is desperately trying to convince David not to visit Robert, the man who gave him a kidney. Despite Pauls efforts, David is determined to keep his promise and visit Robert.

Karl is cooking on the BBQ, while Finn is quiet, and Susan gives him a side eye when he confirms hes happy with his decision to move into Beas room. Hendrix complains about Asters crying at night and is sent to get a BBQ plate from Karl and Susans bedroom. He snoops around the room and finds a blue box under the bed, opens it, and finds a feather boa.

Lucy wants to hire someone with more experience and lock them into a five-year contract. However, if Chloe can impress Lucy in the next two weeks, Lucy will reconsider. Chloe is worried that she will fail, but her colleague Pierce tells her that it is an opportunity to prove herself.

Pierce returns after looking for Anita, who refused to discuss the situation with him. He berates Chloe and Terese for what they have done, but Terese defends Chloes efforts and claims that she needed a confidence boost. Terese goes to find Anita and explain the situation, leaving Chloe and Pierce alone. Chloe reveals to Pierce that she only intended to have Terese help her once.

Chloe was taken aback when she overheard Pierce expressing doubts about her ability to manage the hotel to Terese. Feeling hurt and embarrassed, she quickly left the scene. However, Pierce continued to talk with Terese and acknowledged that Chloe had the capability to handle the job but needed some support and development.

Nell goes missing, and her father Toadie, uncle Shane and Kyle all search for her. They eventually find her at the Community Centre, where a mural of her deceased mother Sonya has been painted. Toadie is moved by the mural, and they all agree to visit and remember Sonya there.

Dipi and Shane have a conversation about Roxy, which reveals Dipis suspicions about Shanes relationship with Roxy. Dipi is skeptical about Shanes claim that he is only being a good mate to Roxy. She thinks Roxy has too much control over Shane, and she is concerned about their age difference. Shane is confused about Dipis sudden suspicion and wonders why she is getting so worked up about it.

Tensions rise between Dipi and Shane as she confronts him about his relationship with Roxy. Dipi believes that Roxy is causing Shane trouble at work and that he is spending too much time with her, causing strain on their marriage. Shane denies any romantic involvement with Roxy and dismisses Dipis concerns, causing her to become frustrated and upset.

Elly was taken aback when Susan arrived instead of Finn, and Susan was upset to hear that Finn had been spending time with Elly in the middle of the night. Chloe, on the other hand, fell asleep at work, and Ned had to wake her up. She revealed that she was behind on a project due the next day and was worried about being seen as a failure.

Chloe and Hendrix were discussing Chloes promotion to General Manager of Lassiters, a job that Hendrixs father, Paul, had also hoped for. Terese congratulated Chloe, but her facial expression showed her disappointment. Hendrix, on the other hand, seemed quiet and distracted during the conversation. Unknown to them, Hendrix had stolen a photo of Chloe earlier and hid it in his pocket.

Chloe and Pierce discuss why Pierce doesnt want Lisa to arrive, and he explains that Lisa will blame him for Hendrixs behavior. Meanwhile, Harlow meets Hendrix on the street and learns that hes afraid Lisa will make him move back to Sydney. Terese tries to organize Pauls 60th birthday breakfast while David arrives with a parcel from Robert.

Pierce chases Hendrix outside, wanting to explain himself, but Hendrix is in no mood to listen. Pierce understands his son is angry, but he says theyre still family and nothing has changed between them. Hendrix is outraged Pierce wants to play the family card reminding his dad you dont keep whoppers of secrets like that from your family.

Lisa confides in Chloe and Pierce that she wants to have a child with Pierce. She explains that she has been having difficulty conceiving and that she is no longer with James. Lisa suggests that they could co-parent the child together, along with Chloe, in a modern family arrangement. Chloe initially reacts with anger and accuses Lisa of using her husband to have a child.

Roxy apologizes to Shane for kissing him the night before. She feels ashamed and takes responsibility for her mistake. Shane tells her that he only sees her as a friend and did not intend to give her any other impression. Roxy accepts his response and tries to move on.

Elly had become increasingly frustrated with David and Aaron for not keeping her informed about the whereabouts of her child. She felt like they were being careless and not taking her concerns seriously. This caused a heated argument between the three of them, with Elly storming off in a fit of anger.

Roxy returns home feeling unwell, surprising her friends and family who thought she was still at work. She later reveals that she wants to quit her job to work in a different industry. Her coworkers try to convince her to wait until shes better and has another job lined up before quitting.

Dipi apologizes to Kyle and Roxy, admitting her mistake in judging them. Roxy had previously expressed her guilt to Shane about kissing Kyle, but Harlow warns her not to hurt Dipi by revealing this. Meanwhile, Pierce receives a text from Lisa, and both he and Chloe agree that they need more time to think about having a child with her.

Lisa is excited about the prospect of having another baby with Pierce and Chloe, while Chloe is feeling overwhelmed and hesitant about the plan. Elly tries to encourage her to talk to Pierce about her feelings. Meanwhile, Roxy and Dipi are at the spa, and Roxy is feeling guilty about her secret relationship with Shane.

Dipi and Shane had a heated argument after Dipi found out that Roxy had kissed Shane a week ago, and they both kept it a secret from her. Yashvi and Toadie overheard their argument, and Yashvi was hurt and angry as a result. Meanwhile, Roxy confessed to Terese, Ned, and Paul that she had kissed Shane and was devastated by her actions.

Kyle suggests adding archery to the Buddy Clubs activities. Toadie and Terese do not question the idea, and Kyle shows them a flyer for kid-friendly equipment. Finn arrives and shows interest in the idea. Meanwhile, Ned receives a call from Yashvi, who is upset due to her parents argument. He promises to pick her up and sees a suspicious figure outside her home.

Yashvis car wouldnt start in the Lassiters car park, but she eventually managed to get it going and drove off. Later on, David and Aaron approached Lisa with an interesting proposal they asked if she would be willing to be their surrogate as they were discussing starting a family. Meanwhile, at Harolds Cafe, Hendrix was bothering Harlow and things got a bit heated.

Lisa pays a surprise visit to David and Aaron and drops a bombshell - shes pregnant. Lisa also shares the news with Chloe and Pierce, revealing that the baby belongs to her ex, James. This news doesnt sit well with Aaron and David, and they confide in Kyle, Elly, and Chloe about their disappointment.

Hendrix arriving at Harlows house to pick up her cat, testing his theory that Harlow has a crush on him. Harlow is too busy ogling him to listen, leading to a sneezing fit and the need for her inhaler.

Harlow is packing her bag when Hendrix, who appears to be her love interest, enters shirtless and sweaty. Harlow becomes distracted by him, and he teases her about having a crush on him. Chloe complains about having too much to do for a Mardi Gras float and asserts her support for LGBTQI rights. Hendrix comes in and is noted for his positive demeanor.

Yashvi sat anxiously at The Waterhole, waiting for the results of her police exam. Ned joined her, and soon after, Toadie arrived. As they were chatting, Ned overheard Toadie discussing an incident at Buddy Club. Curious, Ned listened intently as Toadie explained what had happened.

Kyle and Ned discuss the break-in at Toadies office and suspect that it may be connected to illegal gun trading. Finn confides in Susan and Bea about his struggles with his alcoholic father, and they offer him their support.

Yashvi was in disbelief when Kyle and Ned told her that they had followed her stalker and obtained evidence of him selling guns. Her shock quickly turned to anger as she learned that Ned had not disclosed this information to her, and that Kyle had a criminal record. Despite this, the trio decided to take the evidence to the police.

Paul and Pierce are discussing Chloes delay in submitting a budget report for the hotel and her efforts to secure Princess Mary of Denmarks dress for the upcoming wedding expo. Paul is skeptical about the expos success and points out that everything hinges on Chloe getting her hands on the royal wedding dress.

Karl witnessed Dipi kissing Gary and told Finn that he thinks Gary is attracted to Dipi. Finn got angry and accused Karl of spying on them. Meanwhile, Dipi felt guilty about what happened and decided to tell Shane the truth. She went to The Waterhole with Gary, and Shane was heartbroken when he heard the news.

Finn is shocked to learn from his friends Bea and Elly that his father went to Colombia with the ransom for his release but lost the money and did not come back for him. Finn is devastated, and he walks out of the house. Meanwhile, Dipi visits Shane to try and fix their marriage.

Jane is caught rifling through the filing cabinet by Susan, the school principal. Jane apologizes and explains that she just wanted an update on the staff and students but acknowledges that she should have gone to Susan for that information. Susan gives her an official verbal warning, and Jane accepts it.

Mark approached Ned and informed him that the 3D gun ring was a part of a tri-state police operation, and he was responsible for handling the South Australian branch. Toadie arrived and congratulated Mark on his promotion to detective again. At the same time, Yashvi revealed to Nell and Hugo that she kept everything a secret to avoid stressing her loved ones.

Harlow is feeling guilty and responsible for an accident involving a cat. Paul tries to comfort her and suggests that she takes another driving lesson to feel more confident on the road. However Hendrix, is angry and upset with Harlow and blames her for the accident.

Paul reminds Lucy that she has a meeting and suggests that she gives Jane a lift back to the hotel. The two then leave, and Terese and Paul discuss Lucys offer of her old job as General Manager of Lassiters. Terese is unsure whether she should take it or not, as she doesnt want to let Toadie down. Toadie understands Tereses predicament and encourages her to do what she must do.

Elly arrived home with her daughter, Aster, in an extremely emotional state. She woke up her partner, Bea, who asked if something was wrong. Elly was crying and apologized for waking her up, explaining that she had to leave where she was before. Meanwhile, at No. 28, Beas brother, Finn, appeared traumatized by recent events and was unable to speak.

Finn feels uneasy as he lets Toadie into his house, uncertain of what he wants.
