Meanwhile, Susan is still dealing with the aftermath of the Departments investigation, and Karl tries to support her by arranging a morning tea with Bea and Jane.

Pierce asks Hendrix how he feels about it, and Chloe explains that Fays condition is worsening, and she requires round-the-clock care, and they would like to provide relief for the family in Adelaide. Hendrix agrees, and Chloe tells Pierce how much she appreciates Hendrix for being a good egg.

Jenna reassures her friends that she wont let them down before heading off to give Emmett the good news about her induction. Meanwhile, Pierce discusses Fays impending visit with Jane and Karl at Harolds cafe, and Karl suggests involving Nicolette in the preparations.

Nicolette has moved into Number 24 and quickly made an impression on Chloe and Pierce with her no-nonsense attitude. However, Hendrix is surprised to learn that Nicolette arrived without his knowledge or approval. Nicolette later explains that she is there to take care of Fay, not to take on Chloes responsibilities.
Sheila tries to help Levi with his laundry and talks to Gary the Pigeon. Bea visits Kyle and Levi and ogles at the latter before awkwardly greeting him and leaving.

Harlow and Mackenzie were discussing the environmental impact of plastic straws when Harlow suggested creating a petition to protest their use. Mackenzie seemed to agree, and they started brainstorming ideas.

Roxy confronts Shane about his belief that she is leading Kyle on. Roxy tells Shane that he is mistaken, but Shane continues to accuse her of being hung up on him. This argument leads to Roxy storming out, and Shane becoming angry and kicking furniture.

Aaron and David sat down with Emmett, explaining that they did not say anything to Paul about his mom. However, they discovered that one of the other cleaners had informed on her. Emmett was angry with his mom, and David suggested it might be best for Jenna to leave. Unfortunately, Jenna took it as the boys turning Emmett against her.

Levi is experiencing favoritism from Sheila, which is causing some tension between him and Kyle. Kyle expresses his displeasure with the situation, and it remains to be seen how this will play out in future episodes.

Yashvi confronting Bea and Levi about their secretive relationship. Bea explains that they did not want to deal with the pressure in case it didnt work out, and Levi adds that they didnt want the heat from Gran. Yashvi is upset that they didnt trust her to keep their secret as Levis partner and Beas best friend.

Dipi and Shane had a tense night, with Dipi annoyed at Shane for being locked in a library half the night after she had gone to the effort of cooking dinner. The tension continues when Mackenzie returns home and tells Dipi and Shane about how she and Harlow foiled Pauls plan to install solar panels at the hotel by leaking it to the West Waratah Star.
Roxy is tearful as Kyle demands an explanation from Shane, who is unable to give one. As they leave, Shane collapses in the kitchen, sobbing.

Aaron and David were discussing the fate of Emmett, who was struggling to decide where to live after his aunt Linda was cleared to foster him and his brother. However, Leila interjected, reminding them of the importance of maintaining a connection with family for children in care.

Chloe sat down with Fay and shared the news of her pregnancy. She explained that they waited to share the news until after undergoing tests and mentioned that she was scheduled for a CVS test to determine the levels of the babys HD markers. The weight of their earlier conversation about children at Harolds now seemed more significant.

Nicolette returns to the house where Chloe, Pierce, Fay, and Hendrix are waiting for her. However, she keeps quiet about her date with Alex. Fay tells Chloe that Mark and Paige have sent her a shortlist of baby names for her opinions. Pierce suggests naming the new baby after his dad, but Lisa disagrees.

Toadie checks on Shane, who is out for a walk, and Dipi is worried about him. Sheila invites Roxy and Kyle to try out some of her food for the party, but Kyle thinks it is a bit weird to have a party when Shane is out of town because of stress.

Shane had been struggling with drug addiction, and it had reached a breaking point. Toadie found him in a shed where he had been attempting to quit on his own by gradually reducing the amount he took, but he was clearly not coping. Toadie knew he needed to convince Shane to return home, but Shane was reluctant to do so.

Dipi was having a great time at her surprise anniversary dinner, which her daughter Mackenzie and her friends Karl and Ritchie had organized. Toadie was trying to keep Shane away until he had cleaned himself up. However, Pierce arrived at Number 24 and found out about the secret dinner.

Dipi confronts Shane about his addiction and begs him to make things right. However, Toadie reveals to Karl and Susan that Shane has been struggling with drug addiction for a few months. Yashvi is determined to catch the dealer and confides in Levi about the drugs she found in Shanes bag.

Yashvi appeared distracted, and when pressed, she admitted that watching her fathers interview had been tough. Chloe offered to dispose of a stockpile of non-eco-friendly products taken out of guest rooms, while Hendrix criticized her for working instead of spending time with him.

Jane received a message from her ex-husband, Des, informing her that he was planning to visit her the following day. She immediately suspected that Paul was responsible for Dess visit, based on a conversation he had with Nicolette.

Rose is attempting to guess Toadies computer password, but mistakenly locks him out of his system. When Mackenzie notices the locked door, she advises Rose that the door should not be locked during business hours. This is a reminder to us all that security measures should not impede normal business operations.

Dipi struggling to cope with her husband Shanes departure. She reaches a breaking point at Harolds Cafe and loses her temper, breaking some plates and causing Roxy to be shaken. Pierce steps in to clean up the mess and takes Dipi home. Toadie reminds her that she has people who care for her, including Shane and himself.

Dax informs Yashvi that her father is no longer a suspect in the drugs case, as long as nothing changes. Levi joins them and Dax invites him for a beer later in the day. Meanwhile, Ned realizes that Erinsborough is visible in the background of one of the photos he sent to his subscriber. Paul confronts Ned for not being present at the exhibition.

Yashvi and Patricia attend to Rivers injuries in an abandoned building, where they discover a taser wound on his torso. Meanwhile, Dax continues to make unsettling remarks towards Levi, who looks nervous. Levi uses Kyles arrival as an excuse to get rid of Dax, but Dax gets a call about River being assaulted and asks Levi to accompany him to the hospital.

Nicolette has just confessed her feelings to Chloe, and now Chloe is surprised by the news. Nicolette tells her that she is in love with her and that she will have to find a new job. Chloe, however, responds by telling her that she is in love with Pierce and that her feelings are not going to change.

Rose confides in Hendrix that she has been taking photos of files at Toadies office in order to find evidence that her husband, James, is hiding assets from her. However, she is afraid to tell Toadie as he is bound by client confidentiality and believes that James will not give her a fair settlement in the divorce.

Sheila walks into the room to find Levi, Kyles cousin, having a seizure on the floor. Concerned, she immediately calls for help. Bea, Kyles girlfriend, takes charge of the situation and decides to call the police to get Levi the medical attention he needs.

Mackenzies condition remains uncertain, and Dipi is anxious, waiting for news at the hospital. Karl advises Susan to leave the hospital and go home, but Susan is worried about Mackenzie and upset with Karls involvement.
Roxy feels guilty for advising Ned to create the Fandangle video and apologises to him. Ned admits that he went too far and regrets his actions but decides to focus on his upcoming exhibition.

Chloe is upset about Pierces excitement over their baby, and Nicolette offers her support and suggests she take a walk to calm down. Meanwhile, at Harolds Cafe, Rose gives Hendrix headphones as a gift, but he is preoccupied with the consequences of stealing Mackenzies speech. When Toadie arrives and confronts him, Rose concocts a story to cover up Hendrixs actions.

Chloe is admitted after experiencing severe pains while out for a walk alone. Her partner, Pierce, is worried about her and wants to go into the room with her, but Nicolette, another hospital staff member, advises against it. Chloe is in severe pain and looks tearfully at Pierce through the glass. Later, Nicolette gives Pierce the good news that Chloe and the baby are going to be fine.

Nicolette and Pierce are worried about Chloes pregnancy, as she has not told her mother Fay that she is using a surrogate instead of carrying the baby herself. They urge Chloe to tell her mother the truth, but she insists on waiting.

Pierce accuses Nicolette of causing Chloe to have a miscarriage by encouraging her to go for a walk. Chloe, however, defends Nicolette and insists that it was her own idea. Aaron and David decide to give the family space but plan to take dinner and a care package over later.

Ned meets Scarlett again and is horrified, as she had stabbed him with a cheese knife during their previous encounter. Scarlett insists that she is not stalking him and that she wants to commission Ned to paint her portrait as a wedding gift for her fiancé. She blackmails Ned by threatening to release a video with his tattoos to his friends and family.

Ned receives a gift from his girlfriend, Scarlett - a new palette knife with a sweet engraving. However, Scarletts behavior takes a turn for the worse when she sends Ned a message saying she will leave him alone if he gives her a painting.

Kyle takes it upon himself to try and play matchmaker between Levi and Bea, while celebrating Levis return to work. Meanwhile, Clive pays a visit to Sheila to talk about Levis medical results, and Sheila seems to feel guilty about interfering in Levis affairs.

Sheila is trying to mend things with her grandson Levi, who is upset with her for potentially jeopardizing his return to work by asking her boyfriend, Clive, to evaluate him. Nicolette suggests to Levi that he ask for a second, independent evaluation, which he is hesitant to do out of fear of being cut loose.

Nicolette tells Jane that she has accepted a permanent position at the hospital, and Jane is happy to hear the news. However, Nicolette is doubtful that things will improve with Chloe, and she doesnt think their dream of living happily ever after on the same street will come true.
Dipi and Shane are still arguing about the cooking class, and both are blaming each other for not being supportive. Shane, on the other hand, is blaming Pierce for starting the argument.

Dipi and Pierce share a kiss, but the guilt they feel afterwards makes them realize they shouldnt have done it. Pierce suggests keeping it a secret to avoid complicating their already shaky marriages further. At Harolds Cafe, Yashvi discusses her father Shanes recent argument with Dipi.
Kyle has joined Roxy and Bea outside No 22 and is informed that the conversation between Ned and Yashvi is full-on, and things are worse than expected.
Jane is excited about being made permanent at school. She hopes that Nicolette will also settle down in the street, but Nicolette has other plans and is looking for a new place to live.

Toadie drops by Karl and Susans house to talk about their previous nights encounter with Rose. Karl denies any wrongdoing, while Susan admits that she suggested their dinner might have been a date. Toadie teases them for a while before telling them hes arranged a second date with Rose.

Toadie and Mackenzie are seen talking to James outside the hotel, attempting to persuade him to reconcile with Rose. James jokes about Toadies bond with Rose, while Mackenzie clarifies that the relationship between Rose and Toadie is strictly professional.

Shane is serving pasta sauce to his guests, hoping it tastes better than his previous bad attempt. Chloe offers to help but Shane refuses and goes to put some music on. Meanwhile, at the Hive, Ned is struggling to paint without thinking of Scarletts taunting. He receives a text from Yashvi saying shes busy.

Paul eagerly searches for his portrait, and Terese unwraps a painting of him that he hates. Meanwhile, Levi tells Bea about Yashvis confrontation with Scarlett at the hospital, and Dipi tries on costumes for the exhibition with Shane, who is feeling unwell and decides to stay home. Chloe and Pierce head to the exhibition together, leaving Hendrix behind to Skype with Harlow.

Terese is worried about Ned and cannot reach him. Paul thinks Ned is just blowing off steam and hassling him will make things worse. Yashvi feels guilty for making Ned put on the exhibition that caused the trouble. She blames herself for the incident, but Bea points out that Scarlett is obsessed with Ned and would have done anything regardless.

Ned is being questioned by the police about the disappearance of Scarlett. The police show Ned a palette knife and he identifies it as his own but cannot remember anything about the situation. He suggests that Scarlett must have planted the knife to set him up, but the police cannot be sure until they find Scarlett.

Nicolette receives a surprise visit from her friend Audrey, whom she had been ignoring. David and Aaron come in, and Nicolette insists that she barely knows Ned and doesnt want to visit him. Meanwhile, Dipi and Shane worry about Yashvi, who is struggling with the situation involving Ned.

Dipi tells Toadie about her arguments with Shane regarding his indecisiveness on university decisions and the fear of relapse, which leads them to fight a lot lately. Toadie advises her to be patient with Shane and keep him on track. Nicolette sees Pierce and Audrey talking and then questions Audrey about their conversation after Pierce left.

Pierce and Dipi feel guilty about what they have done and discuss how they both love their respective spouses. They agree that what happened between them is a one-time thing, and they need to focus on their spouses. Nicolette has sent Karl a bill for the repairs she made on the ceiling, which has left Karl feeling annoyed and cheated.

Kyle has suffered a nasty 2nd-degree burn and is taken to the hospital, where he is treated by Beverly. Clive, who was present at Kyles house during the incident, takes this opportunity to speak to Sheila about their previous relationship. Although Sheila denies that she was about to take him back, Clive feels that there is still a chance for them.

Paul and Ned are discussing Scarletts case when Roxy joins them. She assures them that she wont judge or blab about their secrets, but Ned is feeling tense and leaves. Later, Terese and Harlow tell Roxy that she basically accused Ned of being guilty. Terese believes that Detective Graves is in Erinsborough for Neds case.

Ned is struggling with his memories of the night Scarlett died. He tells Paul and Terese about a flash he had of hearing thumping from the car boot while he was driving, which he believes was Scarlett, and another flash in which he was holding a bloody palette knife. Although he cannot remember killing Scarlett, he feels guilty and thinks he must have done it.

Bea visits Paul and Terese at The Hive, telling them that Ned has asked her to bring some paintings back from the exhibition. While discussing the situation, Scarlett eavesdrops on their conversation through a hole in the door to the storage room. Bea asks if they think that Ned is guilty, and Terese replies that she is still processing the fact that he turned himself in.

Shane tells Toadie about his argument with Dipi. Toadie scolds him for going to the police station and messing with evidence. He advises Shane to step back because Yashvi is in a worse position now. Dipi interrupts their conversation and asks Shane to leave her alone.

Jane and Nicolette discuss the portrait of Mrs Mangel. Nicolette declines a lunch invitation from her mother, as she is waiting for Chloe, who is having a difficult time and needs her. Chloe arrives, and they head off together. Dipi decides to stay longer with Pierce. Chloe hears about David and Aarons baby plans and is thrilled for them.

Nicolette visits Nell, who is unwell and believes that she deserves to know the truth about Nicolettes sexuality. Jane is upset to hear that Nicolette had hidden this from her and is angry that she would upset Nell when she was already sick. Nell dies shortly after Nicolette leaves, leaving Jane upset.

Kyle is hit by a van and taken to the hospital while Bea and Terese rush to help him. Roxy reveals that she is the moderator of the Facebook page for Pauls portrait and also the one whos been moving it around town for everyones amusement.

Levi, Ned, Yashvi and Bea want to bring new evidence to Detective Graves, but he isnt interested, dismissing it as circumstantial. Yashvi warns Ned that his family could be in danger, and he decides to leave the house. Meanwhile, Kyle goes overboard baby-proofing the house, concerned that he and Roxy will be targeted by Scarlett.

Dipi is not excited about her camping trip with Shane, where they will be in complete isolation. Toadie thinks it sounds wonderful, but Dipis face says the opposite. Ned, Yashvi, Bea, and Levi reconvene, and Yashvi has made the social media posts about the wedding. Ned managed to get a celebrant on the grounds that its a commitment ceremony rather than a legal wedding.

Levis quick actions prevent Scarletts plan to harm Bea from succeeding, but Scarlett ends up hurting herself. At the hospital a sense of relief amongst everyone as they are glad that the plan did not work. The police arrive to take statements from everyone, indicating that there may be further developments in the case.

Terese, the responsible and caring mother figure, urges Harlow to prioritize her upcoming exam by going to bed early and turning off her phone. Despite Harlows initial reluctance, Terese finally convinces her to do so, showing her firm but gentle parenting skills.

Pierce and Pauls disagreement regarding their business in the Lassiters hotel has created tension between them. The situation escalates when Pierce decides to sell his share of the hotel to Paul, leading to Chloes disappointment.

Terese, the responsible and caring mother figure, urges Harlow to prioritize her upcoming exam by going to bed early and turning off her phone. Despite Harlows initial reluctance, Terese finally convinces her to do so, showing her firm but gentle parenting skills.

At Erinsborough High School, tensions are high as Jane confronts Harlow about cheating on an exam. Harlow discovers that Hendrix is responsible for sending photos of the exam paper on her phone. Jane decides to report the incident, which leaves Harlow feeling even more betrayed.

Pierces suggestion to move out of Erinsborough and Victoria shocks Terese, who worries about the impact it would have on her family. Meanwhile, Hendrix is desperate to win Harlow back, and his discovery of Pierces moving plans complicates matters even further.
Sheila expresses her guilt over what happened to Levi, revealing that she feels responsible for his pain. Kyle tries to reassure her that it wasnt her fault, but Sheila remains troubled.

Sheila is shown to be worried about Levis desire to apply for the police weapons training scheme again. Her concern stems from his previous troubles with the law and the potential dangers of having a weapon.

Chloe is feeling overjoyed at Pierces return to Number 24. Pierce tells her that hes ready to move back in and has taken all the time he needed to sort things out. He confesses that he missed her and is eager to make things right. However, things are not going so well for Dipi at Number 30.

Dipi thanks Pierce for something he gave her. Pierce insists that it is he who should be thanking Dipi. This exchange makes Dipi emotional, causing Nicolette, who is hiding in the bathroom, to panic. When Pierce approaches the bathroom door, Nicolette fears that she will be discovered.

Pierce is seen hastily dressing and trying to talk to his wife, Chloe, but she walks out of the hotel room. Pierce wants to go after her, but she urges him to stay. Nicolette approaches Chloe after waiting for her to exit the hotel and asks her whats wrong, but Chloe is too worried about her need to throw up to respond.
Dipi is grateful for Sheilas kindness in taking her in, following her separation from Shane. Sheila agrees to respect Dipis boundaries and not take sides, but offers her support as a friend.

Mackenzie struggles with her anger after a fight with Richie, which leads to her rushing off in frustration. Roxy steps in and advises her to stop blaming Richie for her parents marital problems. Meanwhile, Susan and Karl return from their trip to Switzerland, and Karl is suspicious of a new top in Susans suitcase, causing tension between them.

Nathan and Bea, who have a great date and plan to go on more. Meanwhile, Kyle and Roxy are curious about how Bea knows Packo. Sheila drops off snacks for Levi at work and inquires about the Packo situation.

Pierce and Dipis affair has caused a stir within their friend group. The situation becomes more complicated as Toadie tries to console Shane, who is still upset about Pierce and Dipi being together. However, Shane becomes enraged when he learns that the situation is about to become more complicated.

Pierces health takes a turn for the worse as he suffers from a heart attack and is rushed to the hospital. The news of his condition sends shockwaves throughout the community, and his loved ones are left reeling. Hendrix, Pierces stepson, turns to Susan for support, hoping to find some solace in her comforting presence.

Nicolette presents David and Aaron with the idea of her being their surrogate and them co-parenting with her. While David is initially sceptical, Aaron is intrigued by the idea, wanting to explore it further. They discuss the pros and cons, with David reminding Aaron about their planned surrogacy arrangement in Canada.

Bea is upset when she discovers that Nathan and Levi have a complicated history, and she walks away from the situation. Meanwhile, Levi is hurt that his friends, Roxy and Kyle, kept the secret about Nathan and Bea from him, leaving him feeling betrayed.

Hendrix, Jay, Richie, and Ollie, are preparing for their schoolies trip. As they unload their car in the campsite car park, Ollie records a video expressing his excitement for the trip. The boys discuss their expectations, including scoring with girls. Hendrix hopes the girls arent watching, while Richie is concerned about his girlfriend, who isnt responding to his texts.

While Karl is worried about the potential scandal at the school, Pierce is more focused on imparting life lessons to his son Hendrix. Karl struggles with how to inform his wife about the incident, and the girls discuss Richies mistreatment of Mackenzie. Harlow being suspicious of Hendrix and Richies motives for delaying their meeting with Mackenzie.

Pierces confession to Dipi about his enduring love for Chloe leads to heartbreak for Dipi, a revelation that creates a tension that is unmistakable. Meanwhile, Chloe confirms the end of her relationship with Pierce, and Nicolette hands over her health summary and ovulation schedule to Aaron and David, urging them to accept her offer.

Tensions rise as Nicolette and her mother Jane have a conversation about Nicolettes pregnancy. Nicolette is adamant that she needs her mothers complete support and wants the news to be made public, but Jane remains silent, leaving Nicolette feeling frustrated and unsupported.
Levi reports that Bea is doing well with her mother and has been working on a new song. However, Levi also notes that Bea has not mentioned Nathan, which may be a cause for concern.

Sheila and Kyle, who are attempting to help Nathan after he sustains an injury. However, their efforts are interrupted by the arrival of Levi, who insists that they step aside and allow him to take control of the situation.

Pierce and Chloe are still discussing Hendrixs financial situation. Pierce is considering buying Hendrix an apartment, but Chloe believes that it is not the right solution. She advises Pierce to stop feeling guilty and be firm with Hendrix so that he learns to be independent.

The departure of Pierce leaves Chloe feeling down. She cancels her plans with the girls and decides to stay home. Nicolette, on the other hand, is happy that Pierce is gone, but she understands that Chloe needs some time alone. She gives her some space and lets her be.

Jane proposes the idea of a group chat for the housemates, but Nicolette seems distracted by her own thoughts. Nicolette starts to develop a plan, and it becomes clear that she has some ulterior motives.

The revelation of Dipis affair with Pierce is a turning point for the family. Yashvis reaction to her mothers confession is one of hurt and betrayal, and its clear that it will take time for her to process and forgive. Dipi, meanwhile, is left to grapple with the consequences of her actions and the impact they have had on her loved ones.

Jay and Hendrix try to cover up the mess they made in Shane and Dipis apartment by staging a break-in. Hendrix is hesitant to help because he is already in trouble with the police, but eventually agrees. They also discuss deleting the security camera footage, which Hendrix is supposed to do before starting his first day of work at Lassiters.

Dipis secret is finally out. She confesses to her daughter Yashvi that she had an affair with Pierce, a man who is not her husband. Despite her infidelity, Dipi insists that she would never abandon her children. However, Yashvi is deeply upset and feels betrayed.

Jane is feeling ashamed of herself after waking up next to Clive following the spiked punch, and she tries to hide her embarrassment. Meanwhile. The Kennedys are suspicious of Audreys behaviour during the party and want to clarify the inconsistencies in her story.

Audrey confesses to Toadie that she had stolen money from a dead person. However, she never used it and wanted to return it to the family. Audrey confided in Nicolette, who had already spent the money and convinced her to keep quiet. This causes tension between them as Audrey feels guilty for what she had done.

Nicolette drops the bombshell on Aaron that she is pregnant, and while he is thrilled with the news, David appears hesitant to accept it. Overwhelmed by the situation, David retreats to bed, leaving Aaron to try and talk to him about it the next morning. However, David remains uncertain about the baby, leaving Aaron to face the situation alone.

Hendrix returns to the laundry room at Lassiters Hotel and discovers Terese unconscious against the wall. He quickly calls for help, and David arrives and takes her to the hospital, where Paul meets them. After some medical attention, David reassures Paul that Terese has moderate hyperthermia and will be okay.

Jay introduces the idea of card-counting to Hendrix in the hopes of making money from underground blackjack games. At first, Hendrix is skeptical about the legality of the plan. However, due to his financial troubles, he eventually agrees to give it a try. Although the two struggle with card-counting, Jay tries to teach Hendrix some online games to help him practice.

Clive and Janes decision to pursue a relationship on the down-low. Despite their age difference, the two characters feel a strong connection, and they decide to take things slow and keep their relationship a secret from their friends and family. However, it remains to be seen how long they can keep their feelings for each other under wraps.

Sheila and Jane discussing the broken deckchair in No.32s backyard. Sheila is feeling down about her relationship with Clive and believes there is no hope for them. Jane sympathises and suggests they head over to No.26 to talk this over, but Sheila wants to stay. As Clive appears and disappears into the Doug Out, Jane agrees to stay.

Nicolettes meeting with Ricardo to discuss her debt repayment. She looks upset after the meeting, prompting Dipis concern. Chloe suggests that she share the news with Aaron at The Waterhole, but Dipi reminds her that Nic needs to start her shift at Harolds soon. Meanwhile, Amy is working on her uniform design in her room when Terese tells her about guest complaints about the noise.

Amy is struggling to cope with the guilt of her designs being copied. She fears getting caught and faces Shanes support as he tries to comfort her. To take her mind off things, Shane takes Amy out for dinner, where they bump into Terese. Terese approaches Amy to talk about the tender and informs her that she still has the contract, and Paul was impressed with her designs.

The tension between Hendrix and Jay is palpable, as Hendrix is blaming Jay for his recent gambling losses. Despite Jays attempt to explain his actions, Hendrix remains unconvinced. Jay, however, promises to help Hendrix recover his losses by lending him money to buy into the next game. Meanwhile, Amy is focused on her uniform idea and seeking a new fabric supplier.

Hendrix and Jay host a secret card game at Number 24. Hendrix is confident that he can win big, but Jay is concerned that things could go wrong. Kane, a former associate of Hendrix, wants the game to be played at 24 and the boys are following his rules to avoid getting caught. Despite Jays warnings, Hendrix insists on playing on, as he needs to win his money back.

Clive and Jane, who have been keeping their relationship a secret, are caught by Sheila. Meanwhile, Aaron tries to convince David to reconcile with Nicolette, but David seems to be unwilling to do so.

David and Kyle found Nicolette unconscious on the floor of the caf, causing panic among them. David immediately suggests taking her to the hospital, but Nicolette is worried about leaving the caf unattended. After much persuasion from David, Kyle agrees to look after the caf while they take Nicolette to the hospital. Fortunately, Nicolette and her baby are both okay.

Amy admits to Chloe that she plagiarized another designers work, a confession that Chloe finds hard to swallow. Chloe is torn between loyalty to her friend and her responsibility to the business. She ultimately decides that Terese needs to know about Amys actions and refuses to cover for her friend.

At Number 28, Hendrixs predicament escalates as he receives a bullet from Kane, a person he owes a large sum of money. His fear for his life leads him to contemplate desperate measures. Jay comes up with a plan to rob Dipis room to find something valuable to sell. However, Hendrix and Jays actions could have dire consequences.

Shane and Amys kiss, which leaves Amy feeling excited but confused. However, their moment is cut short when Shane leaves to buy cheese, leaving Amy wondering about the nature of their relationship. Meanwhile, Clive and Jane return from their mini-break, and they discuss their policy on dealing with Sheila. They decide to be discreet but not hide, leaving Sheila feeling uncomfortable.

Sheila calls Des to come to Erinsborough to spend time with Jane, and Roxy informs her friends of the news. Kyle, Levi, and Bea join in on the conversation, but Levi points out that Roxy lied about Jane wanting to be with Des. Bea suggests waiting to see what happens next.
Sheilas health scare brings her loved ones together to support her. Clive, a doctor and Sheilas love interest, takes charge of the situation and ensures that Sheila receives the proper medical care.

Des and Sheilas relationship is complicated, but Sheila insists that spending time with Clive will be beneficial for everyone. Meanwhile, Hendrix is struggling with Kanes influence and Harlow advises him to look for a job. Jane and Clive reunite, but decide to stick to the plan for Sheilas sake.

Nicolette is facing a lawsuit for stealing and causing emotional distress. Her lawyer Tim suggests she blame it on someone else, but she declines. Meanwhile, Hendrix is dealing with the aftermath of losing an illegally occupied house, and Jay is preoccupied with his situation. Mackenzie tries to lighten the mood, but Jay remains focused on Hendrix.

Nicolette attends a blackjack game at No 24, hosted by Kane. She wins the game and declines Kanes offer of a drink, instead opting to drink with the other women. After Kane leaves, Nicolette discovers that he is planning to transfer the house and decides to investigate further.
Dipi and Shane reconciled, and Kyle cooked his fathers dish for the competition. He won, and Dipi and Shane celebrated with him.

Kyle and Roxy finish preparing Garys dish and wait for the judges arrival. The next day, Jacinta arrives and tastes the dish, declaring it the winner of the competition. Kyle and Roxy are overjoyed and celebrate their victory.

Clive tried to explain to Jane that he was just helping Sheila out with some issues, but Jane was unconvinced. Meanwhile, Amy and Shane were arranging their first date and Kane was hosting a game at Number 24. Sheila remained hopeful that Clive would end things with Jane and be with her instead.

Shane is injured in a pizza oven explosion, and everyone rushes to help him. Hendrix calls an ambulance, and they all go to the hospital. Yashvi discovers the cause of the explosion, and Dipi questions Jay about Hendrixs involvement. Meanwhile, Chloe and Nicolette are surprised, and Ned and Terese are worried. Amy is excited to see her designs on the staff at the hospital.

Hendrix is investigated for his involvement with Kane, a criminal involved in gambling. Nicolette apologizes to Aaron and David for not telling them about Kane and Hendrixs gambling, but is no longer welcome at the Sonya Foundation. Meanwhile, Paul is worried about Harlow, who is missing, and Yashvi informs Hendrix that Kane is missing and may have associates from the gambling ring.
Paul, Terese, Hendrix, Chloe, Roxy, Kyle, Aaron, David, Yashvi, and Nicolette all join forces to find Harlow. They eventually discover that she was kidnapped by Kane, a former member of The Shed.

Roxy, Kyle, Toadie, Clive, Jane, Des, Sheila, Shane, Amy, and Dipi all face the aftermath of the death cap mushroom incident. Jane and Des confront their issues, while Sheila apologizes for her actions. Shane is discharged from the hospital and Dipi and Amy make sure he is taken care of.
